title: Aiysha
excerpt: 2017 Quarter Horse Dappled Buckskin Mare 15 Hands
description: Undeniably, jaws drop as Aiysha rides by And she’s even better on the inside….a babysitter and on complete auto pilot! We in all honesty would not change one thing about her. Not only drawn to her beauty but also her bloodlines, talent, and kindness she is THE TRIPLE CROWN plus more that everyone looks for in a high-caliber mare. Family versatile, she is adorable and so enjoyable to be around. Her personality and talent SETS HER APART. She is a stunning DAPPLED BUCKSKIN mare with an exceptional hip. Aiysha has been there and done it- ranch riding, shown in reining to trail riding, even bareback and everything in between. She is our go-to horse in all disciplines and really stands out consistently on the trails. She is most recognized for her adaptable behavior to surprises or new situations. She always rides to the ability of the rider on her back and does not try to do more than they ask. She is trained to kneel and curbside to make mounting easy with the touch of a finger! Aiysha is an elegant mover, who is the smoothest, and has the most comfortable gaits. More than the average lady. Easy to operate, she is solid in all reining maneuvers, with smooth spins, nice lead change, a pretty circle, and a great stop. Aiysha would be a world contender in the ranch versatility classes. She has a captivating carriage and is a gorgeous mover with a pretty jog and extended trot. One of her greatest assets is that she is very smooth to ride at all gaits. Aiysha knows how to rate off your seat, will nail her transitions smoothly, and is great on the obstacle course. Undeniably one of the most graceful under English tack as well! Her natural athleticism and versatility easily cross over from the arena to the trails and loves to lend a helping hand on the ranch sorting cattle. Aiysha enjoys the simple things in life like spending time with her person on the trails. Ridden many of miles of backcountry trails on overnight and hunting trips. She has been exposed to big game, tents, hikers, packs of dogs, bicycles, drank out of a lake, been hobbled and picketed. Great up the hills and mountains, and careful going down them. Water, bridges and logs, and she will curbside to a rock to mount. She doesn’t mind the city clicker lifestyle either, semi trucks, strollers, cars roaring past, Aiysha just minds her business and gets to town! She is as beautiful inside as she is outside, so sweet, loves to be groomed, clips easily, and a seasoned pro to haul. Whether you’re looking for a show horse or just the prettiest trail/recreational horse out there, Aiysha will be a perfect addition to your family. We have roped on her a bit on both ends and the breakaway. Her balance of competitive ability, disposition, and breeding combined with her willingness to tolerate the greenest riders, makes her extremely special. She has been an easy horse to put through our program because she quickly picks everything up. If you’re looking for that forever horse – you have just found her! She has passed all sales requirements. UTD on worming, dental, and farrier.

title: Ajax
description: As cowboy looking as they come and America’s favorite color, Buckskin! Ajax is one cool gelding that will check all the boxes. He will do anything you want to do on horseback and looks sharp getting it done. He has a fancy reining handle and is loaded with natural cow sense. He’s impressive in a roping pen and is excelling on the head side. He can really run, rate, and do it all balanced and stylish. Ajax has been ridden all over our ranch and knows what a day’s work is all about. He has the heart the size of Texas and is willing and able to do all the jobs and tasks he is asked to do. Ajax is brave and very confident to ride in every and all situations. He’s great footed and easy to take across all terrains. He is a point and go type ride and easily guided wherever you send him. Ajax is always gentle, quiet and sane to saddle up and go, even with substantial time off. He has no silly business and is always honest. No matter what direction you want to go, this phenomenal gelding will be sure to please you. He has all the talent and athletic ability, yet a stellar mind and very sane and personable disposition. Ajax will meet you at the gate and loves all attention. This type of gelding is a hard find! Cowboy looking, family gentle, black type pedigree and versatile to go any direction!

title: Akira
excerpt: 2016 Tennessee Walking Horse Chocolate Overo Gelding 15.1 Hands
description: You will have to move heaven and earth to find another one that looks like Akira! He is breath taking to look at with his gorgeous silver dapples and amazing overo pattern and best of all, he is an absolute dream to ride on the trails, in the arena or down the road! This gelding is everything but plain to look at! He is extremely well bred and it shows, not only is he easy on the eye, but he’s an absolute trail blazer and 100% traffic safe! Akira is absolutely safe on the trails and goes over all types of obstacles, bridges, and water. Akira has 2 amazing four beat walking gaits and a super comfy canter. This superstar not only has an amazing stop, he will also spin a hole in the ground like a reining QH. You can even toss the rope off him! On the trails he can keep up with the faster walking horses or he can slow down and walk with the quarter horses. He has a beautiful stop, back up and turn around! He is not buddy or barn sour and rides out by himself or in a group perfectly. On the ground he stands to be groomed, bathed, saddled, and mounted from the ground or mounting block. He loads and unloads, stands cross tied, ground tied and is an easy keeper. We took him camping and he was a dream. He has seen miles and miles of trails and he has been a pleasure to work with and has excelled at everything we threw at him. We even used him to pack a few items to and from our campsite. We have also ridden Akira down the busy roads. He is 100% traffic safe, we had cars all around us while dragging a tarp and he didn’t flinch. This dream horse would be perfect for someone wanting to do parades, camping, beach trail rides or some arena work. If you can steer, stop, and guide, then you’re able to control and get along with Akira. He does not have any buck, bite, bolt or rear ! What you see is exactly what you get. He is UTD on shoeing, dental work and vaccinations. He is 100% sound in every way!

title: Alex
description: Alex is an eye catching Gypsy Vanner gelding, standing at 15.2 hands weighing 1400lbs very stocky and thick. He has a big gait and an even bigger heart! His ground manners are impeccable. He is safe and quiet as he had years of carriage driving which produced a very well-mannered horse under saddle and inhand. Nothing bothers him – he’s had exposure to many things such as tractors, dump trucks, traffic, guns, farm animals, screaming kids, dirt bikes, and more! Has tons of driving experience on the trails, fields, roads; including showing in pleasure and combined driving. He drives, rides english and western.

title: Ali
excerpt: 2015 Spotted Saddle Horse Black Tobiano Gelding 15.1 Hands
description: Meet THE Ali Unicorns do exist!! Right here is one and this gorgeous boy is 100% a living breathing unicorn. We have hauled him all over America trail riding and with our kids. He is one of the best go anywhere you point him trail horses you will ever sit on. He will absolutely go through or over anything. There isn’t a trail to rough for this boy. He is also a guaranteed 1st place blue ribbon winner in about any model class you will ever put him in. He will park out on command and will set there for days. He definitely knows he is the prettiest horse out there. He is the most personable horse ever. Him and Krissy are without a doubt best friends. She has taught him all kinds of tricks. He will bow, lay down for you to mount, and will side pass! He is extremely easy to catch, follows her around like a puppy dog and listens to everything she says. He has perfect manners. Stands perfect for everything. He absolutely loves to be groomed and pampered. He is easy to saddle and bridle. Stands to mount and always rides off slow and gentle. Ali rides with or without company. Rides anywhere in a group. He is great in traffic and around atvs. We have had him in all different kinds of situations and environments and he always handles himself perfectly. He has a very comfortable consistent gait that you can ride all day. We have had him on several 20-30 mile rides and he always has more in the tank. So he would be a great endurance horse as well. Don’t let that fool you I don’t mean he is go go go because he is more than content with walking all day. He just has a lot of stamina. He does great with overnight camping and will stand tied on a picket line or just tied out. He will cross any body of water. Actually I guess you should say he loves water. He loves to swim deeper the better!! He will go up or down the steepest, slickest hills you will come to. He will really set down and dig up a hill or tip toe and ease over. He is ok with bicycles, backpackers and wildlife. If you have high taste and want the prettiest, coolest trail horse out there with all the bells and whistles.. The Ali is your man!!!!

title: Alibaba
excerpt: 2016 Quarter Horse Red Roan Gelding 15.1 Hands
description: Alibaba is one cool gelding! He’s so easy to train, versatile, talented and extremely level minded. Alibaba cuts a cow very stylish and can hold a rank one from the herd. He does all the maneuvers in the cowhorse pattern and is very simple and easy. He has been roped on in the arena and in the pasture. If you rope it, he can handle it. Alibaba is a ranch horse deluxe and goes right where you send him. He handles any situation with ease. He’s dependable and honest. Alibaba is gentle for everyone and happy to go whatever speed you wish. He’s always safe and very quiet even with time off. He’s perfect on the trails and confident alone or in a group. Alibaba has a funny personality and loves attention. He’s very affectionate and just an all around great gelding. No matter what you want to do, he’s always a trooper and very willing. Alibaba has it all going. He has the breeding, the ride, the looks and as a bonus, the color!

title: Amber
description: Talk about a fancy buckskin mare! Amber looks the part with her stunning blue eyes, chrome galore, and shape for days! She rides as fancy as she looks. She is easy and effortless to put through all the reining maneuvers. Her classy looks and elegant style make her presence in the show pen stand out. She would be a great ranch riding & trail competitor. Amber has been trail ridden extensively. She has been ridden through all types of terrain & scenery. She is always quiet, calm and collected. She is gentle for all levels of riders. She is simple, comfortable and fun to ride and handle around the barn. Amber has the sweetest disposition and is like having an old ranch gelding around the barn. She isn’t fussy, ties, trailers and turns out well with other horses. Amber has been used around our ranch. She side passes to gates, ground ties, has a nice ground covering walk and is accustomed to cattle, Buffalo, camels, and wildlife. She is good with crazy dogs, blowing tarps, loud gunfire and heavy equipment.

title: Amigo
excerpt: 2016 Welsh Pony Horse Blue Roan Mare 12 Hands
description: He is a Blue Roan Welsh Gelding that stands just at 12 hands. We have owned and enjoyed this pony through many seasons and he is a proven fit for children of varied riding abilities and confidence levels. We have used him as a turnback pony, using pony, lead line pony and just something to tolerate kid shenanigans with or without a saddle. He can lie down when asked, leads respectfully for little children and enjoys being groomed. Amigo has a plucky, friendly personality and stands quietly whether he’s with other horses or all alone. He is gentle enough for a hesitant rider, but has enough life and feel to be enjoyable for a kid who wants to see some country, do a job or ride with a little more speed. He travels smoothly and confidently. He’s seasoned to cattle, sheep, goats, deer, blackbucks, dogs, cats, poultry, heavy equipment, bicycles and more. He’s lived with big horses and small ponies – mares, geldings and stallions – and always gets along fine. Amigo has truly been a sensible, trustworthy and honest pony that we all love. He is strong enough for an adult to step on and ride.

title: Andy
excerpt: 2016 Quarter Horse Red Roan Gelding 14.3 Hands
description: This is One Handsome Andy. His name couldn’t be more fitting. Andy is the entire package! He’s absolutely handmade, gorgeous, and has that soft, kind eye. He rides better than he looks. Anything you want to do horseback, he will be your go to mount. Andy will be gentle for anyone and everyone. Go saddle him up and have some fun. He’s a cowy Andy too. He can hold the toughest cow in the sorting pens and is catty moving and stylish looking holding one from the herd. Andy has been used all over our ranch and is handy in all aspects of ranch work. He has been roped on in the pasture and out of the box. Andy is an elegant mover and very smooth riding. He’s stellar on the trails and will go right where you send him. He’s a super fun and an easy going all around gelding. He’s honest and is the same every time you ride him even with time off. He’s always gentle and has no silly business to him. Andy has been exposed to crazy dogs, loud gunfire, busy traffic, blowing tarps, pigs, buffalo and even a camel. His disposition is the best and he loves attention. He will come running to gate when he sees you. He has a very sweet and inquisitive in your pocket type of personality.

title: Anita
excerpt: 2016 Draft Cross Horse Dapple Grey Mare 16.1 Hands
description: Anita is a 16.1hh, very stout built, Dapple Grey Crossbred mare. She is a big stout built horse that will carry a large rider but is gentle enough to carry any age of rider. She is very versatile from jumping to driving to trail riding she is a one horse do it all type of horse that is gentle for most any rider. She has been trail ridden in several states and she has saw everything possible on the trails. She will cross creeks, ditches, logs and navigate rough rocky areas. She has a very smooth jog and a very nice slow collected lope! She is easy to clip, bath, tack-up, load, handle and will be the first horse to come to you out in the pasture. In addition to riding Anita has also been drove in a hitching cart and does well. On the trails she has been exposed to all kinds of wildlife such as deer or turkey or other animals like cows or dogs and will go anywhere that he is asked too. She has been rode many miles and encountered every obstacle possible on the trail. She will go up or down even the steepest slopes, across deep creeks, over downed trees, and over all types of rough terrain while still being sure footed. Anita is not cinchy, cold backed, does not crib or weave. Anita is a rare find with her size, experience and versatility! Not to mention he is one of the most sought after items in the horse world today… a draftcross with color and brains!

title: Apollo
description: Apollo is a 14.3, Dunskin with a stripe down his back and some stripes on his legs. He is 7 years old and is a very well-built gelding. Apollo has mainly been used as a trail horse and has been camping in several states. We have used him for herding and catching cows. We’ve thrown a rope off of him and pulled a few calves, ridden him through rough country finding strays and he is a good cow horse. When out on the ranch or going down the trails he will cross creeks, ditches, and logs and navigate rough rocky areas. He is safe in traffic safe whether that be trucks or cars. He has a very good handle, neck reins, will one-step lope, slide stops, and backs. He has a nice western pleasure type of jog that is smooth to ride, his lope is slow and easy as well! Apollo is fine for advanced beginners on up to ride. Apollo has been exposed to all kinds of wildlife such as deer or turkey or other animals like cows or dogs and will go anywhere that he is asked to. He has been riding many miles in the mountains of Eastern Kentucky and encountered every obstacle possible on the trail. He will go up or down even the steepest slopes, across deep creeks, over downed trees, and all types of rough terrain while still being sure-footed.

title: April
description: In search of your Heart Horse? A special one that touches your soul and steals your heart. Your search is over, here is your Prince Charming… We have had April since a yearling and he’s never been anywhere else but in our care. He was kind of a late bloomer, but flourished as a four year old. This Gypsy gelding is absolutely ASTONISHING! He is as balanced and correct as you will find in conformation and has a babydoll head. I am extremely proud and personally attached to this handsome boy and he will be a hard one to let go of. April is the most beautiful BUCKSKIN color with four perfectly matched socks and an equally portioned blazed face. He grows a lot of mane and tail, which I have never kept braided and he’s lived outside in our pasture and it doesn’t knot or tangle. He would grow crazy hair if someone wanted to tend to it. April rides like our quarter horses. He’s unbelievably good legged and a gorgeous mover. We have never had a Gypsy Vanner that can lope like this guy. He could lope a circle in the palm of your hand. He has a great jog, beautiful extended trot and a ground covering walk. All is gaits are super smooth and comfortable to ride. From day one and our first ride, April has been nothing but a gentle soul. He is such a people pleaser and so eager to do whatever you ask of him. His transitions between gaits are flawless. He has perfect lead departures and guides willingly and effortlessly wherever you point him. He has a great stop and really knows the word “whoa”, just say it and no matter the situation he will stand like a wooden Indian until asked to move. He has cute spins both directions, an amazing side pass, and a lead change. April has been over all the trail obstacles for years and nothing bothers him. Bridges, log drags, trot over poles, blowing tarps, heavy machining, loud gunfire, etc. he’s accustomed to it all. He will ride the same western, English, bareback, and bridle-less, whatever your gig is, he is game. April is fun in the arena, but he’s a trail riding machine with very sure feet and perfect placement in the boulders and rocks, thick brush, and tight places. He will ground tie where you drop a rein and lead by an ear, so no halter required. He would be a blast to take camping or on mountain rides. He’s confident alone and never looks for a buddy, although he’s everyone’s favorite in the pasture. April is the sweetest boy and a total love bug. He will bond with his person, but loves attention from all. He will try to understand you, and work hard to make you proud of him and accomplish the goals you have for him. He has impeccable ground manners and will stand quietly to mount every single time and ride with zero silly business no matter how much down time he’s had. He is incredibly sane minded and 100% quiet and gentle everyday. And to let the fun continue, April drives! He pulls a cart and the 12ft wagon. He’s a complete natural and took to it like a duck in water. We drove him around our entire property on the very first drive. We drive him down our busy roads and have complete faith in him and again he has a total off switch with just the word “whoa”. He will stand hooked up alone as long as you want. Ride or drive, he is whole bundle of fun! April has been raised around our menagerie and this circus we call life. He has seen it all from camels, buffalo, pigs, raccoons, kangaroos, longhorn cattle, unlimited dogs and so much more. Nothing has ever been an issue throughout his training and he’s taken it all in stride. We have a lot of time, miles, and love invested in him. He’s not just a good one, he’s a great one and we are excited to offer this remarkable Gypsy Vanner gelding we affectionately call, April.

title: Arnold
excerpt: 2017 Quarter Horse Blue Roan Gelding 15.1 Hands
description: They just don’t come any prettier than Arnold. He’s absolutely astonishing! He is a true blue roan, without a red hair on him. Arnold rides just as good as he looks. His natural talent, athletic ability and willing disposition make him the premier package. He runs a nice reining pattern and would excel in the ranch riding classes and ranch versatility. He is a gorgeous mover, huge stopper, easy leaded, and has pretty spins. Arnold is loaded with natural cows which makes him fun to go do a day’s work on. He is handy in the sorting pens and good to go rope one in the pasture. He has also been roped on out of the box and solid on the head side. He can really run, has good timing and plenty of speed. Arnold is easy going and quiet outside on the trails. He will go right where you point him without hesitation. He is good with crazy dogs, busy traffic, loud gunfire, and blowing tarps. Arnold also has a huge personality and is very fun to have around the barn. He’s always gentle and one you will truly enjoy. I believe you would wear a pickup truck out trying to find a gelding with his qualities and as special as he is.

title: Arrow
excerpt: 2015 Quarter Horse Sorrel Rabicano Gelding 15 Hands
description: Arrow is the total package! We absolutely love this kind, honest and sweet gelding. He’s loaded with cow and super fun to cut on and use in the sorting pens. We have used Arrow all over our ranch. He’s the best outside and safe for any level of rider. Always gentle even with long periods of time off. He will ride all over the ranch, through the mud, water tall brush and down the trails on a loose rein. Nothing bothers him and he’s confident alone. Arrow is going solid on the head side in the team roping. He’s really fun and easy to rope on. Always perfect in the box and you can run a lot of steers on him. He leaves flat, runs hard, has perfect rate and timing, a fancy move in the corner and a snappy face. He would be great for any level of roper to go enjoy and have fun on without any silly business. No matter what you want to do horseback, you will enjoy Arrow. Go cut, rope, ranch, show or pleasure ride, he will be your go-to mount. He’s the same every trip and as honest as the day is long. Arrow stands 15 hands and you will love his Rabicano pattern color.

title: Ashanti
description: With the lovable, outgoing personality and laid back disposition- it’s hard not to fall in love with Ashanti. Kid Tested and Mother Approved. The kids have trail ridden and driven Ashanti through the mud, over logs and obstacles. I love how she follows my two year old around like they are the best of friends, always keeping her ears up with a sweet kind eye. She rides and drives off away from the other horses without making a fuss, and will keep up with the big horses if ridden on a group ride. Ashanti has been exposed to about all that a child can show one, and has handled it all in stride. Hop on her bareback with a halter and lead rope, put a saddle on her, or hook her up to the cart. Ashanti has a wonderful personality. If you are looking for a pony for you and your kids to bond with and gain confidence, you can’t go wrong here. She is easy to groom, pick up feet and tack. We would love to tell you more about this once in a lifetime pony, so don’t hesitate to reach out!

title: Austin
description: Hands down one of the most astonishing geldings I have seen… no matter where you take him. You can’t walk by him without a double take. Austin will absolutely melt your heart in every way. You will fall in love with his looks, but wait till you meet him. His big, soft, kind eye says it all. Austin’s personality is second to none. He is accustomed to lots of one-on-one time and is the perfect gentleman in every way. He will eagerly meet you at the gate and loves to be groomed, bathed, and loved on. The best part is riding Austin! He is an absolute blast. He performs all the maneuvers push button and easily. He is one of the easiest lead changers I have ridden. Huge stopper and lopes gorgeous circles on a draped rein. Austin would be a phenomenal ranch rider or versatility contender. He is an outstanding mover and his transitions are flawless. Austin is as safe, quiet and gentle as they come. Leave him off for extended periods of time and catch him, saddle him, and go! Absolutely no silly business to him! He’s pure pleasure and fun! Safe for any level of rider to enjoy and go do anything you want to horseback. Open and shut all the gates, push cattle, sort pairs, and rope one if you need to! Austin is the real deal. Don’t let his Barbie Doll looks fool you. He can work for a living too! He’s talented, athletic, and willing to perform any task, yet cool as a cucumber and simple and easy to ride, all the time! I feel privileged to have owned him and blessed that we have had the chance to have him in our program. Whoever gets him will have a once in a lifetime kinda horse.

title: Avenger
excerpt: 2014 Quarter Horse Red Roan Gelding 15 Hands
description: This gorgeous roan gelding will check all the boxes! Avenger is a been there, done that type of horse. He’s not only a proven performer in the arena, he’s one of the nicest horses we have had to do a days work on the ranch. Avenger is as kind and honest as a day is long. He is always willing to do whatever is asked of him. Whether you want to go cut, rope, rein, cowhorse, ranch, sort, mounted shooting or just trailride, Avenger will make it fun and enjoyable! Here you will have a fierce competitor and yet the sweetest companion all wrapped up in one package. Avenger is 100% gentle and quiet for any level of rider. He will ride up or down to your level and go just as slow or fast as you want. Time off, no problem. He rides the same every trip. He is very smooth and easy to guide. Avenger is super fun to back in the box and head on or drop your hand and he can hold the toughest cow in the cutting. Go slide to a stop, spin like a top or change leads, he does all that fun stuff too. If you want an extremely well trained and fun everyday type of horse with no nonsense, check out this phenomenal gelding.

title: Bailey
excerpt: 2016 Quarter Horse Red Roan Gelding 15 Hands
description: Go cut a cow, rope a steer, run a reining pattern, do all the ranch chores or pleasure ride, Bailey will be your number one go-to mount every time. No matter the job or task at hand, this gorgeous roan gelding will be your best partner! As cowboy looking as he is, he doesn’t require a cowboy to ride him. He’s honest and safe for any level of rider and always gentle to saddle and go even with substantial time off. Which makes him super handy in the sorting pens and fun to use on the ranch. You can rope a steer in the pasture, step off and he will hold strong from the horn and work the rope. He willingly side passes to open all the gates and stands quietly ground tied if needed. Bailey has fancy spins, long stops and easy lead changes. He would make an exceptional show horse in the Cowhorse events, Ranch Versatility competition and stockhorse shows. Nothing bothers this guy. He’s been exposed to crazy dogs, loud gunfire, blowing tarps, noisy traffic, heavy machinery, and everything else on our busy ranch. Bailey is great outside and enjoys leisurely cruising down the trails. He’s confident alone and will go right where you point him. His disposition is spot on and you will love his kind personality. Here is a top notch gelding that checks all the boxes.

title: Bandera
excerpt: 2016 Spotted Saddle Horse Black Tobiano Gelding 15.2 Hands
description: Bandera is a Spotted Saddle Horse Gelding. Standing at 15’2hh and built like a tank, he is suitable for any sized rider. If you’re looking for a nice gelding that is easy enough for the babies to ride, or take out and enjoy yourself, Bandera is your guy. There are not many horses I would ever consider “Kid Broke” but Bandera is the closest thing I have ever had to a true unicorn. He has all the heart in the world, or will sit and walk on a loose rein all day until asked to pick up. Bandera has a nice slow gait, or can pick up and travel down the road smoothly around 15mph. Don’t let that scare you, because he will settle right down and walk all day if that is what he is asked. He will stand for mounting, to be tacked, bathed or shod. We have shot guns, and exposed Bandera to all kinds of crazy stuff. There isn’t much that bothers this guy. Bandera has crossed any creek, log and ditch we have put in front of him, without any hesitation. He does not mind standing on a picket line for overnight camping trips, or will stand tied to the trailer next to other horses like a gentleman. This guy rides perfectly in big groups as large as 30 or out alone; front, middle or in the back he is aimed to please his rider. We have ridden Bandera around large farm equipment, ATV”s, dirtbikes, side-by-sides, tarps, leaf blowers and chainsaws and he was not phased. Bandera is suitable for any level rider, and is truly a once in a lifetime horse.

title: Bandit
excerpt: 2017 Quarter Horse Red Roan Gelding 14.3 Hands
description: Cowboy looking red roan that is built like a bulldog! Bandit is Gentle! Gentle! Gentle! We have done a little bit of everything on this cool gelding. He takes it all in stride. He is eager and willing to go do a days work or just leisurely cruise down the trail. This gelding has been extremely easy and receptive to train and doesn’t have a mean bone in his body. You can back him in the box and rope steers all day or rope and doctor one in the pasture and he will work the rope and hold strong from the horn. Bandit stays cool, calm and collected. He is uncomplicated to ride and point and go style. He’s been ridden in rough country catching wild cows as well as along a busy highway with loud, constant traffic. Bandit is fancy enough for the ranch foreman, handy for a day working cowboy, honest for weekend roper or solid for someone just wanting a really nice pleasure horse. He is the same every trip and doesn’t need daily riding to stay trained.

title: Banjo
excerpt: 2016 Rocky Mountain Horse Chocolate Gelding 15.1 Hands
description: Let me introduce you to Banjo, the brokest, safest & most unique Rocky Mountain we have had to offer! This is Banjo. He stands 15.1 and will weigh 1100lbs. He is beautiful in his dark chocolate color with a golden streak mane and tail! Banjo is truly special in his own way. Not only does he have the color and conformation everyone is looking for, but he also has the kindest disposition to make someone a forever dream horse! Banjo has spent numerous hours on trails, field trials & fun shows. You can ride Banjo with a bridle or bridle-less, loose rein or tight rein; it doesn’t matter. He has been ridden by beginners & trained by professionals. Being trained by professionals, he will neck rein one handed, canter on correct leads and back on command. Responds to leg cues. Stands to be mounted and dismounted on the ground or a mounting block. Does Banjo do tricks? Oh yes he does! Banjo will count, march & bow on command. While being on numerous and countless hours on the trails. Banjo has seen it all and done it all. He will cross logs, water and ditches quietly and safely. He will travel up and down hills at a safe pace and comfort for the rider. He is traffic safe as well! He has been used to pony other horses around the camps at trail rides & used to give the beginners lessons! While all this is important to all equine enthusiasts, I think the most important is that he is SAFE! Banjo is an all around family horse. From kids to any aged adult, Banjo takes care of his rider. He can be trusted to ride with a group, or ride out alone with no issues. Banjo stands to be saddled, bridled and groomed! Picks up all of his feet with ease and stands for the farrier. With this being said, Banjo is truly one of a kind. He is seasoned and pure in all aspects. If you’re looking for your next dream trail mount or confidence builder, look no further.

title: Barbaro
description: Barbaro is a barn fav, smart, athletic, gentle, all around extremely easygoing gelding. He’s very willing/eager to please his person. He has 3 balanced, huge, floating gaits that will get you noticed in any under saddle class and has no problem getting down the lines in any competition. Barbaro checks all the boxes to make an incredible 3 ringer. Accompanied with his looks, 10++ movement and bloodlines to prove it. He is a true sport horse. Barbaro is currently and will be in consistent training by myself and trainer until sold. He is 110% sound in every way and has never taken an off step in his whole career. Barbaro is absolutely capable of the 1.50 meters and is consistently schooled up to 3ft at home. Showing PLENTY of scope and athleticism for much much more.

title: Bashiru
description: Bashiru has been an extraordinary horse ever since we bought him as a three year old.. Bashiru had an incredible mind from the start. Alice started riding Bashiru in front of Alice when she was 1 year old. When Alice was ready to start riding on her own, Bashiru was the obvious choice. He took care of Alice from the first ride on, & as her riding skills progressed Bashiru has become more responsive to Alice, while still being very responsive to an experienced rider. Bashiru has never done one thing that concerned us of Alice’s safety. Bashiru can be laid off for months & he always catches up broke, soft & responsive. Bashiru is not lazy, he is incredibly gentle, super minded, & performs to the level of his riders ability. He has an incredible walk, & is smooth in all gates. Alice has ridden him on 4/ 20 mile cattle drives, as well as doing a lot of cattle work in & out of the pens, plus many shorter drives. The video’s of Bashiru says much more than I can ever communicate in words. The video is an absolutely honest picture of what Bashiru is. . He has been exposed to everything; Alice has ridden Bashiru doing ranch work, crossing rivers, wild life, deadfall timber, highway traffic, ridden all over town, ridden at night, ridden among loose horses, & even a 5 yr old can pony horses off of him, you name it Bashiru has been exposed to it with Alice riding him… Bashiru rides in either a bit or hackamore, good to catch anywhere, even in a herd of horses without grain. He will move off your leg for side passing & to open gates. Bashiru is an easy keeper, & has never coliced. If you are wanting a horse to teach your small child to ride so that you don’t have to worry about your child’s safety, plus something Mom or Dad can also enjoy riding , we encourage you to come & ride Bashiru, for a few hours or a couple of days. We are very proud to offer this beautiful gelding for sale to someone who will give him a great home, & hopefully teach some young children the total confidence & riding skills that he has taught our Daughter the last three years.

title: Baylee
excerpt: 2015 Quarter Horse Bay Roan Gelding 15 Hands
description: Here is the complete package! This stunning bay roan gelding checks all the boxes! You won’t find a more kind, honest, and sweeter gelding than Baylee! Whatever you want to do horseback, this will be your guy! Wether you need to do a day’s work or just ride to the mailbox, you will enjoy riding Baylee. He is gentle and safe for anyone and everyone! Great horse to gain confidence for a timid rider. He will ride up or down to whatever speed you desire. Baylee cuts a cow and is super handy to use for gathering and sorting. He easily side passes to gates and quietly stands while you open and close them. He rides great outside and is confident alone. He goes right where you send him without hesitation and is steady in all types of terrain. We have roped on him in and outside of the arena. Baylee is cool as a cucumber in all situations and circumstances. He is super smooth and comfortable to ride. He will eagerly meet you and the gate and is very quiet and gentle to handle. Standing 15 hands, it’s hard to find one with his breeding that has his shape and size.

title: Beamer
description: Look no further if you are wanting that “once in a lifetime” kind of gelding! Beamer will definitely check at box! He’s BUCKSKIN and an own son of leading sire, One Time Pepto! This gorgeous gelding is as pretty as a picture, conformationally balanced and correct. His soft, kind eye will steal your heart and his sweet and loving personality is second to none. Beamer will do it all. If you only have a one horse trailer, he will be your go to every time. He is extremely versatile and well rounded. Beamer has an accomplished record in the AQHA earning 48 points. He has open points in Reining, Ranch Riding, Ranch Versatility, Conformation, Cowhorse, and Cutting! Such a talented and proven gelding that does it all! He does all reining and cowhorse maneuvers easily, with effortless lead changes, cute spins and deep sliding stops. He guides easily and is very simple to pilot. He will really shine in the Ranch Riding & Versatility events. Beamer is very cowy and fun to work out of the herd. He is handy in the sorting pens and makes a day’s work enjoyable. He is good to rope steers on and makes your job easy. We have used him all over our Texas ranch and also have ridden him on countless rides in the Arizona desert. Beamer is safe and sane for any level of rider. He is very smooth and comfortable to ride. He remains extremely gentle even with substantial time off. He is one that you can saddle up and go enjoy without hesitation. There is no silly stuff to him and he remains the same every ride. Beamer will meet you at the gate and is always easy and eager to be caught. He is a very willing partner that aims to please. Beamer is a phenomenal gelding with all the bells and whistles!

title: Bear
description: America’s Favorite Color and one of our personal all time favorites! As pretty of Buckskin as you will find. Bear is a head turner anywhere you take him and he will go do anything you want to horseback! Bear is solid and jackpot ready on the head side. He stands like a wooden Indian in the box, has plenty of run and great rate. He has a fancy move on the corner and faces easily. Bear will makes lots of runs and put you in the same spot each time. He is super easy to rope on for a lower numbered roper. Bear was originally trained in the reining pen and will perform all the maneuvers. Pretty spins, easy lead changes and will ride around on a draped rein. Would make an exceptional all around horse in the Ranch Versatility, Ranch Riding, Roping, and Cowhorse events with unlimited ability and one to definitely catch the judges eye! Bear has been ridden tons of outside miles and will go right where you point him. Bear is a great ranch horse and would make the Ranch Owner or Foreman a top mount and the fanciest you can find. He is very cowy, great in the sorting pens, has been roped on in the pasture and will work a rope. Bear is always gentle and super quiet even with time off. He has a solid mind and sweet disposition. He is super smooth and comfortable to ride for any level of rider. He is great with gunfire and has been taken around some of the mounted shooting patterns too! Bear is the total package! You will love his looks, disposition and the way he rides, along with a black-type Performance pedigree.

title: Beauregard
excerpt: 2014 Spotted Saddle Horse Chocolate Tobiano Gelding 15.2 Hands
description:
Beauregard is a very in your pocket horse and will follow you around like a dog. Easy to catch, handles the best and loves to be petted on. Beauregard is great for the farrier, easy to clip and bathe as well. Stands still to be saddled, bridled and mounted. Beauregard would be a great horse for any level of rider. He will dog walk along all day if you let him. But he will move on out and gait or lope as well. He is very good gaited and very natural. He also has a great canter. He can lope circles and pick his leads up. Beauregard will neck rein around the best, rides off your legs, has a great woa and a good reverse.
\nBeauregard is virtually spook free. Point him and he will go. Ride him down the busiest street in town or drop off over a rock bluff and know you are in safe hands. Beauregard crosses all types of water, slippery rocks and fallen trees. He is traffic safe and great around farm equipment. He has also spent a many days checking cows and other livestock so he is definitely livestock safe as well as wildlife. If you are looking for a big pretty gelding that is sure enough gentle for the whole family Beauregard just may be your man! Please feel free to call or text me with any questions

title: Beauty
description: Did someone say ASTONISHING?! Here she is, the prettiest blonde in town! Those dapples, Snow White mane and tail, and exquisite conformation make Beauty a show girl! Beauty is pretty much picture perfect, but don’t let those looks fool you, she rides absolutely splendid. 100% gentle and easy! This gal has it all going for her! Trained in the Reining and Ranch Riding she would be fun to go show in multiple western events including western dressage! Plus she absolutely looks fantastic cruising around in English gear! She is so much fun and very adaptive! Beauty has all the fancy arena maneuvers with a showy spin, smooth sliding stop, easy lead changes, a solid side pass both directions and she is great over logs, the bridge, and pulling a drag. Beauty is a gorgeous mover with a beautiful long trot, smooth jog and a wonderful lope on a draped rein that you will crave! Her graceful and stylish way of getting around demands attention and it’s hard not to look twice at her. Boy she’s a pretty one! Beauty is always a happy go lucky kinda girl. She’s a people pleaser and loves affection. She just wants to get along and do what is asked of her. She is fun and easy going in and out of the arena. Beauty loves to go on a nice trail ride or leisurely cruise down the road. She’s a brave old soul and nothing bothers her. She is outstanding with heavy traffic, crazy dogs, blowing tarps, heavy machinery, and loud gunfire. Beauty is genuinely considerate, honest and kind with her ground manners and the same to ride. She is a pleasure to own and does not have marish tendencies. Standing 14.3 hands and stamped with the right color her bloodlines, disposition, and trainability make her an excellent future broodmare! Beauty will easily excel any direction you want to go.

title: Bello
description: Bello is absolutely the coolest little horse that you will find. Don’t let his size fool you. He has had a jillion cattle roped, doctored and sorted on him. He will go all day and never quit you in any situation. He is extremely easy to ride and so all the reining maneuvers on. Effortless lead changes, fast spins, and long sliding stops. Bello has been shown in the ranch versatility and stock horse events. He will go right where you point him and no situation bothers him. He’s very smooth with a rocking chair lope on a draped rein, nice little jog, ground covering walk and neck reins easily. Always gentle to saddle up and go! Whether you want to show in the ranch horse events, rope either end in the arena, pleasure ride or use on the ranch, check out this gorgeous gelding. He’s fun, versatile, and one you will be proud to own. Bello stands 14.2 hands.

title: Benny
excerpt: 2017 Dutch Warmblood Gelding Chestnut Gelding 16.1 Hands
description: Benny is an exceptional chestnut with good jump, enough scope and of a perfect nature. Willing to work and learn new things, not looky or spooky, very brave on the jump, nice and comfortable to ride, easy to ride in the trail and easy to handle. Vetted recently, no bad habits. Lovely charismatic young horse with super jumping ability and great potential for the future. Excellent canter and good flying changes. Very careful and never wants to make a mistake. He is good with the farrier, travels well in a truck and has proved to be good to clip. He is very intelligent to ride and adapting to his work very quickly.

title: Biggy (Bugsy)
description: Hands down one of our all time favorites! Biggy is the absolute best and he just happens to be America’s favorite color, Buckskin! This fun sized gelding is as wide as he is tall, standing 14.2 hands, don’t let his size fool you. He can do anything the big boys can. Biggy is so versatile! He ropes, reins, cuts, ranches, and trail rides and does it all outstanding! Happy and willing to do anything you want to do horseback this gelding has the most charming personality and never has a bad day. Biggy comes puppy dog gentle with exquisite ground manners and will ride quiet and safe for kids, grandmas, and beginner riders. He never tries to outthink you and just wants to get along. He’s a great insurance policy for a timid, uncertain or unconfident rider, yet has the tools and ability to step up and get any job done you are cowboy enough to handle. He will go as slow or fast as you ask and does have an off bottom. You can cut a cow on Biggy blindfolded. He’s been used all over the ranch to gather and sort cattle. He’s extra fun in the sorting pens. Biggy has been roped on in the arena and in the pasture. He’s a solid heel horse that is ready to haul. He would also make an phenomenal break away horse as well. He can really stop deep and strong. He’s perfect in the box and easy to rope on. Biggy is a very handy and useful ranch horse. He ground ties where you drop a rein and will easily side pass to open and shut all the gates. He has a fancy handle and good neck rein. He’s simple and easy to operate. No tricks or funny business. He’s smooth and comfortable to ride as well. He goes right where you point him and is eager to do so. He never says no. Everyone that comes to the ranch loves with this guy. He’s a one stop shop for even the most discriminating buyers. Biggy will not disappoint and we give him an A+ across the entire board. We are very proud to offer this once in a lifetime kind of gelding.

title: Billy
description: Worth his weight in gold! You will have to come meet Billy! He is truly a one of a kind. This amazing gelding didn’t get any steps skipped in his training and his foundation is rock solid. From the beginning he has been a superstar. He’s extremely competitive in all Versatility classes, Cutting, Cowhorse, Trail, Halter, Reining, and pleasure. He has been ridden countless miles outside and used all over the ranch. I have trail ridden him all over the desert and he’s great in all types of terrain. Billy will ride for anyone and everyone. He is the same every trip and stays very gentle even with extended time off. He is safe, dependable and requires zero maintenance. Measuring the perfect size of 14.2, he is easy to mount and dismount. He stays that gorgeous golden color and his conformation is flawless. He is very balanced and has the kindest eye. Here is a once in a lifetime partner that checks all the boxes. You will only need a one horse trailer because no matter what you want to do, Billy will be your man.

title: Biscuit
description: You will want to check out Biscuit! This sweet, versatile gelding can do it all! Cowhorse, roping, reining, ranch work, trails, fun tricks, and has that “old soul” disposition. Biscuit is absolutely 100% gentle for any level of rider. He doesn’t require consistent riding and is the same steady eddy every time he is saddled. He loves attention and will meet you at the gate. Biscuit is such a handsome boy with that stunning palomino color and super long, flowing Snow White mane and tail. Biscuit has been shown in the cow horse events and would make a great all-around, ranch Versatility performance horse. He does all the reining maneuvers with an easy lead change, huge stop, and stylish spins. Biscuit loves to work cows and has a great rate whether you are going down the fence or going to rope one. He has been heeled on and roped calves. He will hold strong from the horn and work a rope. He has seen all types of scenery and landscapes. Nothing bothers him out on the trails and he goes right where you point him without hesitation. Through the running water, thick mud, dense brush, prickly cactus, mountainous terrain, and wide open pastures, he is confident alone or great with a group. Biscuit is great to use out on the ranch and in the arena. He will side pass to all the gates, ground tie, pony colts, and do just about anything you ask of him. He’s a willing partner no matter the task. Biscuit is a fun horse to own and ride in every aspect. He doesn’t have a mean bone in his body and loves any type of attention. Standing 14.2 hands, he may not be the biggest horse in the barn, but has a heart.

title: Bishop
description: Absolutely gorgeous in every way. Bishop has the color and conformation that you look for. He has a soft kind eye, pretty head, good withers and a huge hip. Bishop is as gentle and easy going of a gelding that you will find. He stays quiet and gentle with little riding or time off. If you can hold his reins, you can ride him. He is honest and forgiving. He is great outside and nothing bothers him. He’s good around busy traffic, loud gunfire, blowing tarps, and crazy dogs. He has been ridden lots of outside miles and will go right where you send him without any hesitation. Bishop has a reining handle with a big stop, lots of turnaround and lopes very comfortable and quiet on a loose rein. He has been ridden in parades and used on the movie sets. He has seen a lot and is a been there done that type of horse. We have used him all over our ranch. He has worked an unlimited amount of cattle and is great in the pens. He has been roped on outside and out of the box. You will fall in love with Bishop’s kind and sweet disposition. He will meet you at the gate and is willing to do any task you throw his way.

title: Blaze
excerpt: 2016 Spotted Saddle Horse Black Tobiano Gelding 15.1 Hands
description: We have trail rode him many miles and took him on several camping trips. We have spent countless hours with him to make this young man into something truly special. You name it and he can do it!! He lays down, steps over to mounting block and even parks out to be mounted. He will also do other tricks like bowing and sitting. Blaze has had a lot of ground work and is very respectful but at the same time very in your pocket. He will give off both his hindquarters and shoulders. He is extremely good gaited and very very smooth! Has a to die for canter. He will lope circles, pick up both his leads and will lope as slow as you want to go. It’s like riding a QH that just happens to gait. He will neck rein around, has a great woa and reverse. Side passes both directions. You can open gates off him, rope off him, shoot off him seriously you name it and you can do it! He has great manners in the cross ties or being tied out. You can tie him to anything and leave him and not worry. He will also stand tied at picket line and respects an electric fence. Blaze handles like a big puppy. You can rub all over him and he will give you love right back. He loves being groomed on and loves baths. Is great with his feet and perfect for the farrier. Stands dead still to be saddled and drops his head to be bridled. Blaze will always ride off slow and easy no matter if you haven’t rode him for weeks at a time. He rides out with or without company. Rides anywhere in a group as well without getting excited. He is a phenomenal trail horse and will go absolutely anywhere you point him. He will ease up and down the roughest, steepest terrain always taking his time and watching his footing. He crosses all types of water, slippery rocks and fallen trees. We have checked cows off him and even pasture roped a couples calves off him. He is great around wildlife as well. 100% traffic safe! Great around atvs, motorcycles and bicycles. All I can say is if you want the nicest Gaited Spotted gelding out there here is your opportunity because they don’t come like him but once in a lifetime he seriously has it all from his looks, brain and ability.

title: Blue
excerpt: 2016 Tennessee Walking Horse True Blue Roan Gelding 16 Hands
description: He’s not a tornado, he’s not a hurricane, this Blue is even more rare than those… Blue is a 16hh, True Blue Roan Gelding!!! He is a registered Tennessee Walking Horse and has a good pedigree. Blue has had professional training and he neckreins, slide stops, backs, bows down and lays down. Blue is easy to catch, clip, bath, tack-up, load, and handle in anyway. Blue is safe for beginners to ride and he has been trail ridden by our 8 year old boy. Blue has a very smooth and natural 4-beat gait all the way up to 12mph with a nice lope. He moves out easily and will also walk quietly on a loose rein as long as you like. He has been ridden around farm equipment, ATV’s, over large noisy tarps and has also had guns shot off of his back. No matter where he goes or what he does, Blue is not spooky acting. On the trails he is always great! Blue has been exposed to all kinds of wildlife such as deer or turkey or other animals like cows or dogs and will go anywhere that he is asked too. He has been rode many miles in the mountains and encountered every obstacle possible on the trail. He will go up or down even the steepest slopes, across deep creeks, over downed trees, and over all types of rough terrain while still being sure footed. He has been rode in traffic and is safe around cars and trucks. He has a great attitude and an easy going personality. Here is a Blue that you will not want to miss!!!

title: Bolt
excerpt: 2015 Quarter Horse Blue Roan Gelding 15.2 Hands
description: Bolt is a 15.2hh Quarter Horse gelding that is a true dream. When out on the ranch or going down the trails he will cross creeks, ditches, and logs and navigate rough rocky areas. He is safe in traffic safe whether that be trucks or cars. He has a very good handle, and neck reins, will lope from a standstill, and slide stops and backs. He has a nice jog that is smooth to ride and a very good lope! Bolt is fine for beginners to ride. Bolt has been exposed to all kinds of wildlife such as deer or turkey or other animals like cows or dogs and will go anywhere that he is asked to. He has been extensive trail experience and encountered every obstacle possible on the trail. He will go up or down even the steepest slopes, across deep creeks, over downed trees, and all types of rough terrain while still being sure-footed. Bolt will be one of the prettiest, friendliest and nicest blue roan horses that you will ever have the chance to buy! Feel free to call me with any questions!

title: Bonito
excerpt: 2017 Tennessee Walking Horse Black Tobiano Gelding 16 Hands
description: Bones is a 16hh, 8 yr old, Black Tobiano Gelding! Bones has been camping in multiple states, trail ridden at large campgrounds such as Big South Fork and The Land Between The Lakes. He has also made several trips to the semi-annual Knot County ride here in Kentucky and has shown at local fun shows. Bones is easy to catch, clip, bath, tack-up, load, and handle. He is a laid back, gentle type of horse. He will flatfoot walk on a loose rein and will move on out when asked. He has a natural smooth 4 beat gait that covers the ground with ease. No matter where he goes or what he does, Bones is not spooky acting. On the trails he is always great! He has been exposed to all kinds of wildlife such as deer or turkey or other animals like cows or dogs and will go anywhere that he is asked too. He has been rode many miles and encountered every obstacle possible on the trail. He will go up or down even the steepest slopes, across deep creeks, over downed trees, and over all types of rough terrain while still being sure footed. He has been rode in traffic, and is very traffic safe around cars, semi, log, and dump trucks. He has a great personality and a great attitude about whatever he is asked to do.

title: Boomer
excerpt: 2015 Quarter Horse Red Roan Gelding 15 Hands
description: Check out this sale highlight! Boomer is the complete package. He has the look, the right color, a black-type pedigree and the ability and talent to to anything you want to horseback. He is out of an own daughter of…. Boomer is definitely a product of good bloodlines. He is extremely athletic, balanced and has a really fancy style. He is quick footed, cow smart and fun to go cut on or use in the sorting pens.

title: Boris
excerpt: 2015 Gypsy Vanner Black Tobiano Gelding 14.3 Hands
description: Ride & Drive in fashion! Total WOW factor on his handsome gentleman with a long flowing mane past his knees! Boris is such a gentle soul with the sweetest in your pocket type personality. He has been ridden both English and western, but also is amazing to ride bareback. He’s very smooth and easy going. Boris is a trail riding machine and is as comfortable as sitting on the couch cruising down the trails. He’s very sure footed and gets around like a mountain goat. He’s a brave partner that will go through running water, mountainous terrain and navigates easily around the prickly pear cactus. He’s confident alone, but can lead or follow a group. He doesn’t mind his position. Boris is fun to ride in the arena. He has a desirable jog, extended trot, and sweet and slow rocking chair lope. He side passes, ground ties, and will go over all the trail obstacles with ease. He has a one handed neck rein and guides easily. Boris is safe, safe, safe for any level of rider. He’s a great confidence builder for a timid or new rider. Always reassuring his rider that we got this together. Boris drives good as well. He stands quiet and patient while being harnessed up and is accustomed and confident pulling a 10ft wagon. He would look fabulous going down the hometown parade or in a wedding venue. Standing 14.3 hands, Boris is easy to mount and dismount. He stands still for a mounting block or will lie down with a touch of a finger so you can mount up and go. Boris loves attention and the little girls will go crazy over his tremendous mane! His ground manners are impeccable and he is as honest as they come to ride and handle in every way. Boris is good with other horses and will follow you around in the pasture wanting attention. He will drop his head to the ground so the littlest of kiddos can halter him. Boris has been so much fun to own and I’m very excited to offer him. We love this marvelous gelding and look forward to him getting his forever home.

title: Boss
description: He is 3/4 Dutch Harness, 1/4 Percheron and stands 17 hands high. This big guy has endless athleticism and willingness. This guy is a ham; he is a people person! He has been lightly schooled over preliminary sized fences and has potential for upper level dressage as well. Boss also has many miles on hunter paces and paper chases. He is sporty and careful, but quiet and sane in the excitement.

title: Bourbon
description: Guaranteed to hit the Bourbon on a safe insurance policy that is a gorgeous, very well trained individual that will insure your well being and enjoyment horseback. Bourbon is worth his weight in gold. We love this calm, easy-going, kind hearted gelding. His glamorous golden color, soft brown eyes and balanced conformation will capture your attention, but his disposition will win your heart. He will pack any level of rider giving the confidence and assurance of being horseback. He performs all maneuvers with ease. He has effortless lead changes, pretty spins and long stops. His transitions are flawless and he has a smooth slow lope and a nice, comfortable pitter-patter jog. Bourbon willing guides wherever you point him on the trails and has been ridden in lots of different types of terrain. We have used him all over our ranch. He side passes to open and shut all the gates, moves cattle quietly, is good to sort in the pens and easy to rope off of if needed. He walks quietly on a loose rein and is confident alone. He doesn’t require steady riding. Catch him once a month and go have fun. You will have the same horse you rode the previous ride. He stays trained and gentle. Bourbon will make you look forward to going to the barn and you will appreciate this kind soul every time you saddle him up. He will truly be an asset for so many people. This kind of gelding just doesn’t come around everyday.

title: Breeze
description: As black as your felt hat, with a ton of bone and body making Breeze one that will get you noticed. This handsome gelding has an incredible personality and is simply a fun horse in every way. Breeze is always a perfect gentleman on the ground and on his back. He is as kind and honest as the day is long. He is always ready and willing to do anything you ask of him. He is smooth, consistent, and pushes buttons in all maneuvers. He is simple, easy and can be piloted by any level of rider. He has automatic lead changes, correct and stylish spins and long, pretty stops. He cruises around like he is on autopilot and has spot-on speed control. Just think “whoa” and he has an automatic “off” switch. Breeze is always very safe, quiet-minded, and will give you a nice, relaxing ride. He loves trail riding and is very point-and-go. No silly business to him. He is great in all terrain and nothing rattles his cage. His mellow and good-natured demeanor makes him a great confidence builder and great for a beginner rider. Breeze is solid on the head side and ready to haul. He is perfect in the box, runs flat to steer, and is very easy to handle. He would work for any level of roper. He gives you the same shot every trip and you can run lots of steers on him. Breeze is super handy to have around the ranch and is always your right-hand man if you need to get a job done. He will work a rope and hold strong from the horn, easily side pass to open and shut all the gates, and has a nice ground covering walk. There is no gamble here on this super nice individual. He is the real deal.

title: Broli
description:
Drop dead gorgeous defines this picture perfect Buckskin gelding! Broli is America’s favorite color and stands out with his stunning blue eyes and plenty of chrome on his face and legs. He always has a winning personality and has the kindest disposition. Broli is safe and easy for any level of rider to go do anything you want to do horseback. He is easy on the eyes and so much fun to ride! He has nice spins, an excellent lead change, and a smooth sliding stop. He is an elegant mover and would be fun to go show in the reining, ranch riding, and AQHA versatility classes. He has a dreamy slow lope, a jog that you can sit all day, and a gorgeous ground covering long trot. His fancy looks and classy style will definitely get you noticed in the show pen. Broli has been roped on in the arena and out in the pasture. He’s been started on both ends team roping and shows a promising future if someone wanted to take him that direction. He is good in the box, rates nicely, has plenty of speed and is overall easy to rope on.
\nBroli is phenomenal on the trails and enjoys a nice relaxing cruise down the road or throughout the countryside. He has great stamina and will truck along all day alone or with friends. Just point and go, he crosses water, logs, bridges and navigates quietly through the cactus and mountainous terrain. He’s accustomed to busy traffic, motorcycles, bicycles, blowing tarps, crazy dogs, heavy machinery, and loud gunfire. Broli is a stand out type of gelding that is multitalented, safe and gentle, and absolutely astonishing! He is exactly the type of horse that we love to have at our ranch.

title: Bruce Lee
excerpt: 2016 Paint Horse Sorrel Overo Gelding 15 Hands
description: He is 15 hands tall, very stout built . Bruce Lee came into our lives and has a been a pleasure to everyone that has crossed his path. He is a versatile kind gelding with a great disposition. Bruce Lee rides quietly on a loose rein and only gives what you ask for. My husband can go pasture rope off him then turn around and put a little kid on him to push steers, then I could go check cows with my 10 month old son aboard. You can carry the flag on him and haul to the horse shows with no issues. Bruce Lee can be used for grand entries as he carries the American flag with pride and isn’t scared of any types of loud speakers or crowds. Bruce Lee has a one hand neck rein and easy transitions between gaits. He has a nice walk, a very smooth jog and will lope super slow and collected. He will cross water, logs and wildlife does not bother him. The ONLY reason Bruce Lee became available is being able to purchase a road pony to show. He is an easy keeper, simple to catch, trailer and load. He is used to Traffic, farm equipment, dogs, the business of horse shows. He stands quietly when tied. Does not crib or weave. Not cinchy. Sound and ready to go. This is everyone’s dream horse and we hope to make your dream come true.

title: Bubblegum
description: Holey Smokes!!! You will have to see him to believe him! If you want the fanciest POA in the county, here he is! Bubblegum is a lot of horse in a little package! He is the real deal! Totally gentle, quiet and bombproof. You can shoot the gun on him, drag the tarps, jump the dogs in the saddle, rope a steer and run a reining pattern. If you need to jump a log or sort a cow, he’s good there too!

title: Bucky
description: This one is Gorgeous, Grulla and Gentle! You won’t find one quite like Bucky on every street corner. This big, strong made gelding is a showstopper with his flawless looks, big kind eye, and silver color. His disposition is the absolute sweetest. He’s a lover boy through and through. He will lower his head into your chest for hugs and rubs. Bucky wants to do no wrong and is a people pleaser. He is so enjoyable to ride in and out of the arena. With a great reining foundation he has perfect lead departures, pretty spins, an easy lead change, good side pass, and a deep stop. He has the most comfortable jog and smooth, slow lope. He has a great extended trot and looks really fancy going around the arena! He would definitely get you noticed in the show pen and would excel in Ranch Riding, Ranch Trail, and Rail or western dressage. You don’t ever have to worry about Bucky doing anything silly or malicious. He’s always been kind, quiet and safe. Even with months off he’s always gentle to saddle, mount up and go. Bucky is the best outside. He’s not spooky or watchy in any way and absolutely amazing to cruise down the trails. He is confident alone and will walk back to the barn on a draped rein. Bucky is a hand around the ranch as well. He’s fun to gather pastures, sort cattle and can hold anything your cowboy/cowgirl enough to rope. He will side pass up to all the gates, ground tie where you drop a rein and lay down with a touch of the finger to mount. Bucky is very easy to catch in the pasture, his ground manners are perfect, and he is simple and easy to own. His unique color is just a bonus!

title: Buzz
description: Buzz is big, measuring 15.3 hands, very pretty, and America’s favorite color, BUCKSKIN! Buzz has been there and done that. He’s been ridden extensively in the mountains in New Mexico, used for gathering big pastures and knows what a wet saddle pad is all about. Buzz is solid on the end of a rope whether it be out on the ranch or backed in head side box in the arena. Buzz is extremely quiet in the box, scores great, leaves flat, easy to ride and rates steers great. Buzz could pull an elephant if you roped it. Buzz represents what a true ranch horse should be like. He’s stout, strong and willing to do a day’s work and has the endurance as well. Buzz has always been quiet, gentle and easy to handle. Buzz doesn’t have a mean bone in his body and wants to get along. Buzz is sure footed and will go right where to point him. He ground ties, easily maneuvers to open all the gates, fine with crazy dogs, wild buffalo and blowing tarps. If you want to ranch, rope or just pleasure ride you will enjoy Buzz each time you saddle him.

title: Calypso
description: TRICKS, Reining, Trails, Roping, Gentle, Fancy!! Want something different that will turn heads anywhere you go? Look at this handsome guy! Calypso is a Gypsy Vanner who will run a Reining pattern, rope, trail ride, and do all kinds of fun tricks. Go show him or pleasure ride him, you will have one of a kind. Hair forever and as black as your hat! Calypso has been a blast to own and easy to train. Athletic and has speed when asked. Willing attitude stays gentle, and is just fun to have in the barn! Good with other horses and will ride in a group or solo outside. 14.2 hands

title: Captain
excerpt: 2016 Friesian x Morgan Bay Gelding 16 Hands
description: Meet Captain!! This spectacular Fresian x Morgan cross gelding stands 16H tall. Captain not only rides like a dream, but he is broke to drive nice as well! Here is one you don’t want to miss !!!! If you’re a beginner, Captain will teach you. If you’re experienced, Captain is ready to go to work for you!! Captain is the most patient horse I’ve ever seen and he does all he can to please YOU and then some!!! He is a point-and-go, bomb-proof, honest, and obedient as they come and he is definitely a “once in a lifetime” gelding. He is completely traffic-safe and a true gentleman all around. Captain is also a trail horse deluxe … he crosses water and logs, and there is no hill too steep for him to climb. You can rope on him, drive him to town, ride him in parades, etc. Anything you want to do, Captain is up for it! ………We raised and trained Captain and he was a natural from the START!! Be sure to watch the whole video because he speaks for himself. You will wear out a new pickup truck trying to find another one like him because nowadays you’re just not going to! For more info about Captain, please feel free to email me with any questions anytime!.

title: Carson
description: Meet our real life unicorn and he’s America’s favorite color, BUCKSKIN! Carson is the kind of horse people dream about owning! He is highly trained in the arena, a total dream on the trails, a handy partner on the ranch, safe for the entire family, and as a bonus trained to drive a wagon! He comes running to greet you in the pasture and will follow you around the barn eager for attention.

title: Casanova
excerpt: 2016 Paint Horse Buckskin Tobiano Gelding 14.3 Hands
description: Take a look into Casanova’s soft, kind eye and he will have you swayed. This sweet boy is as honest as the day is long and if your top priority is safety, he will be your number one go to. 100% family, kid, grandma, husband tried, tested, passed and approved! Casanova is utterly adorable in every way possible! He’s is so unique with his tobiano patterned Buckskin body with white splashes! standing 14.3 hands he is conformationally correct and very balanced. Casanova wants to be everyone’s buddy and he doesn’t meet a stranger as if he’s running for the town mayor. He is game for whatever is on your agenda for the day and happy go lucky to do it. He is always very calm, relaxed and carefree. He easily settles into new places and adapts well into new environments. Having him in the barn and around the ranch is simple and worry free. He is as quiet as a church mouse with impeccable ground manners and always respectful. He doesn’t have a mean bone in his body towards any human or any other animal. He has been used in big country, rode him in mountains and hauled him along to numerous rodeos and ropings. He has seen all the sights, lights, sounds and excitement of going to town. He has carried the flag for the national anthem numerous times as well. Casanova has a nice reining foundation that makes him fun to play with in the arena and handy to use outside for a days work. He lopes collected circles on a loose rein and guides nicely with a one handed neck rein. He spins nice, has a great side pass, and will stop on a dime and give you some change. Whoa means whoa and he won’t move a muscle until asked. We have roped the smarty in the arena, gathered and sorted lots of cows and used him all over. He’s very user-friendly and a helpful partner to have that will make a days work a lot more stress free and enjoyable. Casanova is the king of trails. He has been everywhere and will cross any obstacle or type of terrain. He goes right where you point him no questions asked. He’s accustomed to the mountains, water, and wildlife encounters. He won’t flinch or flick an ear at loud gunfire, blowing tarps, crazy dogs, heavy machinery, traffic, bicycles, motorcycles, and strollers. You can put a complete beginner on him with zero experience and he will take amazing care of them. He would be an excellent horse for a first time horse owner, for someone wanting to gain confidence, or for an experienced horse person that just wants to enjoy the ride and not deal with any BS. He is always the same, perfect boy no matter how much down time he’s had. Casanova rides western, English, bareback or whatever sparks your interests. I wish we had a barn full of “this” type of horse. He’s a real gem and exactly what we want to offer through our program. You will look far and wide and not find one quite like him. His new forever home is going to absolutely fall in love with this gorgeous and lovely boy over and over every day.

title: Cash
description: So Fancy! Cash checks all the boxes! America’s Favorite color! The Perfect BUCKSKIN, not a white hair on him! We are extremely proud of this astonishing gelding! He is conformationally flawless! Cash will steal your heart. His big kind eye tells his story. He’s a big teddy bear and as sweet and sincere as they come. Cash has been trained in the reining and will do all the maneuvers by pushing the button. He’s a stellar mover and has lots of direction. He has the world champion ranch rider stamped all over him. Cash has nice, smooth, and very comfortable gaits and transitions. He so easy and honest about everything he does. If you can hold his reins, you can ride him. He’s 100% safe and dependable. Cash prefers to go slow and will just cruise along, but can pick up his game when needed. He is great on the trails and rides confidently alone or is good in a group. Bring on the chaos, Cash takes it all in stride. From buffalo, pigs, camels, crazy dogs, blowing tarps, loud gunfire, highway traffic, etc, etc, etc, this young gelding is a soldier. Nothing bothers him and he’s been exposed to a lot here on our ranch. Cash is the kind of gelding that everyone is searching for. He is one special boy. You will enjoy going to the barn each and every day to ride this phenomenal gelding.

title: Champion
description: Here is the complete package. Absolutely gorgeous, built like one should be, athletic, talented, and the breeding doesn’t come any better. Anything you want to do horseback you can do on Champion. He cuts, reins, ropes and has been used all over our ranch. He’s extremely cowy with a lot of style, a deep stop and cow-sense. He runs a super easy reining pattern with effortless lead changes, will run and stop every time, and has fast spins. Champion is great to rope on. Perfect in box, leaves flat, can really run with great rate and timing. He would finish out to be a top break away or calf horse. He works the rope, is strong from the horn, and can make the ground squawk when he stops. Champion is always gentle and there is no silly business to him. He’s honest, kind and is very easy going and adaptive. You will love his funny disposition and big personality. Champion will be fun for any level of competitor to go show in the Cowhorse, cutting, and Versatility shows or will be your go to ranch horse.

title: Cherokee
excerpt: 2017 Quarter Horse Blue Roan Gelding 15.2 Hands
description: Cherokee is a very athletic and handy for his size, he is an idea mount for anyone from kids to seniors. Cherokee has done a little bit of everything and does it willingly and with softness – trail riding, arena work, roping, working cattle, riding English, plus he does tricks such as laying down and bowing. He will spin, side pass, roll back and stop on a dime. If you’d like to hitch him in a beautiful carriage for weddings, he is well broke (traffic safe) to drive. Cherokee has the body and quiet attitude to be a great racetrack pony horse as well.

title: Chewy
excerpt: 2016 Quarter Horse Red Roan Gelding 15 Hands
description: Chewy illustrates why the Metallic Cats are so extremely popular. He’s so easy to train, versatile, talented and extremely level minded. Chewy has a ton of shape, bone and size to handle anything you want to horseback. He was originally trained for the cutting and cowhorse events. He is super cowy and fun to do anything you want to on cattle. Chewy has been roped on and ridden all over the ranch. If you need the speed, he’s got it, but also has an off switch. He is a ranch horse deluxe and handles any situation with ease. He’s dependable and honest. Chewy is great outside and will go right where you point him without hesitation through the water, mud, all types of terrain, and different landscapes. He has a great ground covering walk and is smooth to ride. Chewy has it all going.

title: Cheyenne
excerpt: 2016 Percheron Cross Horse Black Gelding 16.2 Hands
description: Cheyenne is a big fancy gelding. He is gentle as the day is long. You can crawl over him, under him, and do just about whatever you want. He rides bareback or saddled. Cheyenne will walk, trot, and will lope right out of his tracks. He is easy to catch no matter where he is at. Wherever you point him he goes, he is excellent on the trails! He crosses water and all obstacles along the way. He has been around all types of farm animals, tractors, trucks, and etc. Cheyenne gets along well with other horses and cattle out in the pasture. Cheyenne is truly a one of a kind gelding.

title: Chlautile
excerpt: 2015 Paint Horse Palomino Tobiano Mare 15.1 Hands
description: Chlautile is stunningly marked golden palomino and white paint mare that is not only pretty to look at but equally as pretty moving. She stands a solid 15.1 hands tall with a proportionate build and heavy substance to her stature. Chlautile can does it all from English to western and trails she is a versatile and handy mount. Chlautile stands tied, easy to work on for the vet and farrier, sprays, bathes, clips and easy to groom and saddle up whether on a single tie or set of cross ties. Chlautile is great in turnout and comes running to the gate when she sees you, she’s also quiet and clean in her stall. Under saddle Chlautile is an uncomplicated and fun ride. I’ve used her extensively for my lesson students and one of my young ladies even took her out to her first visit wt the equine obstacle park and navigated her through some really awesome obstacles with ease. Chlautile was confident over the tension bridge, moving platform, teeter totter, cowboy curtain, multiple ponds, cake box, how brave this beautiful young mare is!!!!
