She will ride nicely one handed in a finished bit and has lovely transitions she will walk, jog and extend the jog as well as lope off and extend the lope, she comes back through downward transitions effortlessly with just simply relaxing your seat and softly humming and if you want her to bury her hind end for a stop just take your legs off and say “whoa” and she will stop, she has a nice back up and is very comfortable through her gaits. She takes both leads nicely and stays balanced when loping circles, she has a nice simple lead change and really neck reins around easily. I have pulled the bridle off her and rode her around and she guides just as easy as if it was on. Chlautile has a soft mouth and will ride around with beautiful collection in contact, she stays soft over the back and natural impulsion from the hind, when you put this mare together her movement becomes even more elegant and soft. Under English tack Chlautile has a lovely big step to her trot with nice flat knee and reach and has a naturally floaty canter with nice suspension, Chlautile will trot ground poles and willingly will take a jump! Chlautile leg yields, softens her face, moves her hip and shoulders and stays soft and relaxed through all maneuvers. Chlautile is a dream to load up and haul out- she requires no lunging or riding down when in a new place and loves an adventure! This beautiful mare would make an awesome all around horse for just about anyone, kid approved for a lesson program or beginner adult, she’s simple, she’s fun and she’s ready to meet her new partner. Chlautile sells sound without vices or limitations. Chlautile is barefoot, up to date on vaccines and coggins as well as de-worming and hoof care.

title: Colabo
excerpt: 2017 Gypsy Vanner Horse Black Overo Gelding 15 Hands
description: Colabo will ride and drive, goes English or western. We have had Colabo on many trail rides and he will stay quiet in large groups. Colabo has also put in many hours on him in the arena, nice canter and lead depatunes, will respond well to leg and seat cues. Colabo is great on obstacles. We have used him to move the roping steers and pasture roped on him.He will be safe for all level of riders. Our four year old son rides and handles him with no problem. Super quiet in the barn gets along well with other horses. Shoeing and clipping, bathing and hauling are no problem. Clean and sound.

title: Copper
description: This is the kind that is so hard to find! Been there, done that and absolutely gorgeous! Copper is jet black, super safe for anyone, cuts a cow, easy to rope on, bombproof trail horse, deluxe ranch horse, fancy handle and great neck rein! Copper has been shown at numerous ranch cuttings, ranch rodeos, and local jackpots. Everywhere you take him, he gets noticed! His black coat stands out and really shines. He’s got a lot of bone with great structure and balance. Copper is safe, safe, safe and will pack an inexperienced rider. He will do exactly what is asked and ride up or down with ability of the rider of his back. He will go as slow or fast as you want. Copper is fun to rope on. He would suit any level of roper. He has plenty of speed, great rate and is easy to handle. Back in the box and go rope 20, he will give you the same run each time. Copper is very experienced in all types of cow work. He reads one good and is fun to use on the ranch, in the sorting pens and out in the pasture. He easily side passes to all the gates and quietly stands to open and shut them. He has been roped on it the pasture and can control big cattle. He is definitely fancy enough for the boss or ranch foreman to cruise around on. Copper walks out on the trails with a loose rein and is confident alone or will lead or trail in a group. He’s very sure footed and great in all types of terrain. He stands quietly to mount and dismount and will ground tie where you leave him. Copper has an extremely kind way of going. His disposition is spot on and he’s very quiet and easy to handle. We love this guy and no matter what you want to do with him, he’s a team player. Very honest and willing. This gelding checks all the boxes with a black type pedigree, his color, so trained and versatile, yet always gentle with some size and bone! Copper is so special to us and we are proud to offer him.

title: Cougar
excerpt: 2015 Tennessee Walking Horse Chocolate Tobiano Gelding 15.1 Hands
description: Cougar is a stocky built, 15.1hh, Chocolate Tobiano Gelding. Cougar had been their go to horse when a friend wanted to ride or a beginner wanted to give it a try. He was always a crowd favorite! The couple had changed up some of their life plans and decided to move on from trail riding and sold both of their horses. So now Cougar is looking for his 2nd and final forever loving home! Cougar is easy to catch, clip, bath, tack-up, load, and handle. Cougar is gentle and safe to ride. He will flatfoot walk and he can move on out easily. He has a natural runwalking gait and can rack on out when asked. Cougar has been ridden around farm equipment, ATV’s, over large noisy tarps and has also had guns shot off of his back. No matter where he goes or what he does, Cougar is not spooky acting. On the trails he is always great! Cougar has been exposed to all kinds of wildlife such as deer or turkey or other animals like cows or dogs and will go anywhere that he is asked too. He has been rode many miles in the mountains and encountered every obstacle possible on the trail. He will go up or down even the steepest slopes, across deep creeks, over downed trees, and over all types of rough terrain while still being sure footed. He has been rode in traffic, and is very traffic safe around cars, semi, log, and dump trucks. He has a great personality and a great attitude about whatever he is asked to do. If you need a trail horse just go ahead and get the Cougar version!!!

title: Cruiser
description: Absolutely stunning gelding that has a demanding presence. Cruiser is big, bold and beautiful. You won’t find a more gentle, quiet and honest horse. If you can hold his reins, you will be able to ride him. Cruiser has been shown in the reining, ranch trail and ranch riding by a small youth kid. He lopes on a draped rein, has push button lead changes, is a pretty mover and stops easily every time. We have roped on Cruiser and ridden him all over our ranch. He’s great on the trails and is confident alone or quiet in a group. He will go right where you send him. He’s good around busy traffic, loud noises, and crazy dogs. Whether you want to go show or pleasure ride, Cruiser will fit any level of rider and is very safe. He has a stellar disposition that you will fall in love with everyday. He is one that you will be proud to own and truly enjoy.

title: Cruz
description: Tall, dark, and handsome IMPORTED Warmblood gelding! This gorgeous Warmblood gelding is 8 years old and measures just over 16.1HH, to mature to 16.2-16.3HH. His bloodlines include the famous Holsteiners Con Air by Contender and Henry Jotas lines. With his impeccable conformation, perfect hunter canter, and flawless jumping form, this 10+ mover is destined to win big! Cruz has what it takes to be your next top SHOW HUNTER! As a yearling. Cruz has had extensive flatwork training inside the arena and out. He will walk, trot, canter on a loose rein for hunters or collect into a frame for dressage. He rides nicely off of the seat and leg and has a soft mouth. He will be ready to show 2’3”-2’6” this year and is eligible for the green hunter divisions. Cruz enjoys riding Western and going for trail rides. He has mastered all the Western basics – a great stop, back up, lateral work, yielding the forequarters/hindquarters, etc. He is good with traffic and does not mind riding out alone. He has been hauled all over for trail obstacle practice, riding lessons, and local horse shows. While Cruz has clear hunter potential, he could easily shine in dressage, equitation, jumping, or eventing. He is VERSATILE and could excel in any discipline! Cruz is a barn favorite with excellent manners and a sweet, willing temperament. He could easily be brought along by an adult amateur or junior rider in a program. He is easy to load, haul, tack, bathe, braid, trim, etc. He is SOUND and up-to-date on everything with no maintenance. He is a barefoot easy keeper.

title: Cupid
description: Cupid is one fancy gelding that definitely fulfills the requirements even for a discriminating buyer. Cupid is 100% gentle for anyone and everyone. He is as kind and honest of gelding as you will find. He would make a great family horse! Gentle enough for your kiddos, pretty enough for mom, and handy enough to do any job dad wants to do horseback. Cupid is very cowy and fun to cut and sort on. He can hold a tough cow from the herd portraying his stylish moves, quick feet, low head, and loads of eye appeal. He would be fun and competitive to go show in the cutting, cowhorse and Ranch Versatility events. He knows all about a long day’s job and wet saddle blankets. He will be your go-to partner and makes a days work fun. He is always dependable and safe. He’s very sure footed, willingly goes right where you point him, and confident alone on the trails. He is smooth, comfortable and simple to ride. Cupid has been roped on in and out of the arena. He’s stout from the horn and strong enough to handle whatever is dallied to him. It’s hard to find one bred like this with his bone and substance. He’s balanced and correct. Cupid will side pass to all the gates, ground tie, and has been used to pony colts. He rides one handed and has a good neck rein. No tricks or silly business about him. He will go as slow as you want or can step up to the plate if needed. Cupid has the sweetest disposition and doesn’t meet a stranger. He will meet you at the gate and follow you around like a puppy dog. I can’t say about good things about this phenomenal gelding. He’s the kind for sure!

title: Cynthia
excerpt: 2016 Paint Horse Chestnut Tobiano Mare 14.1 Hands
description: “Cynthia” is a 14.1H APHA red roan paint mare. Color or brains? Talented or easy going? Broke or gentle? Kid safe or handy for an advanced rider? Performance prospect or trail horse? The best part about Cynthia is you don’t have to choose. Someone is about to get a REALLY nice horse! You get absolutely everything with this mare! She’s bred exceptionally well, she’s SAFE, gentle, YOUNG, talented, GORGEOUS, has a nice handle on her, and she has real potential to make a performance horse in any direction! Cynthia was started and rode by a little girl for the last few years! That little girl wanted to move forward with a bigger head horse and that’s the only reason we have her now! This mare has seen it all! She’s already been in parades, dabbled in playday events, roped the sled and pushed cows. Cynthia has tons of talent and would make an awesome breakaway/heel horse or a barrel horse prospect! She has speed when asked and is super quick and catty when needed! But if all you want to do is walk the trails on a loose rein, she’ll do it flawlessly. Cynthia neck reins with ease and rides like one should. She moves off leg, goes exactly where you point her at the exact speed you ask, and she stops on a dime. We absolutely love this mare, if we had more time to add another personal horse, she absolutely would not leave. Riding Cynthia brings you a sense of peace and joy that not every horse emits. This mare has your back in all situations and acts like another member of your friend group. Take her to town and she’ll say hi to everyone before you get the chance to. Cynthia absolutely loves attention and has one of the best attitudes we’ve seen from a mare. She gets along with everyone and everything, loads, leads, bathes, ties and stands great. There isn’t one thing we don’t like about Cynthia and that’s why we’ve thought really hard about adding her to our personal pen. Sadly for us, we just don’t have the time and Cynthia deserves to go be someone’s #1! She’s the perfect age, perfect color, has the perfect attitude, is broke enough for any situation and has the talent to go in any direction. APHA incentives are becoming increasingly popular and are being added to more and more barrel racing and roping events. With Cynthia, you’re not only getting a GENTLE, solid mount to keep you safe through any situation, you’re also investing in a prospect that can earn you things your typical AQHA horse with these bloodlines can’t. You’re investing in an amazing pleasure riding horse, talented prospect and very well bred future broodmare. Cynthia is one that will be hard to duplicate and near impossible to replace. Writing this, we can’t help but have a sense of sadness that we won’t be the ones to enjoy her and her potential, but it brings us peace knowing someone else will soon feel the love we have for this mare. You won’t find another like her easily, and one that checks all the boxes like Cynthia does just may not exist with all the added bonus perks of her bloodlines and color. Cynthia is sure to bring joy to the lucky one that ends up with her and to whoever that may be or if it’s you, just know you’re getting one heck of a horse, and quite possibly THE horse of your lifetime. AFFORDABLE Shipping ANYWHERE easily available.

title: Cyrus
description: GENTLE! BROKE! Cyrus Stands 14 hands Cyrus is easy to catch and has been on many overnight camping trips. He crosses water, logs, mud and bridges with no problem. Cyrus was used in a desensitizing program and is uses to the flags and tarps. He’s been pasture roped off of and pulls good from the horn. Cyrus has a soft one hand neckrain, takes his correct leads , sidepasses snd lays down on cue. He’s also seen a lot of miles on the busy highway and is traffic safe and sound.

title: Daisy
description: Daisy is a well trained spotted saddle horse mare. She stands a sturdy 14.2 hh. I don’t even know where to begin, I could talk about this beautiful mare all day long. Daisy has been ridden all over Texas, Arizona. Oregon, Kentucky, Tennessee, and Virginia and many more. She has been on many day rides, overnight and weekend trips. She handles every trip like a champ. She has been stalled while camping, as well as tied out on a hi-line. She does great with both.

title: Dallas
excerpt: 2016 Quarter Horse Palomino Gelding Gelding 16 Hands
description: Dallas is a big, beautiful, quiet ranch horse. He has been ridden in many different environments, has tons of trail miles, and has been ridden around cattle. Neck reins like a pro, does all the maneuvers; sidepass, spin, circles, etc. You can swing a rope off him as well. Dallas has no quirks or bad habits. He never tries to take advantage of his rider. He’s very “bombproof” and reliable. Lopes over tarps, drags logs, crosses water and bridges. He’s so sweet and has a very kind personality. Loads, bathes and clips great. Stands for the farrier. Absolutely no vices. 100% Sound. He’s fine in a stall or turnout. His lope is extremely smooth as is his trot. He’s consistent and collected in all gaits. Dallas is super quiet and easy to ride, but isn’t the kind of horse you have to constantly push to keep going either. Knows all the groundwork exercises and can lie down on cue. He rides bridleless as well. We’ve started colts on him and ridden him bareback.

title: Dandy
description: An absolute favorite around our ranch is our sweet boy, Dandy. This fancy gelding is trained, ready and willing to do any job that needs done horseback. His athletic, low and sweepy style gives him a ton of eye appeal. Dandy is trained for all the cowhorse maneuvers too! He has a huge sliding stop, easy lead changes and pretty spins. He would be fun to go show in the cowhorse and ranch versatility events. Dandy is an awesome partner out on the ranch. He is easy to open and shut all the gates on, ground ties, has a nice ground covering walk, and will go all day long. He is very handy sorting pairs and in the pens and if you need to go rope one in the pasture and tie one down, no problem, he works the rope and will hold solid from the horn. Dandy has been roped on both ends in the arena. He is good in the box and easy and honest in every way. He has plenty of speed and will give you same shot each time. Dandy is gentle and kind every time you saddle him. He has zero silly business to him and is safe for all levels of riders. He is great out on the trails. He will go right where you point him with no hesitation. Dandy has a heart of pure gold and is as (honest as the day is long). He gives 110% in everything he does will be your go-to ride every time. You will adore his sweet, loving personality and kind demeanor. Dandy checks all the boxes and would make an exceptional gelding for the entire family to enjoy.

title: Danny
description: As handy as a Leatherman tool, Danny is as versatile and well rounded as any gelding around. Anything you want to do horseback, this guy is game. He is such an incredibly special gelding to us and to everyone that has been part of his life. Danny’s sweet and kind disposition will steal your heart everyday. He is as honest as the day is long and such a willing, kind and gentle individual. He has a proven record and will be the funnest partner to go enjoy in the show pen and bring home the money and prizes! Danny is very solid and easy in all his reining maneuvers with fancy spins, deep stops and an automatic lead change. He is calm, cool and collected. He is a pretty mover and will stand out in the Ranch Riding classes as well. Danny is great to go cut on in the arena or in the sorting pens. He is a natural at reading cows and has the grit to hold a tough one from the herd. Point, drop your hand and enjoy the ride. He’s all business and knows his job. Danny is a deluxe ranch horse and will be the gelding you want to saddle if you need to get a job done on the ranch. He has earned his keep and knows what long days are and all about a wet saddle pad. He has been used in big country to gather cattle and spent a few winters working the wheat pasture cattle, doctoring, branding and gathering. Back him in the box or go chase one down in the pasture, Danny is super to rope on. Leaves the box flat and smooth, perfect rate and timing, sweet move in the corner and can face on the head side. He will suit any level of roper. You can practice on him all day long and he gives you the same shot every time. You can rope and tie one down in the pasture and he will hold strong from the horn. Danny has been ridden by the kiddos and he’s the type of horse you can walk off and trust. He’s always gentle and safe. If your safety is a priority, he will give you the confidence you need. He will ride for anyone that can climb up in his saddle. Danny is great on the trails and will go right where you point him. He is good with heavy traffic, crazy dogs, blowing tarps, loud gunfire, and wild animals. Very sure footed and smooth to ride. This gorgeous buckskin gelding will be enjoyable to own everyday. He is extremely easy to handle on the ground, will meet you at the gate to catch, and saddles up gentle every time even without routine riding. It doesn’t matter if you just want to ride to the mailbox and back, Danny is the one you will want to ride. Check out this special gelding, they don’t come along like him everyday.

title: Dante
description: Chrome for days! Take a look at this stunning double-registered gelding! Dante is one cool ride that will get you noticed anywhere you unload him. He is trained in the reining, ranch riding, ranch trail, and ranch versatility classes. He has a great jog and lopes on a loose rein. He has lots of direction and willingly guides right where you send him. Dante is extremely easy to ride, smooth, and comfortable. He is very safe, quiet and gentle. He will ride for absolutely anyone. We have ridden Dante all over our ranch. Nothing bothers this honest gelding. He has seen it all and takes it in with stride. He’s cool as a cucumber even when our huge camel is around. Dante has been roped on out of the box and in the pasture. He will run to one and has a great rate and timing. Great in all types of terrain and very sure-footed. Has a good walk outside on the trails and is confident to ride alone or with a group. This is one fancy gelding that you will enjoy owning every day. His ground manners are impeccable and he has a kind disposition.

title: Darrion
excerpt: 2016 Mustang Horse Grulla W/ Stripes Gelding 15 Hands
description: Darrion “The Wonder Horse” will make you wonder is he even is a horse? He’s closer to a human than any horse that we have ever met. Darrion is a well built gelding stands 15hh and has the dark defined grulla markings that you’d folks love including pencil thin zebra stripes on his face. He is trained to lay down for mounting from the ground or he will lay down for you to dismount from the saddle, which is a great tool to have for anyone who has knee or hip issues or if you are handicapped. If laying down isn’t the easiest way for you to mount he will also sidepass over to a trailer fender, truckbed, gate or tree stump. He has been taught all about leg pressure and will ride without a bridle, he will ride with a rein around her neck or just totally by using your feet to back, spin, turn, sidepass both ways, lope and slide stop all by using leg cues. Darrion has one of the easiest and softest lopes you will ever set on! Other tricks that Darrion knows is he will play kickball, count with both feet, rear up on command, walk down a 12’ crosstie, hop up on a pedestal or truckbed, set on his rump and bow down. Since owning him we have thrown everything at him (literally) trying to scare him and I believe he is as close to bombproof as any horse can be. We have had him camping, used him around cows including roping some calves off of him, trail ridden him hundreds of miles including a lot of miles being ridden by 9 year old Konner, we have ridden through town, right down Main Street, across railroad tracks, through the car wash, used the car vacuum on him, rode him down the sidewalks of town, down steps, up ramps, through Hardees drive through, inside Bishop’s Tire Center and through the bank to make a deposit. We have ponied other horses off of him and used him to break colts to lead, he will drag anything that you ask him too. He has been ridden around farm equipment, ATV’s, over large noisy tarps and has also had guns shot off of his back. No matter where she goes or what she does, Darrion is not spooky acting. He has been exposed to all kinds of wildlife such as deer or turkey or other animals like cows or dogs and will go anywhere that she is asked too. He will go up or down even the steepest slopes, across deep creeks, over downed trees, and over all types of rough terrain while still being sure footed. He has been rode in traffic, and is very traffic safe around cars, semi, log, and dump trucks. He in one of the friendliest horses that you will find, in fact he will follow you around and even go for a jog with you. He has a great attitude about whatever she is asked to do. Someone is about to hit the lottery with Darrion he is 1 in a million!!!

title: Dash
description: You will wear out a pickup trying to find one as special as this Big Gorgeous Yellow gelding! Dash is the real deal and the complete package. He does it all! Reins, ropes, cuts, cowhorses, trail rides and is a deluxe ranch horse. He is the kindest soul and most gentle guy you will find. Dash is the most simple and easy horse in the show pen, always honest and enjoys it. All his maneuvers are effortless and push button. He would make an outstanding show horse for any level of rider. Dash is a finished head horse. He runs the same run every time. Scores great and has perfect rate and time. He runs flat and is very easy for any level of roper. Dash is extremely cowy and cuts a cow good. He’s gritty in the show pen and fun to use in the sorting pens and on the ranch. 100% gentle and bombproof outside. He’s always safe and is a great confidence builder. We absolutely love everything about this phenomenal gelding. He is one you will enjoy no matter what you want to do with him.

title: David
excerpt: 2015 Pony Horse Palomino Paint Gelding 13.3 Hands
description: A little something different, full of fun, and for everyone to enjoy! Meet David, 13.3 hand tall, Grade Gelding, weighing at 900lbs. He’s just the right size for everyone in the family and he is trained to ride and drive, making him just right for everyone to enjoy. David is very easy to get along with and has been ridden by a 10 yr old for the past year. David has been on lots of outdoor adventures and recently was used on a trail ride with over 100 horses and was ridden by a 10 yr old boy the entire ride! And just for fun he swims in a lake and loves it so if you need to cool off on a hot day, he will take you for a swim! David has been ridden in driven to town where he’s been exposed to all sorts of commotion, traffic and bicycles. He also knows some really fun tricks – like the lay down and sitting on a bean bag and marker training, as well as saying yes or no! With all the outside adventures he’s had we have also spent some time in the arena teaching him to ride English and Western – working on speed transitions and did we mention he’s a super cute mover! Oh and he is so stinking cute and has a great personality!

title: Davis
excerpt: 2016 Azteca Horse Blue Roan Gelding 14.3 Hands
description:
Davis is soo fun to ride and just as good to look at. A truly one of a kind azteca gelding. He is extremely broke, he will spin like a Reiner, lopes and moves of your feet like a dressage horse and will “Davis” down the trail like a seasoned ranch horse. Davis has seen and done it all from English dressage to ranching.
\nIf you’ve never rode an azteca you’re missing out this guy is soo smooth he feels like you’re loping on a cloud. Davis has beautiful action when he travels, and is soft and supple. He is extremely fun under English tack and has been over some small cross country jumps.
\nDavis house been used on the ranch to gather cattle and has been roped on as well. He’s a calm horse that isn’t frazzled easily. Would make a great horse for an inexperienced rider or youth.

title: Deputy
description: Super classy and stunning dappled buckskin. Deputy started his life in the reining pen and is solid on all maneuvers. He has a soft, smooth lope, fast spins, and big stops. For the past few years, he’s been primarily used on cattle operations and large ranches. Saddle him up and go do a day’s work. He’s a great partner to sort pairs, gather yearlings, and doctor in the pasture. Whatever needs done, he’s willing to do the job. The Deputy is also solid on the head side. He can fly. He leaves the box flat and runs to a steer with cadence. He has a fancy move in the corner and an extremely snappy face. He has all the parts and would be a big-time head horse for someone wanting to go. Deputy is brave and confident outside, nothing bothers him and he will go where you send him. He’s quiet, gentle, and easy to handle. Always good to ride and a perfect gentleman on the ground. Deputy has all the parts. He’s prime aged, the right color, just a super nice all around gelding.

title: Diamond
excerpt: 2018 Gypsy Vanner Horse Black and White Mare 14 Hands
description:
You know what they say, diamond’s are a gals best friend.. No really, your wife called- she wants THIS Diamond!
\nDiamond is standing 14 hands tall. Check out the mane on this girl! That coveted Gypsy flare didn’t skip her- she is F A N C Y.
\nDiamond is a real gem, gentle gentle gentle & BROKE! Your city friend wants to go on a trail ride? Diamond is the girl for the job. Kiddos want to ride around the yard bareback & double? Diamond is ready to roll. She rides off one handed, picks up every gait without hesitation & has all the buttons you could possibly imagine. Diamond loves cruising down the trails, nothing we’ve found phases her & she is eager to work for her rider. This cute little mare has the experience and knowledge to keep the greenest young riders safe, she is well equipped to handle any shenanigans they throw her way. Flappy tarps, running water, busy traffic, loud noises, you name it- she takes it all in stride! She’ll pack a rider wherever they point her. Diamond isn’t just a pretty face- she is 100% safe and gentle for any level rider.
\nDiamond is a classy young lady, she stands quietly for the farrier, loves to be groomed/bathed & patiently waits to be tacked/mounted.
\nSound, sane and utd on all routine care.

title: Diego
excerpt: 2016 Draft cross Horse Grey Gelding 16.1 Hands
description: Amazing Diego is a VERY stout built Dapple Grey Crossbred Gelding, standing a solid 16.1hh, weighing 1400lbs and certainly is a once in a lifetime type horse! Diego is one of the horses that we put in and has now completed our natural horsemanship program. Diego has been in the program since early this year and he is trained to sidepass over to a mounting block, trailer fender, tree stump, ect…set on his rump, he will bow down, he is very good at laying down as well and loves to set on his rump. Diego is totally respectful on the ground as seen in the video, my 3 year old daughter can lead him anywhere with no worries of getting stepped on or pushed around. He will go halterless at liberty and follow, turn and back anywhere that you go even through the little small door on the front of the barn that’s only intended for people. Diego is a very gentle soul that is laid back and safe for any rider. I have used him for lessons with my 9 year old daughter so she could learn how to ride horses off of leg pressure without a bridle. We have ridden him double around the parking lot for hours, with horses going in every direction, loud speakers sounding off and hordes of people and kids running around. I have used him in the shovel race to drag a partner around the ring and also put him in the most wild and crazy setting possible The Balloon Pop where there is a balloon tied to each side of the horse and it’s a mad free for all as 25-30 riders run wild trying to pop each others balloons… and let me say NOTHING phases this him! He has done it all and seen it all! With Diego (as seen in our video) we have trail ridden him bridleless, literally hanging the bridle on a tree limb and heading off down the trails, over rocks, through tight spots, in/out of creeks ALL WITHOUT the use of any type of bit, halter, rein or neck aid. Diego will lope nice circles, take his leads, slide stop and back all too! Diego has a very soft and easy lope which is hard to find on a big horse! He is a very confident horse that is not spooky around anything or any situation and he is as close to bombproof as you’ll see. He has been used in all aspects of ranching from roping and dragging cows, to sorting and loading… he will stand his ground with unruly cows and keeps a cool head even in a heated situation! Diego has a very good handle, will spin both ways, sidepass, back, open and shut gates. Not only will he ride western he will also go English and has been started on jumps. In addition to riding english and western Diego will also hook up and pull a cart or buggy. He is safe in the chains and knows the shafts as well, single or double he does it all. He is safe to drive on the highway and isn’t scared of cars, trucks, mailboxes, garbage cans or barking dogs. As with all horses that complete our program, Diego loves attention in any form that he can get it whether that be brushing or bathing and has a ton of personality! He will follow you anywhere at you go at liberty and he is also easy to catch out of the pasture! He has been ridden around farm equipment, ATV’s, over large noisy tarps and has also had guns shot off of his back. No matter where he goes or what he does, Diego is not spooky acting. He has been exposed to all kinds of wildlife such as deer or turkey or other animals like cows or dogs and will go anywhere that he is asked too. He will go up or down even the steepest slopes, across deep creeks, over downed trees, and over all types of rough terrain while still being sure footed. Don’t miss this truly AMAZING horse!!!

title: Disco
description: Disco does it all! He’s ready to show show in the Cowhorse, Versatility, Roping, Cutting, and Ranch Riding! He has been shown by open, amateur, and youth riders. Disco is extremely cowy with a lot of style and grit. He runs a smooth reining pattern with effortless lead changes and easy speed control. Disco is good to rope on for any level of roper. He’s good in the box, runs hard with perfect rate and timing, gives you the same shot every time, fancy move in the corner and a snappy face. Disco is excellent outside on the trails and in pasture. He has a good ground covering walk and will go all day. He’s superb to use all over the ranch and he’s especially fun in the sorting pens. If you want one gelding that can do it, check Disco out. Ranching Heritage Eligible. Incentive Fund.

title: Diva
description: She is a stout built gal and can carry most any size of rider. Here is a mule that we have done it all with from packing on trails, to going on camping trips, and she’s been used to check cows and fences. I’ve ridden her though town, down the highway, by the gas station, down sidewalks, across bridges, up steps… she will go anywhere you ask! She’s been a pleasure to have around and is always eager to please! Diva has a very good handle! She will spin both ways, side pass, back with easy, slide stop and lope out of her tracks! In addition to having a nice lope she has a very smooth ground covering foxtrot when asked for it. She will walk slow and easy with quarter horses or move on out and keep up with a gaited horse. We have used her several times around our cattle, roped a few calves off of her, done some herding and loaded a couple trucks with her. She has plenty of cow sense and knows her job. You won’t find a trail that’s too rough or tough for her either, she’ll go through anything you ask her too. Diva walks when climbing the steep hills, she goes patiently and easy down the rocky mountain sides, crosses water, bridges, logs, and anything else that might be in your way. She’s been ridden around dogs and other livestock. I have raccoon hunted off of her, led my dog off of her and shot guns off of her back. Diva gets along with other horses when she’s turned out to pasture. She stands quiet if she’s in his stall. She’s fine with her ears, good for farrier and easy to handle when loading and unloading from the trailer. She’s got plenty of experience on the trails! Here is one that you will love for years and years to come!

title: Dorian
excerpt: 2017 Dutch Warmblood Horse Black Mare 16 Hands
description: Dorian is a old Dutch Warmblood horse mare standing 16 hands . This sweet mare is smooth and easygoing with the athleticism to excel in any direction. Dorian has done it all: paperchases, hunter paces, horse showing, lessons, trail riding and more! This lady is a simple, level headed mare with a great brain and fantastic attitude.

title: Dots and Dashes
excerpt: 2017 Appaloosa Horse Red Roan Gelding 15.1 Hands
description: Dots and Dashes is a 15.1 Appaloosa gelding that is one cool rascal! When out on the ranch or going down the trails he will cross creeks, ditchs, logs, and navigate rough rocky areas. He is safe in traffic safe whether that be trucks or cars. He has a very good handle, and neck reins, spins several circles at a time each way, and will lope from a standstill, slide stops, side passes, and backs. He has a nice jog that is smooth to ride and a good lope! Dots and Dashes are fine for beginners to ride. He has been exposed to all kinds of wildlife such as deer or turkey or other animals like cows or dogs and will go anywhere that he is asked to. He has been riding many miles in the mountains of Eastern Kentucky and encountered every obstacle possible on the trail. He will go up or down even the steepest slopes, across deep creeks, over downed trees, and all types of rough terrain while still being sure-footed. Dots and Dashes will be one of the prettiest, smartest, friendliest, and nicest appaloosa horses that you will ever have the chance to buy!

title: Dream
description: Gorgeous and golden palomino! Dream is as quiet, gentle and easy going gelding as you will find. Originally trained in the reining, Dream has a nice, smooth lope and pitter-patter jog on a draped rein. He has nice spins and a good sliding stop. Dream is nearly bombproof. Always safe to saddle up and go, even with long periods of time off. He has more whoa than go. He will go as fast or slow as you want to. Dream would be a great confidence builder for a timid rider or a beginner. He’s confident out on the trails and in the pasture. He is fine alone or in groups. He is good with gunfire, loud traffic, crazy dogs, pot-bellied pigs, and blowing tarps. Dream is solid on the head side in the team roping. He’s perfect in the box and you can run as many steers as you want. He leaves flat, runs and rates great, and faces easily. He would work for any level of roper to go have fun on and enjoy with absolutely no silly stuff.Dream is an all around nice gelding to have around. He is one that you will enjoy every time you saddle him up. He’s the same every trip with no surprises. He stands 15.2 hands and is conformationally very balanced and correct.

title: Dusty
description: Super cute gelding with the chrome! Dusty has been there and done that! Anything you want to go do horseback, Dusty is game! He has been ridden out in big country and has been ranched on extensively. From roping, sorting, and doctoring cattle, Dusty knows his job and is all business. Send him across all types of terrain, rough mountains, miles of ranch country, he takes it all in stride with his ears forward and happy do whatever is asked of him. Dusty is extremely gentle, quiet and easy to ride. Just point and go. He has a great neck rein and fancy handle. Dusty cuts a cow and has lots of cow sense. He is fun to use in the sorting pens and everywhere else cattle are part of the equation. He will side pass up to all the gates, stand ground tied, and is truly a gentleman in every way. Dusty has a huge stop, quick spins and rocking chair lope. He would make a jam up break away, heel or calf horse. He has been roped on out of the box and in the pasture. He has been hauled to local jackpots. He is perfect in the box, has great rate and timing, and gives you the same run each go. Dusty has been ridden by complete beginners and children. If you can hold his reins, you can ride him. He is honest and sincere no matter your skill level. Dusty is easy catch in a pasture and genuinely the perfect gelding around the barn. He’s the kind that makes owning a horse fun and simple.

title: Eclipse
description: Eclipse is an all-around guy, Athletic, Beginner, Finished, Heading, Heel, Horsemanship, Husband Safe, Lesson, Ranch, Ranch Versatility, Ranch Work, Show, Show Experience, Showmanship, Trail, Trail Riding, Working Cow, Working Cattle, Youth. Contact us below for details, pictures, and videos about him

title: Elsie
excerpt: 2016 Gypsy Vanner Horse Cremello Mare 15 Hands
description:
Check this stunning mare out! She has the brains, the experience, and the looks to fit in anywhere!
\nShe spent the first few years of life training and showing in the low level dressage classes. After being hauled around the country and gaining the experience needed to be a youth suitable mount, she transitioned over to pleasure riding. Over the last five years, Elsie has been a teacher, while learning new things herself. Packing kids over small jumps, through trail rides, through hunter jumper courses and even being a mounted archery horse for a short time. As with all good Gypsy’s, she is very intelligent and grasps new concepts quickly and without a fuss.
\nOn the ground she is quiet. She saddles, leads, and stands to be mounted. She also lays down with a lift of a leg to be mounted. She is clean legged, up to date on trims, coggins, shots, and is 100 percent sound. Elsie has had one stunningly beautiful foal. She is a great mother and is sound to breed. We are sad to see this one go, but we are also confident that her new owners will love her as much as we do. Her looks and experience make her a once in a lifetime mare!

title: Eresen
excerpt: 2016 Missouri Fox Trotter Horse Blue Roan Gelding 15.1 Hands
description: Eresen is a SUPER STOUT built 15.1hh, TRUE BLUE ROAN Gaited Gelding. He has trail ridden him, used him around the family farm to check his cattle and has roped and doctored a few calves. He recently sold his cows and got into the sheep business and decided that he didn’t have any time to trail ride and didn’t need to have a horse around for farm work anymore. Eresen is easy to catch, clip, bath, tack-up, load, and handle. Gus has a SUPER smooth gait and he is smooth at all speeds whether that be his runwalking gait or his 4-beat gait that is smooth upto 10mph, Eresen also has a nice lope. He neckreins and has a good stop. He has been ridden around farm equipment, ATV’s, over large noisy tarps and has also had guns shot off of his back. No matter where he goes or what he does, Eresen is not spooky acting. Gus has been exposed to all kinds of wildlife such as deer or turkey or other animals like cows or dogs and will go anywhere that he is asked too. He has been rode many miles in the mountains and encountered every obstacle possible on the trail. He will go up or down even the steepest slopes, across deep creeks, over downed trees, and over all types of rough terrain while still being sure footed. He has been rode in traffic, and is very traffic safe around cars, semi, log, and dump trucks. Here is one that you don’t want to miss!

title: Excellence
excerpt: 2017 Quarter Horse Dapple Grey Gelding 15.1 Hands
description: Excellence is 15.1 HH gelding. Excellence, affectionately a horse who is truly worth his weight in gold. He is big boned and big feet not petite quarter horse legs. He is as thick as he is tall. Excellence is not just a horse; he is a barn favorite with a personality that shines as bright as his name suggests. With his puppy dog loving demeanor, Excellence is sure to win your heart and become your best friend. Excellence is the embodiment of a horse with heart. He has a super “in-your-pocket” personality, always eager to be near people, showering them with affection. Excellence’s loving nature is complemented by his goofy antics that will keep you chuckling and entertained. His presence lights up the barn, and he has won the hearts of everyone around. We will surely miss him at the ranch, but we know he is ready to bring joy and companionship to his new home. Excellence is not just a charmer; he’s also exceptionally talented and well-trained. In the arena, Excellence is fancy broke with skills that are hard to beat. He has a great stop, impressive spins, flying lead changes, and the ability to collect his head beautifully. He can side-pass with ease, showcasing his versatility and training. Excellence has a “been there, done that” personality, making him reliable and trustworthy in any situation. On the trails, Excellence is a true gentleman. He handles any task with ease and grace, whether it’s going through water, stepping over logs, or navigating rocky and muddy paths. Excellence doesn’t bat an eye at any terrain, making him the perfect partner for all your outdoor adventures. He’s been ridden under city lights and is completely town safe. Cars, honking horns, quads, dirt bikes, joggers, loose dogs, airplanes, and scooters – you name it, Excellence has seen it all and could care less. Excellence bravery is unmatched. He’s had flags waved around him, tarps flapping in his face, and he remains unphased. We’ve even roped the sled on him a few times, and he takes it all in stride with ease. Excellence has been our go-to horse for gathering cows in the mountains, participating in overnight camping trips, poker rides, beach rides, and everyday trail rides. He’s also been a star in parades, handling the excitement and chaos with over 50 other horses like a pro. Whether Excellence is part of a group or out on his own, he remains calm and collected. He can happily go out alone without a care in the world. Excellence is more “woah” than “go,” enjoying a relaxed pace as he cruises around town or the neighborhood. His easy-going nature makes him perfect for riders of all experience levels. Excellence is a one-of-a-kind horse with a heart of gold and a personality that will make you fall in love instantly. He’s done it all and is ready to bring his special charm to a new home. Don’t miss this opportunity to own a true gem of a horse. Excellence is also UTD on shoes, worming, shots, chiro. He’s ready to be your new best friend and loyal companion, ready for any adventure you can dream of.

title: Fiona
excerpt: 2015 Draft Cross Horse Bay Tobiano Mare 16 Hands
description: Big Beautiful and Classy… Fiona lives up to her name! She stands a stout built 16hh. She is for sure big enough to carry any size of rider. She has been involved in every aspect of ranch life from herding to sorting and doctoring on a daily basis. She has a great handle, slide stops, backs, opens/shuts gates and will track a cow. She is not afraid of a mad momma cow or an aggressive bull, she will stand her ground. She will ride anywhere in the group… front, back, middle or head off on her own without a fuss. Fiona is quiet to handle, does all the basics, washing, pickup feet, load and is easy to groom. She has been ridden in rough country and will climb the steep hills, she goes patiently and easy down the rocky mountain sides, crosses water, bridges, logs, and anything else that might be in your way. She is traffic safe as well. Fiona has got along with other horses when she’s turned out in my pasture and hasn’t caused any fuss. She stands quiet if she’s in his stall. From Ranch to Trail she is safe and broke and someone is going to get a great riding partner for years to come!

title: Florence
excerpt: 2017 Paint Horse Palomino Overo Mare 15 Hands
description: Florence All Time Beauty APHA mare! She stands 15 hands tall and is built like a tank! She is a beautiful Overo color with a Red Dun/Gold Palomino base. She is super sweet and gentle! She has been through our program and excels at all levels! She will lope around the very best and knows her leads well! She has a great head set and will sit down and stop! Florence has been ridden a lot outsides and loves the trails and easy rides around the farm! She also does well in the arena with obstacles and will come to the mounting block for mounting! Florence has beautiful markings and will get you noticed anywhere! She has been ridden by small children as well as adults! She is very laid back and easy to ride! She shoes well and loves to take a bath! She has done the very best with us and took care of our whole family! She has great coloring and is put together like one should be! She is a very safe horse to ride as well as be around! Not pushy or impatient! She is very gentle and loving! If you’re looking for a family horse don’t miss out on this one of a kind and very unique mare!

title: Fluffy
description: Fluffy, a seven year old Gypsy Vanner gelding. A real gentleman in every right, whether you want to ride, drive, or just have him around the backyard to be your friend. His looks, well, they speak for themselves, with a long, flowing mane and tail, not to mention feather galore! This teddy bear loves to be loved; he will meet you at the gate every time. He is 100% safe in every way, have the grandkids ride in the backyard or ride him into town. He has been on miles of trails, crosses logs and water or whatever obstacles you may meet. He will go out alone or with other horses. He bathes, loads, and is a gentleman to the farrier. We have also had a ton of fun in the arena with him, he will move off your legs and pick up leads like a pro. This is a one of a kind horse you do not want to miss.

title: Genie
excerpt: 2016 Tennessee Walking Horse Bay Mare 15.1 Hands
description: She stands 15.1 hands tall she has beautiful white markings. She is smooth as silk and very fun to ride whether it is trail riding or take her to the show pen. She will do anything that you ask of her. We have ridden her all over Green River trail riding camp! There is nothing she won’t cross just point her head and she will go. She is a very easy keeper and gets along with other horses out in the pasture. She can be kept in a stall or turned out whichever is best for you. She will neck rein like a quarter horse, and will also canter off very nicely if asked. This mare will be great for anyone who is looking to hit the trails this summer she is good sized and very easy to look at. If you are looking for a unique horse that has a lot of brains and is good broke to ride then this mare will be for you. She is very good naturally gaited and would do well in any aspect of riding. She is blemish free and ready for a new home!

title: Genius
excerpt: 2015 Quarter Horse Red Roan Gelding 15.1 Hands
description: We are extremely proud to offer you this phenomenal gelding. He doesn’t only have an impressive show record, but you can go do anything you want to horseback on this guy. He’s ready to win in the cutting, Cowhorse, Versatility and Ranching events. Genius has a fancy style and a really cool presence. He is athletic and smart enough to work an extremely tough cow with low, sweepy and stylish moves. Genius runs a really nice reining pattern, performs all the maneuvers easily and is an elegant mover. He has fast spins and a huge stop. He’s very quiet and easy for any level of rider. He’s 100% safe and gentle, always. Genius is as fancy of ranch horse as you will find. He’s the one the boss will pick. He’s great to rope on in the pasture, will pull strong from the horn, and will work the rope. He’s outstanding in the sorting pens and has a heart the size of Texas. Genius is also a dynamite head horse. He scores perfect, can really run with perfect rate and timing, fancy corner move and faces easily. He would fit any level of roper. Genius is an around outstanding gelding the anyone would be proud to own. Don’t miss him! They just don’t come around this special every day.

title: George
excerpt: 2017 Quarter Horse Red Roan Gelding 14.3 Hands
description: Red roan, 4 white legs, and a silver mane and tail equal lots of chrome on this superstar gelding! George is the ideal Cowgirl or Cowboy mount… He is that cool lookin’ cowboy color and can do all the fun stuff to play the part! He has a deep stop and a low, sweepy stylish move in front of a cow. George is the kind of horse that the ranch boss’s wife rides and all the cowboys envy. He’s handy enough to do any ranch task big or small and knows about long days and wet saddle pads. But when it comes down to it, he’s also the one that you will feel comfortable throwing the kiddos on and not have to watch every move. He’s gentle, safe and sane! He stays that way day in and out, even with substantial time off. Too busy, bad weather, job gets in the way? No worries, George has you covered, saddle him up and have fun with zero silly business. He’s a perfect gentleman out on the trails alone or with a group. Running water, lakes, deep mud, thick brush, narrow trails, wide open pastures, prickly cactus, rough rocks, wildlife and mountains don’t phase this steady-eddy gelding. George is the perfect example of how a good gelding should behave. He’s very respectful with a gentle nature. He would never try to out think you and wants to please. You ask him and he delivers. Zero tricks to him. He’s a happy, sweet, and easy horse to own. He’s adaptive and accepting to whatever you expect of him and has the talent and training to do it.

title: Ghost
excerpt: 2016 Quarter Horse Red Roan Gelding 14.3 Hands
description: This handsome gelding is easy on your eyes and will capture your heart with his charismatic disposition and pleasing attitude. Ghost is always ready for what the day brings. He is happy-go-lucky to do anything you want to do horseback. He cuts a cow, ropes in and out of the arena, is trained the very best, and is hands down an excellent ranch horse. Ghost is safe, quiet, and gentle for any level of rider. Time off? No problem, saddle him up and he’s the same way you remembered him. He is honest and kind for kids and beginners. Ghost has the most comfortable slow lope and a jog you can enjoy all day. His transitions are smooth and easy. He has a great one handed neck rein and rides just as good bridle-less. Ghost reads a cow phenomenal and has a captivating working style with a deep stop and really works over his hocks. He is fun to work cattle on in any type of situation in the arena, sorting pens, or out on the ranch. Ghost is easy to rope on and has great rate and timing. He runs up to the same spot each time and never tries to outthink you. He has plenty of speed if needed. Out on the ranch, road, or trails, Ghost is a complete gentleman and will take care of you. He’s not spooky or looky and is confident anywhere you send him. Everyday he is trustworthy and dependable for someone wanting confidence in there ride. He has that “Metallic Cat” mind that is willing and trainable. He never gets mad or upset and just wants to be good and get along. He is accustomed to crazy dogs, potbelly pigs, longhorns, buffalo, wildlife and even a camel named Clyde. Ghost is good with busy traffic, loud gunfire, heavy equipment and blowing tarps. Catch him easily where you find him, lay him down with a touch of a finger, climb on bareback and enjoy the ride. Check Ghost out, he’s the kind that don’t come around everyday. He’s the perfect all around, versatile gelding and we are proud to offer him.

title: Ginger
description: Here is one that is a little different! Ginger is as loud colored and unique as they come! And did I mention GENTLE for everyone and anyone? He is truly one of a kind and a complete gentleman in every way. You will love his sweet, affectionate disposition and quiet demeanor. Ginger is a willing partner for anything you want to do on horseback. He has been ridden in all types of terrain, through rivers, creeks and muddy water, thick brush, and big pastures. We have used Ginger all over for all aspects of ranch work. He easily side passes over to open and shut all the gates, and ground ties anywhere, and we have sorted and gathered cattle daily on him. We have also trail-ridden him extensively in the Arizona desert.

title: Gizmo
description: Worth his weight in gold, this adorable palomino gelding will steal your heart. Gizmo is a favorite around our outfit. Once you meet him, you will know why. Gizmo has that kind, soft eye that defines his personality. He absolutely wants no trouble. You ask and he will give. Gizmo has been shown in the Cowhorse events by a youth rider. He’s honest and easy in the show pen just as he would be on a Friday afternoon at the ranch. Gizmo performs all the reining maneuvers with ease. He has an automatic lead change, pretty spins, huge stops and auto pilot circles. He’s easy peasy and so simple. Gizmo would be the perfect baby sitter and confidence builder. He has packed true beginners that have never ridden before through the desert and mountains. Nothing bothers him and he’s safe, sane and solid for everyone to ride, have fun and enjoy. Ride him daily or once a month, he’s the same each time you saddle him. Gizmo is super cowy and has a heart the size of Texas. He will go all day and will be your number one partner. We have roped, cut, reined, cowhorsed, shot guns, and exposed him to a little bit of everything. Whether you want to go show competitively or just enjoy a trial ride, Gizmo will always be your number one buddy and make owning a horse fun and easy. His sweet and gentle demeanor will melt your heart each day you are around him and if safety and consistency are a number 1 priority, he will be your guy. Gizmo is one of the coolest horses that we have had a privilege to own. He’s the kind that will fit any ranch, family or individual wanting the “unicorn”!

title: Gold
excerpt: 2016 Gypsy Vanner Horse Champagne Tobiano Gelding 15 Hands
description: Gold is a Gypsy Vanner gelding! He stands 15 hands tall and has tons of shape, he has beautiful blue eyes and a gorgeous mane and tail, they don’t come much prettier than Gold! He rides English and Western! Gold is super SAFE and GENTLE! He is safe for the entire family, has been rode by all ages of kids, you can throw anyone on him and he will take care of them! He’s very broke, and really pays attention to everything you ask him, he has a nice W-T-L and very soft and graceful stop! He knows his leads and lopes very nice circles, moves very well off leg pressure, pivots around nicely! Gold does very well in new situations, he has been rode in town, does very good with traffic and loud noises! Carries the flag without any issues, has been roped off of inside and outside, good around cattle. He has also been trail rode all over, crosses water, goes over the bridges without hesitation! Not only is this guy as pretty and versatile as they come, he is a total sweetheart and in your pocket, catch him where you find him and walk up to him anywhere! He’s good to saddle, bridle, bathe and stands for the farrier, loads and hauls good, stands tied without any issues! If you would like to know more about this sweet gelding, or come take a look at him, be sure to contact us.

title: Goldie
description: Goldie is extremely broke and quiet, and has done so many different things in his life that nothing at all bothers him or spooks him. He is safe and gentle for just about anyone, with no buck, rear, bite, kick or other bad habits. He is a total gentleman on the ground, with a sweet, friendly nature. Goldie has been used for all phases of ranch work, including sorting pairs, roping and doctoring cattle in the pasture, and checking fence. Kids can literally climb all over him and it won’t bother him.

title: Goliath
description: Goliath is a real eye catcher… and he is my unicorn. He is absolutely astonishing with his golden color, long Snow White mane and tail, and balanced conformation. Goliath is so much fun to ride, super simple and push button in all areas. He is a gorgeous mover, has effortless lead changes, stylish spins and monster stops, every time.

title: Gucci
excerpt: 2016 Quarter Horse Red Roan Gelding 15.1 Hand
description: A barn favorite! We bought Gucci as a yearling and he has been on our ranch and in our program the entire time. We absolutely love this gorgeous gelding for so many reasons. Gucci is a superstar in and out of the arena. He has more miles than geldings twice his age. Go rope, ranch, show or pleasure ride, this guy will be your go-to mount. Gucci handles the very best. He rides right in between the bridle reins and goes right where you point him. He runs a flawless Cowhorse pattern with fast spins, monster stops, effortless lead changes, and perfect speed control. He is super simple and easy. Gucci is great down the fence and cuts a cow with a lot of style and grit. He has a huge heart and a lot of cow sense. He can hold the toughest one from the herd. Would make a perfect Ranch Versatility contender. Gucci is solid in the breakaway and on the head side. He breaks flat, can really run, perfect rate, stylish move in the corner and snappy face. Super easy for anyone to rope on. Gucci is perfect outside on the ranch, amazing in the sorting pens and will work the rope in the pasture. Always willing and ready for a days work. He is good with gunfire. Gucci is always gentle even with time off. He has a big personality and is fun to have around the barn. This is a very special gelding that is the real deal.

title: Gunner
excerpt: 2016 Paint Horse Sorrel Overo Gelding 14.3 Hands
description: If you want to have something a little different and have one of the most unique horses anywhere you unload, Gunner his your guy. I absolutely love, love, love this total sweetheart, gem of a horse. I can’t say enough good things about him! Gunner is as kind, honest, and easy going of gelding that I have swung a leg over. No matter your riding skills, this sweet gelding will take care of you. Gunner is fully trained in reining, ranch riding and ranch trail. He would definitely be a world show contender. He’s quiet minded, absolutely nothing bothers him and he is the same every time you saddle him. No surprises or silly business even with extended time off. Gunner is a gorgeous mover, his transitions are flawless and he rides the same for any level of rider. Completely beginner and novice friendly and compatible. Gunner is as smooth as glass and one of the most comfortable horse I have ridden. He has a rocking chair lope and a really nice slow jog on a loose rein. Just think “whoa” and the brakes come on. He will go as fast or slow as you want. He goes exactly where you point him and has great balance and good feet. We have steer stopped a jillion steers on him out of the box. He would make a super fun break away and all around type horse. If you are wanting a phenomenal show horse or the best trail riding partner that is a one-of-kind individual that will make smile every time you go to the barn, here you go! Gunner has been so much fun and he will definitely be missed around our ranch.

title: Hanna
excerpt: 2016 Tennessee Walking Horse Grey Mare 14.2 Hands
description:
Ever wanted your very own real life Breyer Doll that is living and breathing well here is your chance. Hanna is a beautiful 14.2hh Dapple Grey mare that is just truly breathtaking. This mare is 1 in a million. There really was no question how she would turn out. She has done a little bit of everything. She has been shown successfully for years.
\nSince she has been here Hanna has made a truly amazing all around horse. She is truly a horse you can lay off for months at a time. Catch her up and go enjoy her. We have had Hanna trail riding all over. We have camped with her and had her in huge groups of horses and she was always perfect. She is very confident and will go wherever you point her. She is pretty gritty as well she is definitely a horse you can ride all day several days in a row. Hanna is a forward moving horse but a very gentle forward horse. She will walk slow as you want or can cover some ground in a big flat walk if you ask her.
\nHanna has an amazing handle for a gaited horse. She will one hand neck rein around, stop on a dime and back the length of a barn. Everything with Hanna is very easy you can ride her with very little effort and movement. She will ride off your legs. She is very responsive to your legs and seat. Hanna is very very good gaited. One of the most naturally gaited horses you will ever sit on and very versatile. She will walk and shake her head or can move on out racking and never miss a beat all on 4 kegs shoes. She is very easy and anyone can make her gait.
\nHanna is super friendly and very easy to catch. She definitely has that in your pocket personality. She will even follow you around. Hanna has perfect manners in the cross ties or tied out. She stands very quietly. She is easy to clip, bathe and groom. Great for the farrier and super easy to saddle and bridle. Hanna also stands dead dead still to mount and rides off slow and easy.
\nLike I said earlier Hanna is very confident. Ride her through town, down a busy road, across a wooden bridge, down the nastiest trail you can find and know you are taken care of. If Hanna sounds like your Dream Horse please give me a call and let’s try to make this dream reality!

title: Harvey
description: Harvey is a rockstar! We love this charming, kind and handsome boy! It’s hard to find a black gelding with all his credentials. He cuts, ropes, reins, trail rides, is a deluxe ranch horse that doesn’t mind loud gunfire, crazy dogs, blowing tarps, busy traffic, large equipment and he’s ALWAYS gentle, quiet, and sane even with substantial time off. Harvey is super fun to drop your hand and go cut on. He’s athletic, talented and has a stylish look in front of a cow. He reads one like a book and is super handy in the sorting pens and can hold a tough cow from the herd. Harvey is a fun horse to go rope on. Back in the box and go rope 20, he gives you the same run each time. He’s consistent, honest and smooth. He has great rate and timing. He has a ton of speed, but makes everything effortless. Harvey will turn heads anywhere you unload him. He has an impressive look that demands your attention, but his personality is the best. He’s hands down what you want a gelding to behave like. He’s a class act around the barn and he’s the type of gelding you will enjoy owning each and every day. If the Boss Man wants to cruise around in luxury and not have a worry in the world, Harvey will be your ride. He’s dependable, sure footed, and confident alone outside. Harvey is ready to go show in the cutting, cowhorse, roping and ranch versatility events or be a superstar trail horse or top notch ranch gelding. Harvey ticks all the boxes and you will wear a pickup truck out trying to find one similar.

title: Henry
description: Henry is a double-registered Gypsy Vanner. This horse has a personality bigger than himself and his feathers. He also has official DNA filed and papers on their way back to us from the Gypsy Vanner Horse Society. He is also PSSM1 negative. This guy rides inside or outside an arena. He will take you down the trail, cross water, go up and down hills, and even pony another colt better than the rest. He has pushed around cattle, and ironically, this guy has a HUGE stop. The slide in his hind end might allow him to become the coolest working cowboy horse around. He is one of the friendliest horses I have ever met. He is the first to come (quite literally) running to the gate when he sees you. He spent the first few years of his life as a pet and was not broken out until the last 2 years of his life. He has NOT had his legs ridden off.

title: Hercules
description: Looking for safe, reliable and bombproof? This handsome gelding will check those boxes! Hercules is an insurance policy! He is the most inquisitive gelding with a huge personality. He will make you laugh every time you catch him, which is extremely easy because once he sees you, he will run to the gate and is always eager for your attention. Hercules is a trained reining horse that has been shown. He is super stylish in all his maneuvers. He has a huge stop, pretty spins, push button lead changes and circles super fancy with a low head set. He would excel in the Reining, Ranch Riding, Versatility, and Trail events. Hercules is an elegant mover and has a ton of show presence. He is as classy as they come and so easy to ride. He’s nearly on auto pilot. We have roped on Hercules out of the box. He is so easy to back in the box and go rope. He has great rate and timing. He’s loaded with natural cow sense and tracks one on a loose rein. We have ridden Hercules all over our North Texas ranch as well as many miles on trails in the Arizona desert. He has packed kids and complete beginners. He is safe, safe, safe and always quiet and gentle. He would assume go slow, but has the speed if asked. Hercules is always reliable and a steady-eddy out on the trails. He’s confident alone or good with a group. Always walks on a loose rein and definitely has more whoa than go. Nothing bothers this guy! Loud Gunfire, blowing tarps, unexpected wildlife, crazy dogs, large machinery… bring it on, he won’t be phased. Hercules has great conformation, is very balanced and just as wide as he is tall. He has the kindest eyes and will steal your heart the moment you meet him, if you like a horse that has very interactive. He treasures any attention and time you have for him. Hercules is super fancy and fun to own. We love this big teddy bear horse and he’s been one of the easiest horses we have trained and owned.

title: Hero
description: Hero is a 7-year-old HANDY broke and SAFE gelding for the whole family. He has a phenomenal handle thanks to working a ranch in all aspects including doctoring and loading cattle trucks. Hero can get around and cut one off like a 14-hand cow pony and isn’t afraid to reach down and bite a momma cow that gets too rowdy. Hero has started on the head side as well. He has been ridden by all ages and hauled on barrels by a youth. The video we have of barrels is less than ideal because that arena isn’t deep enough to really let them work. You can see he knows them and is very automatic especially in the bridleless video though.

title: Amarillo
description: Handsome, charming and 100% a gentleman in every way! You will fall head over heels in love with our sweet boy, Amarillo! He’s a people pleaser for sure! You ask, he will do it! This gelding is so sincere and kind. He will follow you around like a big puppy dog around the barn and run to the pasture gate when he sees his person. Amarillo is trained in the reining and performs all the maneuvers easily and consistently. He is a very elegant mover with the smoothest, most comfortable gaits and transitions. Amarillo has a huge stop, a lot of turn around, automatic lead change and great speed control. He has great direction with a solid neck rein. Just point and he will go right where you send him. Amarillo loves trail riding and being outside. He is very sure footed and handles himself well on rocky and rough terrain and willingly goes through running water, deep mud, thick brush and heavy wooded areas. He’s confident alone, but good with a group of horses out on the trails. He will ground tie where you drop a rein and will side pass to open all the gates. Amarillo can go long periods without any riding and he stays gentle. He’s always honest to saddle up and go. He stays trained and knows his job. He is safe and sane for any level of rider. We have steer stopped out of the head box and roped the sled on Amarillo. He tracks right in behind a steer and rates one great. We have used him to sort and doctor cow/calf pairs and used him out in big country to catch wild cows. He’s happy to do any job you though as him with his ears forward and a great attitude. He will go all day long and has no quit in him. Amarillo deserves the best home. His willingness to ride for anyone that climbs on his back and his big personality unquestionably makes him a barn favorite.

title: Hershey
excerpt: 2015 Draft cross Horse Grulla w/ Stripes Gelding 16.3 Hands
description: Here is one we have been biting at the bit to share with the world! This is Hershey, he stands 16.3 hand Grullo Draft Cross Gelding that has the kindest sole. If you want one that’s big, handsome, and possibly one of the friendliest horses we have ever had and super well broke you will fall in love with Hershey. He loves attention from the kids and people of all ages. This striking guy is as quiet as they come, easy to catch, easy to lead and a real pleasure to work around. He is 100% safe enough for any level and any age to ride, yet he will move off your leg like a quarter horse if you want. He has three awesome gaits and will walk, trot, and canter with ease. He will go either English or Western and look good doing it. He is wonderful on the trails, busy roads, and open fields. He will take you anywhere happily and then go into the arena and trot and lope circles light and correct. He is super comfy, even bareback. He walks over tarps, bridges, through water without any issues. He has no problem going out alone or in a group. He can carry your little ones and always bring them home safely. Hershey was even used by a 9-year-old boy at rodeos as a pickup horse and has been around cows as well. He is trustworthy for beginners and athletic enough for anyone to enjoy. Ride him brideless and bareback anywhere you want! Hershey is the type that doesn’t have to be ridden every day and he is the same horse every time you take him out. He would excel at any discipline and would be amazing in a therapeutic program because of his nature. He is the epitome of a “KIND EYE”. He is sound and healthy in every way and a very easy keeper.

title: Hidalgo
description: If you are looking for a versatile, quiet, safe, and talented partner, Hidalgo is your match. He is a safe mount, and excels with a beginner, intermediate to advanced level rider with good use of their aids. This horse has the heart, soundness, mind and talent to make it to the upper limits of a competitive sport such as eventing or jumpers. He loves a challenge and having a job!

title: Hildi
description: This beautiful bay warm blood gelding stands 16.3 hands tall and is clean all around. He is very talented goes off voice command and leg pressure. Very beautiful floating strides. He is a very enjoyable ride. Jumps a nice course of fences with good lead changes. We have had him out and around our ranch and on trails goes out in the cross country field as well. Would work as dressage horse or fancy fox hunter.

title: Holiday
description: Big things come in small packages! Measuring right under 14.1 hands and just as wide as he is tall! You will have to see him to believe him! Holiday is the COOLEST! No matter what you want to do horseback, grab him and get after it. Don’t tell him he’s small, he has a heart the size of Texas. Holiday is safe, gentle and kid tested and approved. You can run a reining pattern blind folded aboard him. He’s simple and easy in all his maneuvers.

title: Hunter
description: Hello Gorgeous! Take a look at this blonde bombshell. Hunter is a stunning dappled golden palomino with a long snow white mane and tail. He has been trained in the reining and performs all the maneuvers with ease. He has a rocking chair lope on a draped rein, long and smooth sliding stops, pretty spins and is an elegant mover. Hunter would be fun to go show in the Ranch Riding and Versatility classes. He is very easy and adaptive to all situations, new obstacles and new places. Hunter rides out of the trails like a dream. Nothing bothers this guy. He willingly goes through running water, rocky terrain, and is sure footed going up and down the mountains. Hunter is always gentle to ride and easy to handle even with substantial time off. He is an “old soul” in a young body. He enjoys attention and affection. He will meet you and the gate and follow you around like a puppy dog. Hunter is good around crazy dogs, blowing tarps, busy traffic, heavy machinery and loud gunfire. We have used him around our ranch and a great partner. He side passes easily to open and shut gates, stands ground tied, is confident outside alone and quiet in a group. He has a lot of natural cow and we have used him to sort cattle in pens and gather cattle out of the pasture. We have roped on him a little too. Hunter has all the tools, ability and mind to go do whatever you want to do horseback.

title: Ivar
excerpt: 2016 Belgian Warmblood Horse Bay Gelding 16 Hands
description:
2015 Belgian Warmblood Horse
\nBay Gelding
\n16 Hands

title: Jackpots
description: This fairytale friesian for sale looks like he just walked out of a DREAM—he is a WOW!!! And he has been extensively shown in dressage competitions in Holland. He has worked up through the levels in B and M level with a young female rider, who recently had a baby; and has competed extensively in 3rd level, but mostly he LOVES being adored, groomed and going on trails and hacks!! He is a true schoolmaster. With more than 30 winning points in z level (3rd level), Jackpots doesn’t have anything else to prove in the dressage arena! We promised his owner we would handpick his new owner to provide a LOVING home offering more than just more dressage competitions—so if you are just interested in competing, Jackpots doesn’t want YOU. If you wanna take him out of the stall, take his mane out of that double french braid, and go for a long gallop, riding bareback, into the sunset, and stop for a moment—telling him how wonderful he is—-Jackpots wants YOU. 166 cm tall, which is 16.1 1/4 hands TALL) .This is a really Good horse and it’s hard to find Friesians like Jackpots !!! This horse is so friendly and easy to ride, even in noisy traffic….. no problem for him! He has accumulated a tremendous list of accomplishments, competing against primarily warmbloods. His gaits are superb and VERY smooth and easy to sit. This is a son of the famous approved stallion, Uldrik–also an upper level dressage horse, recently deceased, unfortunately. Here is a truly schoolmaster that you can learn from, but don’t forget, Jackpots also likes to be ridden bareback, side saddle, and with his slow jog and lope—-will be a phenomenal western horse! He is so well behaved and easy to ride, whether you are perfecting your skills, or out on the trails—he is EASY, and truly appropriate for any level rider.And it doesn’t stop there. He is truly an exquisite mover for any discipline. He moves very freely out of his shoulder. He travels very well, and behaves WHEREVER he goes, and is loads of fun, as he is everyone’s favorite horse to ride in his barn:) He is great not only for trail rides, parades or exhibitions, but this boy is also highly educated! He is about as SAFE as they come, and very easy to ride. His ability in dressage is indisputable. He currently has over 30 winning points in Z Dressage (3rd level), which means he HAS to be scoring above 60%, and he acquired the highly coveted SPORT predicate, which is proof of his upper level dressage capability!

title: Jimmy
description: Exceptionally special in so many ways, Jimmy is the total package! Above all, his attitude and demeanor is an A+ everyday and 100% safe and gentle in every aspect. His beautiful golden color and long Snow White mane and tail are just a bonus! He would excel in Ranch Versatility, Stock Horse, Cowhorse, and Ranch Riding classes and would be perfect for a youth or beginner competitor. Jimmy has pretty spins, easy deep stops, great transitions and guides easily with a neck rein. He has a super comfy jog and lopes on a draped rein. He has a good extended trot and his speed control is spot on. He’s more of a push style ride and would assume go slow. Jimmy would be a great family horse and will give confidence to a beginner or nervous rider. He is patient and tolerant to mistakes and nothing bothers this sweetheart gelding. He is calm, steady, and quiet. Jimmy is fun to work cows on and a great partner gathering pastures and in the sorting pens. He has a ton of natural sense on cattle and is good at boxing one on the short wall. We have roped the dummy and live cattle on him too! Jimmy is a steady eddy out on the trails and is perfect alone or will follow or lead a group. He enjoys a nice leisure ride and will be the best company you can ask for. He will brighten your day and make you look forward to going to barn. He’s a fun and easy horse to own. Jimmy has great conformation and is built to last. Standing 15 hands and has a lot of structure and is very balanced. Jimmy has the pedigree, looks, ability, and disposition of a super star! We are proud to offer this exceptional gelding!

title: Jockey
description: Jockey has been the best pony for my daughter who made her showing debut on Jockey. He gave her confidence in the hunter ring from Intermediate and then to Lg. Pony Hunters qualifying for the Pony Finals then moving up to the 3′ Hunters.
