She then wanted to try the jumper ring where he was successful in the Intermediate Jumpers placing in the ribbons at every show. Jockey allowed her to expand her knowledge by taking her around a beginner novice event placing on her dressage score amongst 30 competitors, going double clean in showjumping and cross-country. He is the type of pony that can arrive at the show minutes before going into the ring without any prep. He can safely ride around fields alone and has given my daughter all the confidence to move up to the next stage of her riding. He is super easy in the barn, safe, and sound, and gets along with all. We could not have asked for a better first horse for our daughter. We hope to find Jockey his next best friend to enjoy the show ring, hunter field, or cross-country course.

title: Jubline
excerpt: 2018 Gypsy Vanner Horse Black Tobiano Mare 14.1 Hands
description: Meet “Jubline”!! She is a breathtaking Gypsy mare with the prettiest markings and huge feathering. This fantastic mare is my daughter’s horse. My daughter, who is 11 years old, has done nearly all of the training on this mare. She has been so easy from day 1. She has zero buck, rear, or anything like that. She stands 14.1 hands tall and is just about as wide lol. The only reason she is being offered is because she has too many horses and my daughter wants to buy a finished barrel horse. “Jubline” has three super smooth gaits that anyone would find so smooth. She floats when she canters, and she loves to jump. You can crawl all over her. She is just a big puppy dog and thrives on human interaction and loves to do tricks such as laying down or setting on her rump. I trust her completely because she is so trustworthy in the ground and in the saddle. She has a soft snaffle mouth, knows her leads, and she has a nice stop and backup. You can lope her out on the trail on a loose rein and she will only go as fast as you ask her to. We have extensively trail ridden her, hauled her to shows, used her to lead line complete beginners at our church youth camp, and the list goes on and on of what she has done. Jubline is a go anywhere and do anything type of horse that everyone wants. We have rode her in all kinds of terrain and had her in so many situations with loud and hectic atmospheres and she was solid. We think she would excel in an English program as well. She would be great for any rider that knows how to W-T-C. She is SAFE! Jubline has the best PERSONALITY. You can literally catch her anywhere, she and loves interacting with people. She will nicker at you and stick her head out of her stall as far as she can until you come and give her attention. She stands for farrier/vet work, hauls well and stalls/pastures with other horses. She is up to date on farrier/dental/vet work. Jubline is sound and ready to go do whatever it is that you may want to do with her. She will make someone a special partner. She is so loving and has the best personality of any horse we’ve ever had.

title: Justice
description: Justice is one of the safest, gentlest, and best minded horses you will ever find. He is kind enough for the most timid beginners yet athletic and smart enough for a seasoned fox hunter to enjoy. This horse will blow you away in every aspect. He has brains, education, experience, and attitude for any level rider to enjoy. Whether it be dressage, hunting, eventing, or just an easy trail ride, Justice will be sure to sweep you off your feet.

title: Justin
description: Cuteness overload with this picture perfect Buckskin gelding! Justin is America’s favorite color and so unique with his stunning blue eyes and huge mane and tail. His charming personality will keep you smiling and his in-your-pocket disposition will make your heart happy. Justin is safe and honest for any level of rider and all age groups from the small kiddos to the elderly. He will take the best care of the rider on his back. He never has a bad day and is truly a bonafide sweetheart. He has nice spins, an easy lead change, and a smooth sliding stop. He is a pretty mover and would be fun to go show in the reining, ranch riding, and AQHA versatility classes. His stellar looks and fancy style will definitely get you noticed in the show pen. Justin rides amazing on the trails. Just put him in cruise mode and go have fun! He crosses water, logs, bridges and navigates quietly around desert through the cactus and mountainous terrain. He’s accustomed to busy traffic, motorcycles, bicycles, blowing tarps, crazy dogs, heavy machinery, and loud gunfire. Justin is smooth and comfortable to ride. He would assume go slow, but has plenty of speed if needed. If safety is a priority, look no further! It would be very accurate to say that Justin is 100% legitimate and a one of a kind of gelding. No matter your plans for him, whether it be the show pen, trail rides, or just riding to the mailbox, Justin will make you a happy horse owner!

title: Kingsley
description: Kingsley is an absolutely gorgeous gelding that can do anything you want to horseback and looks good doing it. Kingsley cuts a cow with a deep stop, low sweep and has lots of expression. Runs a pretty Cowhorse pattern and would excel in the Versatility and Ranch events. Smooth transitions and very comfortable to ride. Kingsley has been roped on in the pasture and out of the box. Absolutely perfect in the box, leaves flat and rates great. Perfect for break away, calf roping, or the heel side. Ridden lots of outside miles and is perfect alone or in a group on trails. Kingsley is 100% gentle, quiet and sane. He is always the same even with time off. Very trustworthy and honest. You will love Kingsley’s sweet and loving disposition. He will meet you at the gate and is happy to do whatever task you ask of him. Good with gunfire, dogs, tarps and traffic. In or out of the arena, he will be your go-to mount. No wonder this sweet boy is such a neat horse. He has breeding, conformation and talent all in one package!

title: Kipper
excerpt: 2016 Quarter Horse Bay Roan Gelding 15 Hands
description: Here is a cowboy lookin’ roan that will go do anything you want to horseback. Kipper is hands down a phenomenal gelding that will go cut a cow, run a Cowhorse pattern, rope in the arena and out, and is always gentle and quiet minded. Kipper is extremely cowy with a fancy style, low sweep, and is athletic enough to hold the toughest cow from the herd. He is a monster stopper and has fast turnarounds. Kipper has lots of outside miles. He’s great in the sorting pens, will pull and hold anything dallied to the horn, can really cover the ground, and goes right where you point him. Kipper has had several roped on him out of the box. Would make a great switchender. Perfect in the box, runs flat, great rate and easy to ride. Would make an exceptional rope horse futurity contender. Would make an exceptional break away or calf horse. Kipper is as fancy of young horse as you will find. Whether you want to go show him in the Cutting, Cowhorse, Versatility, and roping or make a top ranch horse out of this guy, you can’t go wrong. Kipper is a total sweetheart with a stellar disposition, as honest as a day is long, and just an all around fun horse to own.

title: Kobby
excerpt: 2016 Paint Horse Palomino Overo Mare 15.3 Hands
description: Kobby is a stout built 15.3hh, Champagne/Palomino Overo Gelding. I have hauled him to team sorting events, took him on a few weekend camping trips and thrown a rope off of him as well… You just pick what you want to do and Kobby will gladly do the job. He has worked on a ranch, has been trail ridden in several states and I’v used him a couple times at the stockyards to pen cattle. He will cross creeks, ditches, logs and navigate rough rocky areas. He is traffic safe. He has a smooth jog, a nice lope, will slide stop, turns a circle both ways, sidepasses and backs with ease! Kobby is a confident horse on the trails and will lead the crew, head out alone or follow behind with no issues! He has been exposed to all kinds of wildlife such as deer or turkey or other animals like cows or dogs and will go anywhere that he is asked too. He has been rode many miles in the mountains and encountered every obstacle possible on the trail. He will go up or down even the steepest slopes, across deep creeks, over downed trees, and over all types of rough terrain while still being sure footed. Kobby is not cinchy, cold backed, does not crib or weave. If you’re looking for a classy looking trail or ranch horse, you have sure found him!

title: Legacy
excerpt: 2015 Quarter Horse Blue Roan Gelding 14.3 Hands
description: True BLUE roan and as handy as a leatherman! Legacy is a deluxe ranch horse, trail horse, rope horse, very trained and has a fancy handle! He’s been there and done that! As cowboy/cowgirl looking as they come and always safe and gentle! Legacy has been used for break away roping and heeling in the arena and has been used all over the ranch to doctor, gather, and sort cattle. He goes right where you point him without hesitation and is your number one partner! Nothing bothers this level headed, confident individual. He’s the kind that will entertain the entire family. Handy and fancy enough for the top ranch boss and kind and honest for the kiddos. Legacy has a good ground covering walk, smooth jog and comfortable slow lope on a loose rein. He has a great one handed neck rein and easily guides where you send him. He willingly crosses creeks and rivers, is very sure footed in the rocky mountainous terrain, and easily navigates through thick brush, deep mud, prickly cactus, and steep trenches. He’s accustomed to busy traffic, bicycles, motorcycles, and city lights. Wild dogs, blowing tarps, loud gunfire and heavy machinery don’t rattle his cage either. Legacy is a sweet boy that wants to please and get along. He doesn’t want to be wrong. This gorgeous gelding rides very nice, has excellent ground manners and is ready to do whatever you ask of him whether it be leisurely cruising down the trail or being the top ranch horse, Legacy will be your go to guy.

title: Legend
description: Hello Gorgeous! Legend has that “kind” eye, golden color, and Snow White mane and tail that will turn heads anywhere you go. We are so excited to offer this outstanding gelding that will melt your heart with his charming disposition and entertaining personality. Legend is fun to ride and ready to go any direction you desire. He is solid in the reining and ranch riding and performs all maneuvers super smooth and easy. Legend is ready to go to the show pen or ride out on the ranch or trails. Legend rides so quiet and easy outside. Always gentle no matter the situation and will ride for anyone that climbs on his back. Legend has a rocking chair lope and his gaits and transitions are smooth as glass. Legend is fun to rope on for any level of roper. Perfect in the box, runs flat with a lot of rate and timing. He is the same horse every time you saddle him even with time off. Legend is the total package and as honest as the day is long.

title: Leo
description: True all around gelding that is the real deal! Whether you want to ranch, rope, show or pleasure ride, Leo will be your go-to gelding. Anything you want to do horseback, this guy is willing and capable of getting done. He’s extremely stylish and fun to work cows on. Just put your hand down and he can hold the toughest cow from the herd. Huge, deep stop and very cow smart. Leo is the ideal ranch horse and is fancy enough for the bossman to ride. He has been used for all aspects of ranch work. Sort, drag, doctor and works a rope well. He pulls strong from the horn and can handle big cattle. Leo has been started well on the head side out of the box and used for Breakaway. Stands like a wooden Indian in the box, leaves flat and has a lot of rate. Very easy for anyone to rope on. He is the same way every trip. Leo has fancy handle, rides right in between the bridle reins and goes right where you point him. He is good with gunfire. He is kind, super gentle and honest as day is long. Safe everyday for any level of rider, even with time off. Leo has been fully vetted and radiographs clean.

title: Lilly
excerpt: 2017 Draft Percheron QH Bay Mare 15.2 Hands
description: I am proud to introduce you to “Lilly,” this is a mare the entire family can enjoy. Lilly is an amazing mare that stands 15.2hh, making her the perfect size for both kids and adult riders alike.

title: Lollipop
excerpt: 2016 Quarter Horse Red Roan Mare 15.1 Hands
description: Holy smokes! Look what we have to offer! Lollipop is a beautiful red roan with a stunning flaxen mane. Talk about broodmare potential in the future! She loves to go work cows and is smooth, consistent and stylish. She is fun and easy to go drop your hand and just hang on. You could hold a cow from the herd blindfolded. She could easily go back to the show pen in cutting, but is very versatile and could go any direction you desire. Lollipop is safe, safe, safe and gentle every time you saddle her. She can easily be ridden by beginner or youth riders. She doesn’t want to be wrong and has the heart the size of Texas. You can catch her anywhere, climb up on her and be 100% worry free of any silly business. Lollipop is naturally low headed and cruises around like a Mercedes, classy and dependable. She is very good leaded with smooth lead departures and lopes around on a draped rein. She neck reins easily with fancy spins and great direction anywhere you want to go. She has big deep stops yet smooth and easy to sit. Lollipop lays down on command with trust and confidence around blowing tarps, crazy dogs and loud gunfire. She will boldly cruise down busy highways with traffic and bicycles. She is good around heavy machinery, pigs, buffalo and even a camel. Lollipop is a straight arrow outside of the arena and nothing bothers her. She portrays confidence alone and doesn’t buddy up to other horses. She is accustomed to deep water, sloshy mud, running rivers, thick brush, prickly cactus, rocky terrain, and the wildlife that pops in and out. Lollipop has been roped on, sorted on, gathered pastures, and is handy for all aspects of ranch work. She is great turned out with other horses and will load, tie and happily ride next to all the ranch geldings without pinned ears or a marish attitude. Lollipop is a lady in the barn and a sweetheart to handle. She bonds to her people and is very trusting and eager to please. Ride her now and have one jam up broodmare in the future! Her possibilities are endless. Standing 15.1 hands and built like one is suppose to be. Few and far in between, she is the type of mare that you will be proud to own.

title: Lucky
description: Here is one of the Fanciest ranch geldings you will find! Lucky has the size, color and talent all wrapped up into one package! He’s absolutely gorgeous, hand made with tons of bone, amazing feet and the kindest eye. He’s strong and solid from the horn. If you rope it, he can pull it. He will pack you around all day with a great cowboy walk and goes right where you point him. Lucky has been used primarily in rough country on a big ranch. He has had a lot of wet saddle pads and knows all about a days work. He’s a deluxe ranch horse and big time head horse. Perfect in the box, leaves flat and runs hard, yet super smooth and will fit a lower numbered roper. Lucky is consistent, reliable and forgiving. Don’t let his size fool you. He has a rocking chair lope, perfect lead departures and can spin a hole in the ground like a reiner. He would shine in the arena in all the ranch horse classes. If you ask him, he will do it. Lucky is honest as a day is long, super kind always gentle even with time off. He will be your Go-To mount on the Ranch or in the arena.

title: Lucy
description: As Flamboyant and Fun as Vegas! This fancy showgirl has all the bells and whistles. Lucy is absolutely astonishing! She will definitely make you turn your head. Her flawless conformation, desirable buckskin color and elegant movement all wrapped up into one package! Anything you want to do horseback, here is your gal! Lucy runs a pretty reining pattern with easy lead changes, good speed control, fast spins and deep, long stops. She is extremely easy and push button. Back her in the box and some head steers! This mare can run, rate and turn some cattle. She is perfect in the box, leaves flat and has a fancy move in the corner. Very consistent and giving you the same shot every trip, she will work for any level of roper. She is extremely well rounded and nothing bothers her. She is safe and gentle even with extended time off. Lucy would make a great show horse for any level of rider and has been shown successfully by a youth kid. She is like having a nice, quiet using gelding around the barn with no “marish” tendencies. Her soft kind eyes, loving personality and sweet disposition make her a barn favorite. Lucy is hands down a great partner to do any task on the ranch or extremely competitive in multiple events in the arena such as team roping, ranch riding, Versatility and Reined Cowhorse. With her talent, looks, disposition and black-type pedigree you will have a magnificent future broodmare as well. She is 5 panel N/N.

title: Luna
excerpt: 2016 Warmblood Horse Bay & White Gelding 16.2 Hands
description: Luna is a sweet gentle, very uphill and comfortable, suitable for beginners working with a professional. Husband safe. He has a high level of rideability both in the ring and on the trail. Very experienced field hunter, point and shoot jump, collects easily. Very brave to jump and loves water. Easy to handle and more of a push ride, can take a joke, Jumps 3 feet safely and comfortably. Great with shoer, vet, children, animals, other horses. Great in the indoor arena, outdoor arena, and cross country field.

title: Lyrical
description: This is “Lyrical”, a blanketed chestnut and white Appaloosa gelding. He is loud colored, a fancy mover, and very broke. He will sit down and turn around nicely. He will slide stop when asked to whoa. He will back up for any distance that you ask him to. He lopes nice circles, fast or slow, he catches his leads, has nice lead departures, and he can do lead changes. He has been shown in the ranch pleasure classes as well. He is very gentle, super safe, honest, reliable, and dependable. There are no tricks, no surprises, and no issues. He is user friendly, sure footed, and confident. He has all the buttons you would want one to have with the gentleness to go along with it. He is quiet and well mannered in uncertain situations and he unloads in unfamiliar territory calmly. He is traffic safe, he packs saddle bags, rides bareback, and in just a halter and lead rope. He is one cool horse with lots of ride, color, size, and eye appeal. He stands 16 hands tall and he is 8 years old. He will excel as your ranch horse, show horse, trail horse, family horse, and your new best friend. He is personable, he loves attention, and he is pleasant natured. Don’t miss out on the best broke Appaloosa I have had the opportunity to ride.

title: Magic
description: Total WOW Factor! This is one big, loud colored and fancy gelding! Magic was raised on a ranch and has worked for a living and is no stranger to all phases of daily ranch work. Pasture roping, branding and dragging, sorting, feedlot exposure and also used for breaking colts. Magic is so much fun to ride outside on the ranch and on the trails. Goes right where you send him through the brush, rough terrain, mud and water and is very sure footed. Quiet, easy and smooth. Magic is solid in the team roping on the head side and is ready to jackpot on. Perfect in the box, leaves flat and runs hard. Never strong and rates a cow great. Would work for any level of roper. He is happy to do any job thrown his way in the arena or out. Don’t let his size fool you, Magic is extremely athletic and broke to ride. Turns around like a top and has a really fancy handle. Will go as slow as you want to or will kick it up a gear if asked. Super easy going gelding that loves attention and is fun to own.

title: Mariah
description: This Mariah is insanely gorgeous with tons of shape, size, pedigree, and she’s buttermilk buckskin! She is definitely “The Whole Shebang”! Plus she is a total sweetheart, family friendly, and super versatile. She is so simple and very uncomplicated to ride and operate. She pretty much has auto mode and cruise control. 100% safe, quiet, and gentle in every way and everyday. She will go as slow as a turtle or speed up to whatever gear you desire. She has a nice little jog and big ground covering long trot. She has a sweet babydoll lope and is an excellent lead changer. Naturally low headed and carries herself very level. Mariah is no different than having a good natured gelding in the barn. She’s doesn’t have mare tendencies and can be turned out with, tied next to, trailered without dividers, and rides nicely next to other horses. She doesn’t buddy up and fall in love and will happily ride away from her friends without a fuss. We love this mare for so many reasons and her cool-as-a-cucumber way of living life is a top quality of hers. Absolutely nothing bothers her and never has. She has zero spook or silliness in anyway. Whatever you send her direction, she is unfazed. Mariah rides the very best in and out of the arena. She has a lot of training and is super versatile. She would be very competitive in the Ranch events such as ranch riding, trail, rail and versatility. She is perfect over all the trail obstacles including the bridges, logs, drags, gates and we have roped on her quite a bit at well. She has very pretty spins and a nice sliding stop. Mariah rides English and bareback too and is especially smooth. She is a rockstar out on the trails and again nothing fazes her. We trust her completely and we have let kids, beginners and business men that have never ridden before cruise her down the trails and down to the Rio Verde River (she loves the water) She is great in the mountains and loves to be outside and see the sights. If you don’t have time to ride, no problem, she’s the same delightful girl you left and you can pick up right where you left off. She stays trained and gentle. Mariah ground ties where you drop a rein and crossties for a bubble bath. She’s easy peasy in the barn and has a darling disposition. She will stand quietly all day to be groomed and loved on. She is kindhearted and will lower her head for the kids to pet her and is very respectful of their size. Standing 15.1 hands it’s hard to find a mare in today’s market with this size backed by a strong blacktype pedigree. Not to mention she is America’s favorite color, BUCKSKIN. After you are done riding her, she has huge broodmare potential! This mare is first-class all the way and you will wear a pickup truck trying to find one like her.

title: Mario
description: Safe, reliable and fun is why we adore this handsome gelding that we affectionately call Mario. He’s the kind that makes the Gypsy Vanner breed so popular. This sweet gelding is absolutely stunning with a jet black body and his perfectly matching white stockings with feathers like a cheerleaders pompoms! He’s built to last with a ton of bone, great feet, and balanced conformation. Mario comes running to the gate when he sees you and has the disposition of a big teddy bear. Sweet, kind, and lovable. He doesn’t have a mean bone in his body and wants to be your buddy. Mario is a trail riding machine and is happy to pack anyone in the family. He’s made lots of miles cruising through the mountains and desert. He’s happy, trusting, and willing to go right where you pilot him. Mario has a nice one handed neckrein and is simple and uncomplicated to ride. He is super smooth with a nice ground covering walk, beautiful trot, and comfortable lope on a loose rein. He has a big stop with just the word “whoa” and will stand still and quiet until asked to move. Mario has a nice side pass, easy lead departures, and is soft in his face. We have ridden him English and bareback as well. He’s just a fun horse anyway you choose to ride him. He’s very trained in the arena, yet amazing outside with great confidence and stamina to last all day. Mario has been ridden all over the ranch to gather cattle and used at a couple brandings. He’s been roped on a few times and is game for anything you throw his way. Mario knows some fun tricks and will lay down to easily mount or dismount. He’s accustomed to crazy dogs, loud gunfire, heavy traffic, large machinery and blowing tarps. Mario enjoys attention and looks forward to being groomed and loved on. He has impeccable ground manners and will ground tie where you drop his lead. You can ride him daily or twice a year and he’s the same solid citizen being 100% absolute gentle every time you saddle him. Mario makes owning and riding a horse fun, easy and effortless. If you want to enjoy the ride, here you go!

title: Master
excerpt: 2016 Quarter Horse Blue roan Gelding 15.2 Hands
description: Who loves a True Blue Roan? That is a seasoned Head horse, been used at numerous Ranch Rodeos, cuts a cow and is one of fanciest ranch geldings you will find! Master has the size, color and talent all wrapped up into one package! Very pretty, hand made with tons of bone, amazing feet and the kindest eye. He’s strong and solid from the horn. If you rope it, he can pull it. He will pack you around all day and goes right where you point him. Master has been used on a big ranch and has sorted, drug and doctored an unlimited head of calves. He has had a lot of wet saddle pads and knows all about a days work. Perfect in the box, leaves flat and runs hard, yet super smooth and will fit a lower numbered roper. Master is consistent, reliable and forgiving. Don’t let his size fool you. He has a rocking chair lope, perfect lead departures and can spin like a top. He would excel in versatility and ranch horse classes. If you ask him, he will do it. Master is honest as a day is long, super kind always gentle even with time off. The first to contact will own this guy .

title: Maxine
description: Stunningly beautiful with a disposition and personality to die for. Maxine has beautiful movement and a natural drive for riding and driving. She’s playful yet kind, responsive, trusting and loves people while demonstrating an excellent mind and very high degree of trainability. She is currently ridden.. no down time. She rides both English and Western on the trails if you wish. Maxine has had extensive trail experience. She will cross creeks, go over bridges, through tunnels, etc. She can be shod or go barefoot. Se is excellent for the farrier and the vet. She has excellent movement for saddle seat, and could easily be a dressage star. Pre-purchase exams welcomed. She has had NO injuries,, no illness, no colic and is up to date on worming, vaccines, coggins, etc

title: Mercedes
description: Absolutely gorgeous gelding that has chrome and shape for days!!! Mercedes has a fancy paint job with a bald face and four white legs. He is conformationally very correct and balanced. He is just as wide and he is tall. Mercedes is kind, gentle and safe. He has been ridden by inexperienced riders and children. He will ride up or down to the ability of his pilot. Mercedes has been shown in the reining and performs a really pretty pattern. He has gorgeous circles, huge stops, gorgeous spins and an easy lead change. He is capable of plussing all maneuvers.Mercedes loves cows and is fun to go work one on. He would make a fantastic horse to go show in the Cowhorse & Versatility events. He’s fun to use in the sorting pens and out on the ranch. Mercedes also loves to cruise down the trails and is confident alone and good with a group. He can lead or follow, no problem either way. He is always quiet and gentle to saddle and hop right on even with time off. Mercedes is good around crazy dogs, blowing tarps, busy traffic, heavy machinery and loud gunfire. Mercedes stands about 14.2 hands, but he doesn’t know he’s a short guy and he has the heart the size of Texas. His personality will steal your soul and his soft, kind eye will make you fall in love every time you look at him. He’s such a sweet, loving and fun horse to own. Mercedes does have a small, quarter size scar on his front left knee. It will never cause a soundness issue. He will sell 100% sound in every way.

title: Mick
description:
Ever wanted to be a cowboy and ride off into the sunset? Mick is the perfect partner! He’s cowboy colored smutty buckskin with a charming quarter horse build topped off with a baby doll head. His easy-going personality shines right through his big kind eye. Fancy broke and user friendly, Mick is ready for whatever you want to do horseback. Standing a versatile 14.3 hands, and weighing in at 1200 lbs, Mick is ready to be your new best friend. His easy-going demeanor makes him enjoyable to ride to do any chore or simply take for a pleasure ride. Uncomplicated, Mick has been enjoyed by a variety of riders. Mick is pleasantly mature enough to be unbothered by new things and always stays trained even with time off. You won’t ever have to worry about anything with this kindhearted gentleman, climb on (with a saddle or bareback), and go! Mick has simple transitions, lopes collected circles, and naturally has an attractive headset. His sensible temperament makes him the perfect partner to gather cows out of the pasture, and he’s easy to sort on. An experienced rope horse, Mick is handy enough for a professional to appreciate and kind enough for a novice to learn on. Mick pays attention to rougher terrain, he’ll surefootedly pick his way up and down rocky mountains. He’ll open gates, march through water and enjoys checking out new scenery. Mick loves attention, he has impeccable ground manners. He’s good to clip, bathe, shoe – an easy going soul, Mick makes friends everywhere he goes.
\nWe have thoroughly enjoyed the privilege of having Mick in our barn and would love the opportunity to introduce you to him.

title: Mickey
excerpt: 2015 Paint Horse Bay Overo Gelding 15.3 Hands
description: Mickey is American Paint Horse Gelding. He stands 15.3 hands tall. Chief is the whole package!! He is the kind of horse everyone is looking for and the kind of horse everyone wants. He is in the prime of his life !! Very Good Looking, Rides the best and is very quiet and gentle and safe in everyway!! What more could we want ? He is as close to bombproof as you will ever find in a horse. Mickey is a great trail horse, he has been trail ridden all over! Anywhere you ask him to go on the trail he will go and never refuses or complains, he is a true trail horse deluxe !! He also rides very good in the arena and has a nice walk, trot, canter and Hits his correct leads each way. He would make a nice lesson horse, husband horse, beginner horse, kid horse , ranch horse or just a safe horse for anyone in the family wanting to enjoy a nice relaxing trail ride. Ride him once a year, once a month or once a week and he will stay good broke and ride the exact same each time. We have done some ranch work with him and he is very good at working with cattle. My favorite thing about Mickey is how quiet and gentle he is to ride. He will teach a total beginning rider how to ride and or take a timid rider and help them build their confidence. He is one of the quietest horses I have ever had the privilege to own. He will trail ride alone or with other horses and he is trail and traffic safe. If you been looking for that all around good broke, safe gelding then here he is!

title: Midnight
description: Midnight is truly a perfect pick for the entire family. This gorgeous gelding has been exposed to a little bit of everything and takes it all in stride. He is a deluxe trail horse that is a steady eddy leading a group or super chill following behind. He has plenty speed, but would assume go slow. Out on the trails and ranch he is pure joy and will carry timid riders with great confidence. Midnight makes for a quiet yet fancy ride. He is 100% extremely kind, extremely quiet, extremely well loved and will be family gentle!! He is good with loud gunfire, crazy dogs, busy traffic, heavy machinery and blowing tarps. Midnight is very smooth with a great rocking chair lope on a loose rein and a very comfortable jog. He has a nice neck rein and is very simple and easy to ride. He is loaded with natural cow and has been used on cattle and cutting horse ranches for turn back in the cutting pen and daily ranch work. He has been roped on too. Midnight has also been on the racetrack and ponied colts around the track. Anything we ask him to do he puts his ears forward and is ready and willing. Midnight will walk up to you out in the pasture and loves attention. He is very easy to own and have around the barn.

title: Missy
description: Missy is as black as your felt hat and has a huge amount of shape!. She is super stylish on a cow and reads one like a book. She has smooth gaits, will lope on a draped rein, has a big stop and pretty spins. Missy has been ridden all over our ranch and been trail ridden extensively. She is great outside and nothing bothers her. She is always gentle, quiet, and easy going. Missy has been roped on outside and out of the box. She is super easy and solid. She would work for any level of roper. She has good rate, perfect timing, and just easy all the way around. Missy has a stellar disposition and is never marish in anyway. She will stand tied and haul next to other horses. She is sweet in the pasture and will meet you at the gate. You will love everything about this mare. She’s fun to ride and easy to own. Ride her now and have an exceptional broodmare in the future! Missy is one fancy individual that you will be proud to have in the barn.

title: Moana
description:
You will be extremely hard pressed to find a more impressively bred Andalusian mare in the market today.
\nMore recently, she has shown in local hunter/jumper classes and shows a lot of promise in this area. She is ‘knees to nose’ with great footwork, form, and always makes the right decision coming up to a fence. Moana has three impressive yet comfortable gaits along with great transitions. Her trot can easily be sat or posted and her canter is likely the smoothest, most natural canter you will sit. She responds well to leg aids and has a very soft mouth. She works well into the contact when asked but will also happily go around in a looser rein.
\nMoana is an incredibly dynamic and well-rounded horse and while she’s a rockstar in the arena under English tack, she is also very light and handy broke for any Western rider. She will one hand neck rein, turn around, side pass, and has a big stop on her. She also has experience pushing cows and has been exposed to a variety of different livestock even including Water Buffalo. As if it comes as any surprise, she is a dream to take out for a day of trail riding. With Moana you can rest assured you will have the fanciest horse out on the trails this summer! She has trailered to various different parks to ride. She is not easily spooked, will go out alone or with friends, and will cross any obstacle from water to downed trees. She has great stamina and will ride for as long as your heart desires!
\nAndalusian lovers will quickly notice how true to the breed her personality is. She is super intelligent and willing which makes working her a breeze. Like any great mare she is super loyal and puts her whole heart in whatever you ask of her. Moana is super easy to have in the barn and turns out with a heard of geldings without issue. She has excellent ground manners and could stand for hours to be loved and groomed on. Moana stands for the farrier without issue, clips, bathes, and trailers like a dream. She a pleasure to have around and as uncomplicated as they come.
\nWe have thoroughly enjoyed every day we got to own this special mare and can’t wait to see where she goes next.
\nPlease reach out to us for further questions or to set up a time to meet Moana.

title: Mocha
description: Here is the “real deal” kind of gelding! Mocha is so handsome and a perfect gentleman in all situations. Go cut, rope, ranch, or trail ride and do it all in style! If you have a one horse trailer, this will be the one you load. He has a smooth, sweepy, low style that gets him noticed in the show pen. He reads cattle like a book and is so smart and accurate. He is so much fun doing anything cattle related. Mocha is a point and go type of horse. He’s a willing partner and will go right where you send him without hesitation. He walks out good on a loose rein and is amazing cruising down the trails. Nothing bothers this confident soldier. He’s safe, sane and reliable for all levels of riders. Mocha has a smooth jog and comfortable lope. He’s simple and easy to operate with a good neck rein. He’s a solid ranch horse that knows all about a wet saddle pad and a long days work. He’s very sure footed and perfect out in rocky, mountainous terrain. Nothing bothers him and he’s confident alone or quiet in a group. He is good around crazy dogs, blowing tarps, busy traffic, heavy machinery and loud gunfire.

title: Montana
description: Montana is the true “Barbie Doll” of horses. He is absolutely astonishing with flawless conformation, gorgeous golden color and a Snow White mane and tail that go on forever. He’s a dream to ride, so smooth and push button. He can easily plus all maneuvers with a ton of talent and athletic ability. His fancy looks and showy style will definitely get you noticed in the show pen along with anywhere you take him. Montana has a lot of natural cow with great rate and cow sense. He’s making a fancy switch ender rope horse. Great in the box, leaves flat, runs hard, stylish move in the corner and has a snappy face.

title: Moonshine
description: Moonshine is the color of gold! Anything you are cowboy enough to do, this gelding will be your go-to mount, yet he is gentle for the entire family. Dad can cowboy on him, mom can look fancy on him, and the kiddos can have fun and be safe on him. He’s easy and consistent. Monster stopper, extremely cowy, gritty and athletic. He has a rocking chair lope on a draped rein and is very comfortable to sit. Moonshine has a great cowboy walk and knows what a days work is. He’s been there and done that. Drag calves to the fire, rope and tie one down in the pasture, team rope out of the box, or just go trail ride. Moonshine’s sweet disposition will steal your heart. He’s as honest as a day is long and someone is going to get a very special gelding sale day.

title: Mylene
description: Check out this bombshell! Mylene has that shapey body, blonde hair color, dynamite pedigree, and sweetest personality to make anyone fall head over heels! Enjoy riding her now and breed her later, she has all the elements to make an outstanding mama! Mylene is a people pleaser and loves attention. She is charming, charismatic, and inquisitive, yet very respectful and never oversteps her boundaries. Mylene was originally trained for reining and happily will perform all the maneuvers. She is very stylish and would definitely get noticed in the show pen, excelling in ranch riding! She has a gorgeous extended trot, super easy lead change and is push style making her very biddable and easy to maneuver in the arena. She guides willingly and stays right between your bridle reins. Mylene is amazing and unbothered by any and all the trail obstacles in and out of the arena. She has never been reactive or spooky towards anything and is confident and trusting of her rider. Mylene is extremely comfortable to ride and so smooth. You can sit her jog and lope all day long. She’s very gentle, quiet minded, and honest everyday. She’s amazing on trail rides alone or will follow or lead a group. Whatever you want to do, she’s a happy camper to listen. Mylene is good with other horses. She gets turned out, tied and trailered next to horses without any mare tendencies. She will meet you at the gate and follow you around like a puppy. Bareback, English, Western, bridle or bridle-less, Mylene is trained, fun and worry-free.

title: Nacho
description: You won’t find another like Nacho! Extremely fancy with mane and tail Galore! He is quiet in the box, leaves flat, can really run, good in the corner and has a snappy face. He is easy and honest for any level of roper. Nacho is good with gunfire, dogs, tarps and traffic. He is very trained, safe and quiet outside the arena. He will go right where you send him over and through any terrain. Nacho loves trail rides and pleasure riding and is confident alone or good with a group. Stays 100% gentle even with time off and has been ridden by children. He is the same ride every time you saddle him. This astonishing gelding is the entire package.

title: Olaf
description: This phenomenal ranch gelding has been used outside his entire life. Olaf is not only gorgeous but a great horse! Has had an unlimited amount of cattle roped and doctored on him in the pasture and sorted thousands of cattle in the pens. Olaf is very cowy and can hold a tough cow from the herd.

title: Outlaw
description: Outlaw is an absolute knockout with his stunning golden color and Snow White mane & tail that goes on forever! He definitely turns heads everywhere you take him. His inquisitive, loving and sweet personality will seal the deal and his calm and quiet demeanor will make you fall in love over and over. Outlaw has been trained in the reining and does all maneuvers easily. He has a comfortable jog and lope on a draped rein and is more of a push-style horse. If you think whoa, Outlaw slides to a stop. He has stylish spins, easy lead changes and you can close your eyes in a run down and he stops pretty every time. Outlaw has a naturally level headset and is an elegant mover. He has Ranch Riding and Ranch Versatility written all over him. He guides willingly and directly. Outlaw has been all over our ranch and would make the fanciest ride for the ranch Foreman. He walks out nicely, easily side passes to the gates, and knows what a days work is all about. If you need to go rope a steer in the pasture and doctor one, he will work the rope and do his part. Outlaw is always gentle and completely beginner friendly. He is a super fun horse to have around the barn and always game for whatever the day may bring. Whether his job is babysitting the kiddos or packing around your mother-in-law or spending a day in the sorting pens or out on the ranch, Outlaw will be your go-to. Nothing bothers this gorgeous gelding. Bring on the rough terrain and mud, blowing tarps, crazy dogs, noisy traffic, loud gunfire, pushy pigs and even a giant camel. Outlaw is a barn favorite. He is the entire package. Black-type pedigree, stunning looks, balanced conformation, puppy-dog disposition, and the talent and willingness to do anything you want to horseback.

title: Paco
description: Check out this young great trail companion that’s sweeter than pie! “Paco” is 14.3 hand, paint gelding that has a lot to offer! He’s nice to look at and is a pleasure to ride!! He’s quiet on trails and is extremely gentle! Paco loves to gather cattle and isn’t afraid of water, tarps, trucks, or wildlife! Despite his size, he is soft and easy to ride with 3 lovely gaits and exceptional ground manners to boot! He rides in the arena or down the trail and is simple and very uncomplicated for anyone who puts a leg over him. He’s a trail boss- will go over, through and whenever you point him! Paco will go out alone or in a group and isn’t afraid of taking on new obstacles. He has a very willing disposition and is extremely easy to please! Paco is great for the farrier, loads, ties, clips, and will literally beat you to the gate when trying to catch him! He stands at the mounting block and is quiet when you saddle him! Paco is extremely sweet and in your pocket! If you’re looking for phenomenal trail gelding with a hard to find mind, look no further!!

title: Parfect
excerpt: 2014 Quarter Horse Red Dun Gelding 14.3 Hands
description: 100% safe and approved for anyone and everyone! This sweet gelding known as Parfect is an absolute saint. He has literally been exposed to everything you can possibly imagine. A little background on him… We have shown Parfect in the Stock Horse classes such as reining, ranch riding, cowhorse and ranch trail. Parfect has seen the sights, the sounds, and the electric atmosphere of it all and nothing bothers him! Parfect has been taken well care of and loved. He’s in amazing shape and has his entire life ahead of him to be loved by another family. He is the best confidence builder and safety assurance you will find. He is so honest, so kind, and so forgiving. Parfect is trained in reining and performs all the maneuvers easily. He has the easiest lead change ever. He has smooth, pretty spins and easy-to-ride sliding stops. Parfect is a gorgeous mover and excels in the Ranch Riding! He guides so easily and always has a beautiful presence. Parfect has seen every trail obstacle in and out of the arena. He willingly goes over logs, bridges, sides passes to gates and through creeks and lakes. Parfect has been ridden a million miles bareback by the kids all over the cattle ranch. He’s been used to gather cattle in large pastures and sort in pens. He is amazing on the trails and is confident alone or will lead a group or happily trail behind. Parfect has lived with crazy dogs, pigs, buffalo, camels and a zebra. He’s fine with wildlife, gunfire, traffic, mountainous terrain, prickly cactus, deep water, thick brush and wide open spaces. Parfect has the smoothest gaits with a pitter-patter jog and rocking chair lope. He will only go as fast as you ask and has a complete off switch. He stands perfect at the mounting block or will lie down with a touch of the finger. Parfect also pulls the wagon and a cart. From the first day he was confident and loved it. We have cruised him all over our ranch and around the countryside. He’s perfect alone and happy to go wherever you send him. He stands quietly and patiently while hooked up and stands like a wooden Indian until asked to move out. He drives easily for anyone and is safe in all situations. This gelding is worth his weight in gold to the right home. He’s a happy horse that wants to be loved and adored, a trustworthy partner that you can do anything you can dream of horseback, and as picture perfect pretty as they make with his gorgeous dun coloring, dorsal striped back, tiger striped legs, and flawless conformation. Parfect is the real deal and we are proud to offer him to his forever home. You must watch his video to see how versatile this perfect gelding is and how well he takes care of his kids.

title: Patrick
description: We love our boy, Patrick! Here is one horse that can do it all. Anything you need to do horseback, he will be your go-to and makes the job much more enjoyable. He’s also been seasoned, hauled and shown in team roping on the head end in AQHA shows and jackpots. Patrick has been roped on by a #4 to #8, including my wife that is true beginner roper. He’s easy in your hand and never strong. He leaves the box smooth, runs flat, has a good corner move and snappy face. He has great timing, perfect rate, and plenty of speed. He is quiet in the box with no silly business. You can rope 20 and he’s the same every trip. Patrick’s eager to please and doesn’t want to be wrong. He’s incredibly easy to train and easy to get along with. He’s extremely adaptive and goes with the flow no matter the job or task. Patrick is super easy to do all the reining and Cowhorse maneuvers on with fast spins, long stops, and automatic lead changes. His cow work is spot on and he’s push button to ride. He’s gritty down the fence and stylish on the short wall. Just point and go. He knows his job better than most his riders. Extremely cowy with all the talent and athletic ability wrapped up into one package. Patrick is easy to operate and will ride up or down to the level of rider on his back. If you want a solid, been-there-done-that all-around gelding, Patrick will be the one you catch. He ground ties where you leave him, willingly side passes to open and shut all the gates and is steady eddy through all types of terrain. He’s perfect out of the trails and has been exposed to all types of country. Patrick stays trained and stays gentle even with significant time off. He will fit anyone and everyone no matter how old or young you are or whether you are a top horseman or complete novice. He’s been a special gelding to us.

title: Patriot
excerpt: 2015 Quarter Horse Bay Roan Gelding 15 Hands
description: Here is the complete package! This stunning bay roan gelding checks all the boxes! You won’t find a more kind, honest and sweeter gelding than Patriot! Whatever you want to do horseback, this will be your guy! Wether you need to do a days work or just ride to the mailbox, you will enjoy riding Patriot. He is absolutely gentle and safe for anyone and everyone! Great horse to gain confidence for a timid rider. He will ride up or down to whatever speed you desire. Patriot cuts a cow and is super handy to use for gathering and sorting. He easily side passes to gates quietly stands while you open and close them. He rides great outside and is confident alone. He goes right where you send him without hesitation and is steady in all types of terrain. We have roped on him in and outside of the arena. Patriot is cool as a cucumber in all situations and circumstances. He is super smooth and comfortable to ride. He will eagerly meet you and the gate and very quiet and gentle to handle. Standing 15 hands, it’s hard to find one with his breeding that has his shape and size.

title: Peach
excerpt: 2014 Quarter Horse Red Dun Gelding 14.3 Hands
description: Peach is absolutely the most adorable gelding with a stout bulldog build, super fun color, large dorsal stripe down his back and tiger striped legs to his belly. Peach rides as good as he looks and is extremely versatile. He does everything! From reining, ranch work, cow work or just a fun, safe ride out on the trails this will be one that you will enjoy each and every ride. Always gentle, honest and easy going even with time off. Saddle him up and go enjoy! Peach easily performs all the reining maneuvers with long sliding stops, snappy spins and easy lead changes. He would be fun to show in the Ranch Riding and Versatility events. He has a super smooth jog and rocking chair lope. He has been ridden all over our Texas ranch as well as many miles in the Arizona. He is confident alone out on the trails and will go right where you point him. He is very sure footed and has a good outside walk. Peach is a very people friendly horse that loves any kind of attention making him super fun and easy to have around the barn. If you want to go show, pleasure ride, or both, Peach is a perfect fit and complete gentleman for any level of rider.

title: Pepper
description: Hello Handsome! Pepper is a super classy, talented His gentle, kind and eager to please disposition make him first class in my books! He is fun to ride and a total sweetheart! Standing 15 hands,Pepper is very balanced and well put together. This elegant moving gelding has a ton of presence in the arena with his glowing dark coat, level top line and naturally low head set. Pepper has a solid reining foundation and all of his maneuvers are pretty impressive, easily earning pluses in the show pen. Pepper has a one hand neck rein, smooth, slow lope and a comfy jog. He has fancy spins, effortless lead changes and big, pretty stops. He is naturally made for the reining, ranch riding and Versatility Classes. He has the cadence, looks and the mindset to take you all the way. Pepper excels outside the arena as well. He’s very quiet and calm on the trails and has been exposed to all kinds of activity. Loud gunfire, busy highways, blowing tarps, crazy dogs, pigs, camels. You name it, he has probably seen it. Pepper is a superb partner on the ranch and knows what a wet saddle pad is all about. He has a ton of natural cow and is fun to use sorting steers, pushing cows pasture to pasture, and he will drag anything you dally up. Whether you are in the show pen or on the trail he will always make you look good, no matter your task at hand. Pepper will meet you in the pasture and loves attention. He has quiet ground manners and is patient, and kind. I think the world of this sweet boy and I know he will be loved in his new home!

title: Phantom
excerpt: 2017 Quarter Horse Buckskin Dun Gelding 15.1 Hands
description: Here is possibly the most astonishing gelding we have offered through our program. Phantom is the American dream! He absolutely has the kindest disposition and a heart of gold. He is 100% bombproof gentle and tolerant for anyone. If you want an insurance policy, here you go. He has stylish circles, fast spins, long sliding stops, and effortless lead changes. He would make a world champion style ranch rider and ranch versatility horse. He demands attention in the show pen with his bold presence. Phantom is a push-style type of horse and likes to go slow, but has all the speed you would want if needed. He is amazing outside and enjoys to leisurely cruise down the trails. He is perfect alone or good with a group. He stands ground tied, will side pass to open all the gates, and his very sure footed. Phantom has seen a little bit of everything. Nothing bothers this confident gelding. He’s accustomed to crazy dogs, enormous Longhorns, pushy pigs, buffalo, and even a camel. He has been in all types of terrain and goes right where you point him. Phantom loves attention and will run to the gate when he sees you. He’s very easy to handle in all situations. There is nothing tricky to him. He’s as pure and honest as you will find. He’s been receptive and easy going about everything we have exposed him to. Standing 15.1 hands, we absolutely love this big guy and are excited to offer him. He’s truly a once in a lifetime kind of horse and partner.

title: Phyno
description: Phyno the ROCKSTAR!! He does it all!!! Been there- Done that! Reining, Ranch Riding, TRICKS, Trail, Gentle, Roping, Gorgeous, kid Approved, Halter, Phenomenal and loud colored!!

title: Picasso
excerpt: 2016 Missouri Fox Trotter Pinto Mare 15.1 Hands
description: Who Says you can’t have it all? Well, you can with Picasso. She has all of the Beauty and Reliability to match. She is a Very Safe and Gentle horse to ride. Picasso is so gentle and has such a calm and easygoing nature. She is the type of horse that you can put beginners on, or when company comes over she is the go-to horse that will take care of a new rider. She is a great trail-riding horse, you can always know with her that you are going to have a Safe and enjoyable ride. Picasso is content to just walk along slowly and easily. Picasso is the same trustworthy horse to ride whether she is by herself or with other horses. Take a look at her video and see what an outstanding horse she is! At the end of the video you will see a 75-year-old lady who had not ridden in 25 years, that asked to ride Picasso when I was at the park with her.

title: Picolo
excerpt: 2015 Paint Horse Bay Tobiano Gelding 14.2 Hands
description: If safety AND looks are a priority he is your guy. And talk about unique. He turns heads wherever he goes. He is a trail riders dream! He has been trail ridden a lot, and he has been exposed to all kinds of trail obstacles. Picolo has also been used at playdays, and he has heeled several steers out of the box and shows a lot of potential there. We’ve never had one as sweet and gentle as he is. He also knows how to come and pick you up off of a mounting block or gate for easy mounting. Picolo is the one we always use to carry flags at rodeos and parades. He loves attention, he meets you at the gate, and he will do anything you ask him to do with a good attitude. This gelding has very smooth gaits and he knows his leads. He has a one hand neck rein handle, he has a nice spin, and he stops good, too. Picolo has been exposed to loud noises, ropes, traffic, dogs, water, bridges, huge crowds, and he takes it all in stride. I really can’t say enough good things about him. He is the kind you don’t find every day. You don’t want to miss him.

title: Pirate
description: Pirate will be one of the fanciest horses anywhere you take him. Standing 15.1 hands, he is breathtaking gorgeous and has the talent, mind, and ability to go do anything you want to do horseback. If you own a one horse trailer, he will be your one stop shop! He would excel in Cowhorse events or make a jam up ranch versatility competitor. He has big, deep stops, lopes pretty circles on a draped rein, and spins like a zero-turn lawn mower. Pirate knows all about ranch life. He’s sure footed, has a great ground covering walk, and will go right where you point him. Pirate has been roped on in the arena, out in the pasture and in the branding pens. He is good with loud gunfire, heavy machinery, blowing tarps, busy traffic, crazy dogs and whatever else you want to throw his direction. Pirate is safe, sane, tolerant and gentle for any level of rider. You will wear out a pickup truck trying to find one this versatile, fun to ride, and easy to own. His attractive looks and black type pedigree are just a bonus.

title: Prince
description: Prince is the sweetest pony you’ll ever meet! This little guy is as gentle as can be, making him perfect for riders of all experience levels. His adorable looks make everyone fall in love with him at first sight, and his friendly nature just adds to his charm. Whether you want to ride him or drive him, Prince excels in both areas. Don’t let his age or size fool you, Prince can loop a pretty circle like a big horse and always takes care of his rider. His easy-going nature and willingness to please make every ride a delightful experience. Whether you’re a beginner or an experienced rider, Prince’s friendly demeanor and impressive riding and driving skills ensure that you’ll have a fantastic time with him. He truly is a gem in the world of ponies, bringing happiness and fun to all who have the pleasure of meeting him. Prince has been ridden many miles down the trails, in the busy streets of town, competed in the local horse shows, as well as been used as a lesson pony. Prince is always a fan favorite whether it’s showing off his fun tricks of laying down or sitting, to cruising him around in the pony cart. So much fun can be had with him whether you are big or small.

title: Queen
description: Supermodel astonishing! They just don’t come much fancier than this 14.3 hand buckskin mare that has dapples, mane and a tail for days! Queen is the whole shebang with a power packed pedigree, conformationally correct, very versatile all around trained and her color is just a bonus. At 5 years old, she has her entire life ahead of her. Ride her now and have one heck of a future broodmare! Queen has a reining foundation with pretty spins, balanced circles, easy lead change, and a deep stop. She has great lead departures, a nice side pass and is good with the logs, drags, bridge, and other trail obstacles. She has a slow, smooth, rocking chair lope and cute, little jog. Queen has been worked on cattle in the cutting pen and been roped on. We have used her all over our ranch to move and sort cattle. She is very cowy and has a lot of try. She is very adaptable and could go many directions. She is a pretty mover, naturally level headed with a ton of eye appeal and presence. You can’t walk by her and not take a second glance. Queen is a trail riding machine. She’s as brave and confident outside as any horse and rides great alone or is good in a group. There isn’t anywhere she won’t go. Through the mud, water, around the prickly cactus, brush, rocks, just point and go, she won’t hesitate or say no. Queen is always gentle to saddle up and go even with time off. She has great ground manners and will ground tie anywhere you drop a rein. She loves getting attention and being groomed and pampered. Queen is good with other horses and can be tied next to, trailered with and turned out with a group of horses without marish tendencies. She’s easy to own and have around the barn.

title: Queency
excerpt: 2017 Paint Horse Red Roan and White Mare 15 Hands
description: I’m going to show you the fanciest mare I have ever offered! Queency is as cute as a button and will get you noticed anywhere you take her!

title: Rambo
description: Rambo has made us understand the craze for “feather” footed horses. His gentle, kind demeanor is second to none. We love this big, gentle giant. He is 100% safe on the ground and on his back. He will pack any level of rider, young or old. Rambo is sired by a Quarter Horse/Percheron stallion and out of a Friesian mare. He is jet black and measures 16 hands. To start your day with Rambo simply whistle at the pasture gate and he comes like a big lovable puppy dog. Then signal him to lie down and climb aboard. Or stand on your mounting block and he will side pass over to you and stand quietly until asked to move forward.

title: Ramos
description: Seriously cuteness overload with his gorgeous dappled gray color and precious defined head with soft, kind eyes that will touch your soul. Ramos is beyond his years and is truly an old soul. With the very best beginning and foundation, Ramos just didn’t want to go quite that fast and be the superstar athlete they needed him to be. So with that being said, Ramos does all the fun Reining maneuvers and has all the fun buttons, but would rather do things on a lower scale. He has cute spins, easy changes leads, and has a smooth sliding stop. He is a gorgeous mover and is very push-style. He would excel is Ranch Riding or Ranch Versatility competition. Ramos always saddles up gentle even with time off. He just wants to get along and be a good boy. He is simple and easy to ride and just a fun horse to have around. I truly believe he enjoys seeing the wildlife and taking in the beautiful scenery. He knows where his feet are and can navigate easily on the granite rock, through the prickly cactus and is sure footed through rocky and mountainous terrain. He will guide right where you send him willingly without hesitation. We have roped the dummy and the lead steer a ton on Ramos. He will run right up to a cow and has great rate and timing. He’s handy to use all around the ranch and will side pass to open all the gates, cross bridges, drag logs, and ground ties where you drop a rein. Ramos will follow you around like a puppy dog demanding attention and will run to the gate when he sees you eager to be caught. He is a great size standing 14.3 hands with flawless, stocky conformation. Ramos knows some fun tricks and has been exposed to a little bit of anything and everything. He’s a happy camper that has handled all the shenanigans we have thrown his way. He has an inquisitive and humorous personality making him fun to work with. Ramos is cute as a button, super gentle, and will fit so many people! Check him out if you are wanting one ABOVE AVERAGE!

title: Randy
description: Quality through and through defines this handsome 8 year old gelding we affectionately call Randy! Standing 15.2 hands and stamped with America’s favorite color, buckskin, this striking gelding has so much to offer. Randy rides western, English, bareback or whatever strikes your fancy. He is safe, sane, and very calm in every aspect of his life. He has an ample amount of training in the arena and a great deal of exposure outside on the trails and throughout the ranch. Randy is always quiet, gentle and easy to handle on the ground and on his back. His ground manners are impeccable always being sweet and respectful. He is your model citizen gelding all the way around. He stands quiet as a church mouse to groom, bathe, tack up and mount up. He will side pass over to the mounting block, fence or lay down with a touch of the finger for you to climb aboard. Randy is beginner friendly, very tolerant, and unbothered by mistakes or miscues. He’s never anxious or worried about different places or new situations. Randy has a solid reining foundation and lopes soft collected circles and has a supple face and ribcage. He has nice spins, rollbacks, and side passes. He steers great with a one handed neck rein and stays right in-between the reins. Wherever you point him, he goes. Randy is a very graceful and elegant mover. He has the smoothest, most comfortable and easy to sit gaits. With an impressive big long trot, a slow jog that you can enjoy all day, and his lope is slow, steady and pleasant. Randy looks absolutely stunning under an English saddle and has western dressage written all over him. We have started him over smalls jumps and obstacles and he loves it. He never says no and will cross anything in his path. Randy spent the first few riding years of his life hitting the trails. He has seen every national forest and state park in our region. He is accustomed to mountains in the desert and high country, all types of water features, roaming wildlife, and overnight camping. He’s a soldier outside and will take care of his rider. He’s not spooky or watchy in anyway. He is very sure footed and knows where his feet are at all times. Randy is very useful all over the ranch. He’s good in the sorting pens and has gathered lots of cattle. We have tracked a lead steer in the arena and roped on him as well. He will follow right in behind a steer and track them nicely. He is accustomed to busy traffic, bicycles, motorcycles, loud gunfire, crazy dogs, blowing tarps, and heavy machinery. Randy is always a pleasure to ride in the arena, out on the trails, or anywhere on the ranch. It’s hard to find a horse with his size that has a modern day, blacktype pedigree.

title: Rascal
description: Come fall in love with our sweet boy, Rascal! This adorable gelding will quickly steal your heart with his big personality, gentle disposition, fabulous talent, and did I mention he’s America’s favorite color, Buckskin! He circles beautiful with amazing speed control, has effortless lead changes, pretty spins and a big, smooth stop. Rascal is an elegant mover with great direction and guides easily. He would excel in the Ranch Riding classes and Ranch Versatility events. New places and faces do not bother him, he’s cool as a cucumber. Rascal is safe, sane and gentle for any level of rider. He comes in a “fun size” package standing 14.2 hands which makes him easy to mount and dismount. If you can get on him, you will be able to ride him. He’s very forgiving and wants to please his rider. He’s dependable and honest in all situations. Rascal loves to cruise down the trails and is confident alone or quiet in a group. You can lead or follow, it doesn’t make a difference to him. Rascal is good around crazy dogs, blowing tarps, busy traffic, heavy machinery and loud gunfire. He will meet you at the gate and hang around like a barn dog. He loves attention and enjoys people. Rascal is one fancy ride and so much fun to have around the barn. Come check out this gorgeous gelding, he will not disappoint.

title: Rebel
description: Take a look at this hand-made dappled palomino that has the prettiest little head, big soft eye and stands 15 hands. Rebel rides as good as he looks! He has a reining foundation and is solid in all the maneuvers. Quick footed spins, sliding stops and he lopes around gorgeous on a draped rein. He has smooth gaits and comfortable to sit, including his jog. Rebel has been started in the arena roping both ends and has also roped some in the pasture. He’s naturally very cowy and pins his ears behind a steer with great rate. He has plenty of speed with great control and is quiet in the roping box. Rebel takes everything in stride. He has a calm demeanor and new things don’t bother him. He’s good with loud gunfire, busy traffic, crazy dogs, heavy machinery, and blowing tarps. Rebel is fun on the trails and has no spook to him. He is very sure footed and great in the rocky and rough terrain. We have ridden him all over the desert, through all the cactus, into running water, and though the mountains. He will lead a group or follow behind just enjoying the ride. Rebel is the same each time you saddle him with no tricks to him. Just jump on and go, saddled or bareback, he’s always gentle. He’s super easy to catch and will greet you at the gate. He enjoys the attention and love given to him. This is super cute gelding that anyone will be proud to own.

title: Red Bloom
description: As cowboy lookin’ as they come and stamped with dun factor galore! Red Bloom has a black face, tiger-striped legs up to his belly, a thick dorsal stripe, and bulldog-style conformation measuring just as wide as he is tall. He will perform all the reining/cow horse maneuvers with an easy lead change, solid spins, and a stylish sliding stop. He’s a pretty mover with a naturally low headset. He has a rocking chair lope with pretty circles, a nice ground covering a long trot across the pasture, and a super smooth jog that you can sit all day long. Red Bloom has been used for all types of cow work. He’s been cut on, boxed on and down the fence. He’s loaded with natural cow and has a pretty working style. He’s quiet and easygoing and will not shake up a herd. Red Bloom has been roped on in the pasture, steer stopped out of the box, and roped the sled. He has great rate and timing which lets you focus on roping. He is very smooth and comfortable to ride. We have ridden Red Bloom a million outside miles. He is an absolute dream to ride outside and willingly goes right where you point him through rocky and rough mountain terrain, running river water, knee-deep mud, tall brush, and prickly cactus. He side passes to open and shut all the gates, smoothly goes over the logs and bridges, and will drag whatever you dally to the saddle horn. Red Bloom is very easy to handle on the ground and is always gentle. He is the same horse every time you saddle him with zero silly business. He is good with noisy traffic, loud gunfire, blowing tarps, crazy dogs, and wildlife. Red Bloom has all the talent and ability to go to horse shows in the Ranch Versatility, Ranch Riding, and Cowhorse events. He would be a phenomenal ranch horse that is fancy enough for the boss man to ride or he would be just as happy being your partner for the recreational trail rides or avid cross-country competitions. Red Bloom’s distinctive and “ranchy” look has a presence that turns heads everywhere we take him. This is an outstanding young gelding that can easily go in any direction!

title: Rex
description: Colored up like golden coins and treasured even more is our handsome, saint of a gelding we all love, Rex. If you are in the hunt for a babysitter, confidence builder, and a tolerant packer here is your guy. You can look at his big, soft, kind eye and just tell he’s a good one! He will go as fast or slow as you want. He has pretty spins, balanced circles, great speed control, automatic lead changes and is a monster stopper. But if the arena isn’t your thing Rex is equally as great outside on the trails and all over the ranch. He’s happy to go wherever you point him and confident in all circumstances. Through the water, up the mountains, around the prickly cactus, down the busy roads, through the neighborhoods with bikes and strollers, nothing fazes him. Rex has the most forgiving and acceptable attitude. He would make a great first horse for beginners or kids to learn on, but has all the buttons and tools to be competitive and one you won’t outgrow. Rex is easy and push button to ride. He rides western, English, bareback and bridle-less. He’s super comfy with a sweet little jog and perfect slow lope. He collects nicely or will maintain the same speed on a draped rein. He’s going to be more of a push style horse, but trained and honest enough he doesn’t require spurs. He has beautiful lead departures with just a smooch and just say “whoa” and he will stop and stand like a wooden Indian. He will lay down to mount or dismount, stand quietly at a mounting block, or scoot over next to a fence. Rex has an A+ disposition and is 110% a gentleman all the way around. Never rude or pushy, just a sweet laid back teddy bear that enjoys attention, grooming, bathes and loving. Rex is the total package bound together with that sought after palomino color, prime age of 7 years old, black type pedigree, talent and ability, and the mind and disposition of a winner. He is a great size standing 14.3 hands with balanced and correct conformation. Rex is a champion in our barn and in our hearts. He’s a special kind of horse that deserves the best forever home.

title: Ringo
description: Ringo is a 2015 off-track Thoroughbred gelding by multiple leading sire, Into Mischief, and out of a multiple stakes-producing daughter of Tale of the Cat. This race winner has been used as a ranch horse and shows talent working cattle. Has lots of miles under his belt doing ranch tasks, such as gathering big pastures, sorting, and pen work, and has been started on basic roping. Has a great disposition with looks and nice ground manners. Good to catch, saddle, tie, shoe, load, clip, bathe, and no stable vices. This young gelding came directly from the breeder. Registered but papers not available. Videos available. Contact for more

title: Rita
excerpt: 2016 Paint Horse Black Tobiano Mare 13.2 Hands
description: We sell with 100% total confidence so that you can buy with extreme confidence!!! Rita is sold with a 30 days money back guarantee. It’s that simple if you don’t like her for any reason. All you have to do is return her to us in the same condition that she left in and you will get 100% of the purchase price back. Rita ….is a 13.2 hands black and white mare pony. You will search the world over and never find another like her very rare opportunity here. She rides around like a big horse. If western riding is your thing just listen to the résumé she is a finished ranch pony. Has drug the calves to the fire for branding caught wild loose cattle on the ranch and done everything and every chore ever ask with no hesitation. Put her in the arena and it’s game on she is finished heading and heeling team roper. Does the breakaway as well boxing/penning and goat tying. Will trail ride the very best nothing scares her. Also will run the barrel pattern for beginners on up. Has been shown in the reining and cutting. On the English side of it she will jump a full 2’6 course with beautiful lead changes. Rita is truly a very versatile once in a lifetime individual. Her every day manners around the Ranch are impeccable if you are and adult or child she will suit you this pony is extremely broke in all disciplines. There won’t be a dry eye in the barn the day she leaves for her next life adventure . Rita is what every child dreams of she a dream come true…Trust me when I say this I would put her up against anyone’s horse or pony in any activity on horseback. I’ve own thousands of horses in my life and she is good as they get. She is UTD on All vet and farrier care we can help find shipping anywhere in the US.

title: Robinhood
description: Going far beyond the ordinary, Robinhood is what dreams are made of! Faithful, Smooth, Reliable, Gentle, and handmade perfection. We are excited to introduce you to this versatile horse! His versatility and gentle nature make him a trustworthy choice. Robinhood has been ridden by various levels of riders at our ranch, on the trails and in the arena. We notice that he works at his rider’s level and is non-reactive to mixed cues. A total LOVE bug who looks forward to his time with his person daily. He is captivating to ride in & out of the arena and uncomplicated, even bridleless and bareback. Robinhood is trained to kneel and curbside to make mounting easy! Robinhood keeps it simple for his rider: point & go, stop, & stand. Having owned Robinhood from a baby 3 year old, we can pull him out no matter how much time goes by with zero worries. He has a baby-sitter demeanor; you can catch him anywhere, hop on bareback, or saddle him up and go! He sure captures the judge’s attention in the show ring with his presence. A soft and graceful ranch riding mover performs reining maneuvers with ease, phenomenal gait transitions, lead changes, spins like a top. Rides on a draped or contact rein with a great jog and rocking chair lope. Tack him up English, where he so fluidly guides with direct rein and floats across the ground. ABSOLUTELY LOVES trail riding, confident & steady in all situations regardless of location. Quiet on the city streets with the hustle and bustle of semis, strollers and bicycles. He is agile and sure-footed in rocky terrain, knows where to put his feet, walks through water, over bridges, over logs, through the trees, up and down the hills. He has been ridden down our city streets with bicycles, motorcycles, and pedestrians. He doesn’t let his feathers ruffle, even with gunfire, plastic bags, and fireworks. Classy as they come packing youth, beginners, & rides to the level of his rider on his back. He gets along with other horses in turnouts and the trailer. Robinhood isn’t afraid to get his hooves dirty, as he has also been an asset on the ranch. Used for daily tasks such as cattle drives, sorting buffalo and cattle, doctoring, and branding. In roping, he is a standout with a lot of natural ability, run, and rate! He has impeccable manners, is patient when tied, likes bathes, and is one you could trust with toddlers. To say we love Robinhood is an understatement, and we know you will agree too. He has the looks, disposition, conformation, and talent for a lifetime of memories. Whether your interests lie in leisure trail rides, ranch versatility, western dressage, loping across pastures, reining, mounted shooting, roping & ranching, or simply being THE best buddy, Robinhood is the perfect partner for your endeavors. We would love to schedule a time for you to try him for yourself.

title: Dillion
description: When you picture what a cowboy rides, in my mind it’s Dillion! This gelding portrays what the American Quarter Horse should look like. Standing 15.1 hands and built like an army tank this gelding is the real deal. Plus he America’s favorite color, BUCKSKIN! It’s hard to find one that looks like this with a modern day black-type pedigree. Dillion doesn’t fall far from the tree. His genetics have played a huge part into the phenomenal gelding he is. He is athletic, versatile, and has an outstanding mind. This guy is so intelligent and you could seriously teach him anything. He has a solid reining style foundation with fast spins with balance, deep sliding stops, push button lead changes, and great direction with speed control. Dillion is a gorgeous mover with a bold presence and would make a world champion Ranch Rider! He guides very easy with a great neck rein. His gait transitions are flawless and he’s very laid back and quiet. Dillion has been started well in the roping arena. He’s loaded with natural cow and has great rate. He has plenty of speed and is quiet in the box. He has been used in the feed yard and out on the ranch. He’s the type of gelding the Ranch Foreman would saddle to ride! He makes the job easier and looks so fancy doing it! He has a good ground covering walk and his extended trot is ideal for making ground in big country. He ground ties where you drop a rein, side passes to the gates, is handy in the sorting pens, and he can hold anything you are cowboy enough to rope.
