My favorite thing about Dillion is his huge personality. He’s bound to make you laugh with his inquisitive ways and funny nature. He loves attention of all kinds and will literally follow you around like a puppy dog. If a horse could be your best friend, it would be this guy. Dillion is a kind soul. He’s very easy to handle on the ground and have in the barn. He is simple and uncomplicated to ride. He’s always gentle to saddle and go even with substantial time off. He would fit any level of rider including a complete beginner. He’s safe, tolerant and consistent. Dillion is accustomed to gunfire, tarps, dogs, wildlife, traffic. He’s made lots of outside miles and excels in and out of the arena. He’s one of the funnest horses we have owned and we are proud to offer such a special gelding.

title: Rocky
excerpt: 2016 Rocky Mountain Horse Black Gelding 15 Hands
description: Rocky is very disciplined and respectful on the ground and in the saddle.. He has a beautiful long flowing mane and tail and looks like Black Beauty! He is as laid back and sweet as they come. He’s that type of horse that anyone could ride and have fun on. He rides out alone, in a group and isn’t barn sour or Buddy sour and he loads himself in the trailer! He’s easy to catch, runs to you in the field. Rocky is up to date with vaccines, worming. Shoes and coggins. He side-passes, backs up, spins, etc. He has excellent ground manners. He is also very natural in his gait. He doesn’t need to be collected up or held with a tight rein, he just goes along naturally. He has a great canter as well! PRETTY, PRETTY, PRETTY!!!

title: Rose
excerpt: 2016 Swedish Warmblood Horse Bay Mare 16.0 Hands
description:
SAFE & Comfortable All-Around Warmblood
\nSwedish Warmblood mare Rose! Rose is one of the nicest Warmbloods I’ve ever owned. She is super safe, comfortable to ride, and has experience in multiple riding disciplines including dressage, jumpers, eventing, fox hunting, trail riding, and giving beginner lessons. Rose is tolerant and amateur-friendly, perfect for kids and adults learning to ride or an amateur that just needs something safe and quiet. She is a lovely mover and nicely forward without being hot. She is comfortable to ride and easy to sit. She has a thicker build and takes up more leg than you would expect. She measures 16h but rides like 16.2h. She loves jumping! Point her at it and she’s going over. Rose has schooled 2’6” with scope for higher. She has attended several jumper schooling shows and hunter paces, often being leased out to junior riders and timid adults. She is also amazing on trails. She has taken several timid riders on trail rides, even riding over highway overpasses around bicycles and traffic.
\nRose started fox hunting this season and has taken to it like a fish in water. She especially loved the time we got to ride with a whip (galloping, jumping logs, and being right with the hounds). She has received compliments on how nice she is in the hunt field. She could ride in any flight and hunts in only a snaffle. Rose has also been leased out to advanced beginner riders for fox hunts. She truly is one of those horses that just about anyone can enjoy riding.
\nRose is an angel on the ground. Easy to load, stands for mounting, lowers her head and opens her mouth for bridling, stands tied to the trailer, etc. She is an easy keeper and up-to-date on everything. No maintenance or vices. She was barefoot until hunt season started, when she got front shoes for riding on rocky terrain and asphalt.

title: Rosine
excerpt: 2016 Paint Horse Black Tobiano Mare 15 Hands
description: Rosine is a stocky built 1200lb mare standing around 14.3hh, she has some very nice markings. She is trained to lay down for mounting from the ground or she will lay down for you to dismount from the saddle, which is a great tool to have for anyone who has knee or hip issues or if you are handicapped. She has been taught all about leg pressure and will ride without a bridle. She will ride with a rein around her neck or just totally by using your feet. She will back, spin, turn, sidepass both ways, lope and slide stop all by using leg cues. Since owning her we have thrown everything at her (literally) trying to scare her and I believe she is as close to bombproof as any horse can be. We have had her camping, used her around cows, trail ridden her hundreds of miles, used her to clear new trails on while running a chainsaw and cutting tree limbs off of her and she is always great. Although she is a mare, she is never marish! She will haul standing directly beside of another horse and even when it comes to feeding time she will eat right out of the same trough as her pasture mates and not bite or kick. We have ponied other horses off of her and used her to break colts to lead. Our kids have trail rode her. She has been ridden around farm equipment, ATV’s, over large noisy tarps and has also had guns shot off of his back. No matter where she goes or what she does, Rosine is not spooky acting. She has been exposed to all kinds of wildlife such as deer or turkey or other animals like cows or dogs and will go anywhere that she is asked too. She has been rode many miles in the mountains and encountered every obstacle possible on the trail. She will go up or down even the steepest slopes, across deep creeks, over downed trees, and over all types of rough terrain while still being sure footed. She has been rode in traffic, and is very traffic safe around cars, semi, log, and dump trucks. She in one of the friendliest horses that you will find, in fact she will follow you around and even go for a job with you. She has a great attitude about whatever she is asked to do. One lucky person is about to get the love of their life with this gal!!!

title: Roswell
excerpt: 2016 Pony Horse Red Roan Gelding 11.3 Hands
description: Roswell is as cute as they come! We already knew what a good pony we were getting, but he continues to surprise us with his good attitude and charm! We absolutely love Roswell and think he is one outstanding Pony. The kids adores him and we can’t hardly keep them away from him! This little gelding will take care of his rider and loves any activity with his little ones! He would be a great starting horse for any family because of his good nature and experience. He is tolerant, quiet and respectful. Roswell has a soft eye and a willing Temperament. He moved right through our program including dogs, atv, tarp, the big ball, walk-trot-lope with the flag, the water, trails, tricks, and riding double.We think he is the complete package and know that your family will too

title: Ruby
description: Ruby stands a solid 16HH measured barefoot with a stick. Ruby gives the best of both worlds in size, sensibility, athleticism, conformation, and movement. Ruby is absolutely stunning and turns heads wherever he goes! A 10+ mover with all the personality and heart you could want in your dream horse! He has a ground-covering walk, smooth comfortable trot, and rhythmical easy-to-sit canter. He is like riding a couch! He has a great stop, back up, and knows all the lateral work. His walk, trot, and canter are very adjustable and he has easy upward and downward transitions. He can walk to canter and has started flying changes in both directions. Ruby has been trailered all over for hunter paces and trail riding. Woods, water, mud, bridges, traffic, wildlife…he has seen it all and ridden alone and in groups of up to 30 other horses. He will go up or down the steepest hills, over downed trees, through deep creeks, and over all types of rough terrain while being sure-footed. He rides in the front, middle, or back. He has gone on walk, trot, canter hound walk and been exposed to hounds, whips, and gun shots. He enjoys showing off at trail obstacle practice with obstacles including the teeter-totter, narrow bridges/planks, giant inflatable balls, tarps, tents, bubbles, etc.

title: Ruz
description: Everyone loves a sharp dressed man! And Ruz is all that! This stunning, Ruz BLACK gelding is the kind that you can’t walk by without a second glance. Ruz is very versatile, well rounded, and trained! He loves life and is happy to conquer any job you ask of him wether it be the top ranch horse, show horse, or your favorite partner just to cruise down the trail. Ruz comes with an extra dose of gentle and kindness. He is safe and quiet for beginner riders and is always tolerant, respectful and patient. He has been ridden by kids in the cutting, sorting pens and out on the ranch. He is always the same honest gelding even with time off. Ruz is an absolute blast to go drop your hand and work a cow. Very stylish and classy. He’s not only an amazing arena horse, but great outside the arena too. Ruz is accustomed to several different types of terrain. He will go right where you point him through running water, deep mud, thick brush, mountainous and rocky terrain, prickly cactus and he is very sure footed. Ruz has smooth and comfortable gaits with more whoa than go. If you just think whoa, it’s happening. He’s easy and simple to maneuver with good spins, lead changes and a great stop. You can sit his sweet, little jog all day long and you will love his rocking chair lope. He has a good extended trot that will cover some country too. Ruz has been roped on in the arena out of the box and also in the pasture. He goes right to his spot with perfect timing and rate making your job easy. He portrays no nervous energy ever and gives you assurance that no matter what you want to do, you can accomplish it together. Ruz is super user friendly in all aspects and is simply a fun and easy horse to own. He’s very special to us and has always been a pleasure to work with. We have enjoyed him over the past few years and know his new owners will too.

title: Sahara
excerpt: 2015 Quarter Horse Red Roan Gelding 14.3 Hands
description: You will be looking pretty dapper showing up with this astonishing roan gelding! I would refer to Sahara as a “ride in luxury”. They just don’t come much fancier! With his soft, kind eye, versatile talent, and willing temperament, Sahara resembles his sire (leading Cutting & Reined Cowhorse Sire with offspring earnings of $18 million+). Aside from his swagger looks, Sahara is an extremely well-trained all-around gelding. He’s a one-stop shop, if all you have is a one-horse trailer. Sahara will run a reining pattern, cut a cow, rope in and out of the arena, cruise down the trail, or go do any ranch job and he takes it all in stride. He is a gorgeous mover and looks like a boss in the showpen. His presence is bold and you can’t walk by him without taking a second look. He performs all of the reining and ranch riding maneuvers very easily with super easy lead changes, smooth sliding stops, pretty spins, good direction, and a big long trot. If horse show is your cup of tea, here’s one that will make a statement. He has Ranch Versatility, Ranch Riding and Cowhorse stamped all over him. Sahara loves cow work, whether you are on the ranch or in the arena, he looks forward to it. He has a big heart and will give it all to you every time. He is very cow smart and reads one like a book. Just point and go, he will do the rest. Sahara has been pasture roped on, steer stopped out of the head box, and roped the sled a ton. He would make a jam up breakaway, calf or heel horse. Sahara is always gentle and safe for any level of rider. If you just want to occasionally hit the trails or go extreme cross country, he is always a great partner. He is confident alone and quiet in a group. You can ride him once a month and he will be the same way you left him the previous ride. He stays trained, kind and quiet. Sahara loves people and will meet you at the gate everyday eagerly waiting attention. His sweet, loving and inquisitive personality will make you laugh and fall in love over and over. Sahara fills the bill and will satisfy the demands and requirements of the most meticulous buyers. Sahara is the whole nine yards with his classy looks, vibrant color, flawless conformation, black-type pedigree and the talent and ability to do anything horseback.

title: Samba King
description:
Samba King is a APHA Tobiano gelding that is 16.0HH, full of personality and athleticism! Samba King is the definition of a versatile, he’s been shown in everything from the ranch riding to the HUS. He’s been used for kids summer camps, lessons, trail rides, parades and so much more! Samba King has been my personal barn favorite and will always make his rider smile!
\nFrom the arena to the trails, Samba King will pack any level of rider. On the trails he will go anywhere you point him with no hesitation, over logs and through water and tricky terrain. He will ride out alone or in a group with no troubles! He 100% traffic safe and has been ridden in parades!
\nIn the arena, Samba King has a very versatile show record and can be ridden both english and western. Under western tack, he has a solid reining foundation with spins and lead changes. He does not have a big stop, but he does have great transitions and will do everything with or without a bridle. Pull the western tack, throw a snaffle on him and go jump 2+ or show in the HUS. He is perfect for someone wanting to competitively show at the local, 4H, or amateur breed shows! He will also show in the halter, ranch riding, ranch trail, and extreme obstacle challenges. He has been shown competitively on a youth team and excels in the shower environment, but is completely content also packing someone down the trails and never returning to the arena.
\nSamba King has been desensitized to blowers, machinery, tarps, cattle, exotics and so much more! He is great being at home or being conditioned in a professional program. He is great stalled or turned out! He does not weave, crib or any other stalling vices. He does well away from home as well and drinks great on the road!
\nBack at the ranch, Samba King is pretty easy and handled daily by beginners. He is the first to meet you at the gate! He is a great patient for the vet, farrier and dentist and is up to date on everything! A forever and perfect home for Samba King is an absolute must for us! Please feel free to email, text, or call with any questions and to discuss more about him! We can help arrange shipping absolutely anywhere!

title: Sandy
description: As Flamboyant and Fun as Vegas! This fancy showgirl has all the bells and whistles. Sandy is absolutely astonishing! She will definitely make you turn your head. Her flawless conformation, desirable buckskin color and elegant movement all wrapped up into one package! Anything you want to do horseback, here is your gal! Sandy runs a pretty reining pattern with easy lead changes, good speed control, fast spins and deep, long stops. She is extremely easy and push button. Back her in the box and some head steers! This mare can run, rate and turn some cattle. She is perfect in the box, leaves flat and has a fancy move in the corner. Very consistent and giving you the same shot every trip, she will work for any level of roper. She is extremely well rounded and nothing bothers her. She is safe and gentle even with extended time off. Sandy would make a great show horse for any level of rider and has been shown successfully by a youth kid. She is like having a nice, quiet using gelding around the barn with no “marish” tendencies. Her soft kind eyes, loving personality and sweet disposition make her a barn favorite. Sandy is hands down a great partner to do any task on the ranch or extremely competitive in multiple events in the arena such as team roping, ranch riding, Versatility and Reined Cowhorse. With her talent, looks, disposition and black-type pedigree you will have a magnificent future broodmare as well. She is 5 panel N/N.

title: Schatzi
excerpt: 2016 Icelandic Horse Sorrel Tobiano Gelding 14.1 Hands
description: Meet Schatzi, he is up for sale for your consideration! He is a chestnut/white spotted Icelandic Gelding which is eight years old. This eye-catching boy is an incredible mover, he is gaited, walk trot tolt and canter. He has been trail ridden by all ages, friends and family. He is easy to handle on the ground or in the saddle. In this current video that I made with him crossing over benches, going up handicapped ramp, being harnessed and hitched was all his very first time doing it. And he did it like he’s done it all his life, he has a good attitude and wants to please. He wasn’t a bit upset or nervous about anything that we were doing with him. Schatzi can ride out alone or in a group. If you’re in the back of the ride and you have to stop to do something he doesn’t get all excited and wanna go racing back to the others. Schatzi is willing to walk along as much as you want, he will tolt, trot, or canter when asked. We have had him on many camping trips and he does well tied over night. He is pastured with mares and geldings and gets along with all. He is traffic safe, has been around our farm tractors and ATVs. He stands to bath, saddled, stands for the farrier, and hauls quiet.

title: Scooby
description: Cutest little guy around, Scooby is just as wide as he is tall! His flashy, distinct looks set him apart from your everyday buckskin and his charming personality will make you fall in love over and over again. Scooby has been reining trained and will lope pretty circles on a draped rein, has correct spins, and a sliding stop. He is very smooth and comfortable to ride. Measuring 14.1 hands, he is easy to mount and dismount. Scooby is super simple and easy to maneuver. He will go as slow or as fast as you want, although he does not have lightning speed. He is a great confidence builder and would make a great first horse for a beginner or kid. Scooby is safe and honest. He is very quiet-minded and nothing bothers him. He is accustomed to crazy dogs, blowing tarps, noisy traffic, loud gunfire, pigs, and even a camel. Scooby has a ton of natural cows and is good for gathering cattle, use in the sorting pens, and we have ridden him all over our ranch. He’s great on the trails and fun to ride. He is confident alone or with a group. Scooby has the sweetest, easiest-going guy. Whatever you want to do, he is game. Always willing and just a super fun horse to own.

title: Shadow
description: Marvelous will describe this gorgeous gelding we call Shadow! With the perfect amount of chrome, he has four perfect matched white legs and big blazed face. His soft kind eye matches his sweet disposition and he has the mind set of a gentle old soul. Shadow is very well rounded and adaptive to anything you want to do horseback. He’s happy to go cut, sort or rope a cow or leisurely cruise down the trail. Pick your cow, drop your hand and let him go to work. He is a great partner out on the ranch and fun to do a days work on. He side passes easily to the gates, ground ties where you drop a rein, and has the stamina to go all day. Shadow is a great horse for the entire family. Good enough for dad to do a days work, pretty enough for mom, and gentle enough for all the kids to enjoy. He is the same horse each time you saddle him and has zero silly business about him. He’s always honest, safe, and quiet to ride and handle even with time off. He’s very smart and wants to please. He’s easy to teach new things to and doesn’t want to be wrong. Shadow is a very confident individual that has been exposed to wild dogs, blowing tarps, heavy machinery, loud gunfire, and busy traffic and none of it ever bothered him from day one. He’s quiet out on the trails and very sure footed. He’s good in a group and happy to lead or follow. If you’re riding alone, no problem, he’s got that covered too. Shadow stands 14.3 hands, is very balanced and correct. This is a super nice young gelding that has his entire life ahead of him to be your partner and friend.

title: Shatta
description:
Shatta is a 2015 purebred Andalusian gelding. He measures 15.2h and is a stunning shiny golden palomino color in the summer. Shatta loves to spend time with his person, give kisses, and smile for treats. He trains in dressage and is schooling all of training level plus shoulder-in and lateral work. Shatta is soft in the bridle and moves off of the seat and leg. He goes best with a quiet rider that rides with a soft connection. He is a nice dressage prospect for a knowledgeable rider to bring up the levels.
\nHe enjoys trail riding and has hacked out in a group from the farm as well as hauled out quite a few times to the local state parks. He has also done some trail obstacle practice and helped pony young horses.
\nShatta is a sweetheart on the ground. He loves attention and wants to say hi to all the barn visitors by reaching out of the stall and giving kisses with his head turned sideways and ears back (shown in pictures). He thinks it will get him treats. Easy to load, tie, clip, bathe, etc. Will stand for hours to be groomed and braided. He is up-to-date on shots, Coggins, deworming, and floating. Just checked by the chiropractor and needed no adjustments. Shatta has a very comfortable fitted dressage saddle and bridle that can be sold with him.shipping can be arranged anywhere in the country.

title: Sheriff
description: Such a kind soul, gentle demeanor, and super talented gelding describes our handsome gelding that will put an anchor on your heart. We proudly offer Sheriff as we affectionately call this very versatile gelding. He is happy and willing to do anything you what to accomplish horseback. He is exceptionally good minded and extremely talented in so many areas. Standing 14.3 hands and absolutely gorgeous. Pick your cow, put your hand down and go have some fun. He is very cow smart and gritty enough to read and hold a tough cow from the herd. Sheriff would make a jam-up cowhorse or Ranch Versatility show horse. He has gorgeous spins, long and deep sliding stops, and easy lead changes. He lopes balanced circles on a draped rein and my-oh-my, he is so smooth! His ears are always forward and he loves his job. He’s a willing partner that is just pure pleasure to ride. Sheriff has been all over the country in many types of terrain. He’s very sure footed and confident out in the rocks, mountains, thick brush, crossing desert arroyos and goes right through running river water. Sheriff is safe and approved for anyone and everyone. He’s a great confidence builder that rides gentle each and every time you saddle him regardless of time off. He is good around crazy dogs, blowing tarps, busy traffic, heavy machinery and loud gunfire. Sheriff is a cow-cutting machine, deluxe trail partner, all-around ranch horse and best friend kind of gelding. This gorgeous gelding has been so easy and enjoyable to have around. He’s a special individual that we are proud to offer.

title: Silver
description: Here is a very astonishing mare with all the bells and whistles. Silver is easy on the eyes with shape for days, balanced conformation, and a hind end the size of Texas. She is gentle, classy, very well trained and did I mention, BUCKSKIN! Silver has a unique pedigree with top cutting, cowhorse, reining bloodlines. Silver was originally trained in the reining. She has the smoothest rocking chair lope and a jog that you could ride for days. She’s very comfortable to ride with easy transitions, stylish spins, easy lead change and deep stop. Silver has been ridden on cows a lot and has a lot of natural cow. She has been used for sorting and would make a fun mare to show in the Cowhorse boxing or ranch versatility events. She is naturally low headed and is an elegant and gorgeous mover with a great extended trot, making a Ranch Rider’s dream. She portrays great talent and style in everything she does. Silver is one of the best trail horses I have had the pleasure to ride. She knows where her feet are at all times and is splendid in all types of terrain. She is confident alone or to lead a group or just as happy to trail behind. She has been exposed to all kinds of wildlife, huge longhorn cattle, crazy dogs, pigs and camels. Silver is always gentle and will ride nicely for any level of rider. Even when ridden inconsistently, she is always the same gentle soul. She is accustomed to blowing tarps, loud machinery, heavy traffic, and gunfire. Silver has a very long mane and tail and enjoys the extra attention being groomed and pampered. She has a world champion disposition and is a jewel to have around the barn. She doesn’t have a mean bone in her body and is good to turn out, trailer and tie next to other horses. She acts as sweet and tolerant as any good old gelding in the barn. We have roped on Silver and used her around the ranch. She easily side passes to the gates, ground ties where you drop a rein, and is a fun partner doing anything with cows. Silver is absolutely drop dead gorgeous with the kindest heart and will be the new barn favorite for her new person.

title: Sir Luiz
description: SIR Luiz!!! This beautiful bay warmblood gelding stands 16.3 hands tall is 11 years old and is clean all around. He is very talented goes off voice command and leg pressure. Very beautiful floating strides. He is a very enjoyable ride. Jumps a nice course of fences with good lead changes. We have had him out and around our ranch and on trails goes out in the cross country field as well. Would work as dressage horse or fancy fox hunter.

title: Skepta
description: If you’re looking for a great all-around gelding the whole family can enjoy, take a look at Skepta! Skepta is a grade, Buckskin Roan Gelding that stands 14hh. He is tall enough and stoutly built so an adult can ride him all day with ease. Yet he is short enough and so gentle that he won’t be intimidating to your child. He will get your attention with his stunning good looks. Then he will steal your heart with his sweet, lovable personality. Skepta has been in good hands since the start and has never learned any bad habits or vices. If you need a nice reliable ranch partner, Skepta won’t let you down. He has been used to check and move cows, sort pairs, rope and drag. He is stout enough for a day’s work, yet his smooth gaits and easy transitions make him a joy to be on all day long. Maybe you’re looking for a new trail riding partner. Skepta is happy to go for a relaxing ride. He goes wherever you point him. He guides easily with a one hand neck rein. He will cross whatever obstacle that comes up, from ditches, ravines, deadfall and water crossings big or small. Even things such as bridges, a teeter totter, tarps, big bouncing balls and the bull whip are not a problem. You don’t have to worry if your trail takes you into town or areas with traffic. They aren’t an issue for Skepta either. From bicycles, ATVs, farm machinery, cars, and trucks, he handles them all with ease. He loads in a stock or slant trailer and stands wherever you put him. If your camping and need to highline, Skepta is fine with that too. Skepta also knows how to drive. If you’re looking to take a nice relaxing buggy ride, Skepta has that covered also. He stands for the vet and farrier. He loves to be bathed and groomed. He sells 100% sound with clean x-rays

title: Snickers
description: Golden and Gorgeous! Snickers makes a statement everywhere he goes! Not only is he stunning, but he checks all the other boxes too! Safe, safe, safe every time you catch him. Snickers is super easy going and wants to always be a good boy. Gentle and easy to handle in the saddle and on the ground. Fully trained in the reining with stylish spins, easy lead changes, and long sliding stops. His speed control is amazing and is more of a push-to-go type of horse, but so trained he easily takes his correct leads with just a smooch and neck reins with the lightest touch. When you say “whoa” all four feet are like a statue. Snickers is great out on the ranch. He is naturally cowy and good in the sorting pens and gathering cattle out of big pastures. He ground ties where you drop a rein, side passes to all the gates and can pull a semi truck if you roped it. Snickers is a trooper out on the trails and is confident alone, will lead a group, or happily trail behind. He goes where you point him and doesn’t say no. He’s accustomed to lots of wild life, crazy dogs, pigs, camels, buffalo, and cattle. Blowing tarps, loud gunfire, busy traffic and heavy machinery do not phase him either. Snickers has a big personality and is a fun horse to have around the barn. He’s the kind that anyone will be proud to own.

title: Snoopy
description: Worth his weight in gold, this adorable palomino gelding will steal your heart. Snoopy is a favorite around our outfit. Once you meet him, you will know why. Snoopy has that kind, soft eye that defines his personality. He wants no trouble. You ask and he will give. Snoopy has been shown in the Cowhorse events by a youth rider.

title: Soldier
description: Soldier is one of the SWEETEST ponies ever. He’s smart, willing, and extremely versatile. Whether we tack him up English and work on some poles, hop over some fences, or throw a western saddle on him and head to the obstacle course or trails; Soldier doesn’t have a single care in the world he will do or try anything you ask him. We tell people all of the times horses like Soldier are just born with that loving disposition we look for in our horses. It’s something you can’t teach or train into them, so even at a young age they have the potential to be a great kids or beginner horse or pony. Soldier is big enough to carry a small adult so whether you’re looking for something on the smaller side for yourself or just want to be able to hop on the kids pony to be able to do some schooling or refresher courses down the road, Soldier is the perfect size. We’re so excited for his future and can’t wait to follow his journey with his forever family! It could be you!

title: Spooncat
excerpt: 2016 Paint Horse Grulla Tobiano Gelding 15.1 Hands
description:
Are you looking for your dream horse?! Your next dream partner that is experienced, reliable, versatile, affectionate and ready to go?! Meet Spooncat, a stunning Grullo Tobiano Paint Horse Gelding standing 15.1 hands! Spooncat is the REAL DEAL! He has the mind and experience everyone wishes their horse had. Conformation that is built to last. And well he is dang handsome! Spooncat has great quality feet! He stands tied like a gentleman! Self Loads into the Trailer! Is fantastic for the vet and farrier- and we’re just getting started! From solid ground manners, making him easy, enjoyable and safe for anyone to be around to his extensive training rooted in ranch and dressage, he will make a phenomenal partner whether your just trail riding, enjoy showing in trail/obstacle/ranch classes or want to have a deluxe ranch horse you can go get a job done on! He’s the real deal! Spooncat can be ridden on a loose rein or with contact for more collected maneuvers. He willingly and easily follows your seat and leg, has a great stop, neck reins, turns around, and more! Need help mounting? No problem! Spooncat will pick you up from wherever you need him to, whether it’s the mounting block, the fence or even a stump in the woods. With Spooncat, you truly get the whole package! He’s a solid, willing partner with a quality, versatile education that makes him a pleasure to be around. His experience goes far beyond just the arena! He’s also an expert on the trail, with extensive trail riding experience both alone and in groups. He easily navigates creek crossings, logs, hills, and works gates like a pro. And if obstacles are your thing, Spooncat performs them with ease, making him a great choice for recreational or show obstacle courses.
\nWith his quiet personality and extensive experience, Spooncat would excel as a trail horse (recreational or show), obstacle horse (recreational or show), or ranch horse (working or show). He’s best suited for a rider looking for a willing, safe partner who loves to give him attention. And with his stunning color and great confirmation, Spooncat is definitely a head-turner. Out of all the incredible horses we have offered for sale- Spooncat is hands down one of the nicest horses we’ve ever sold! Don’t miss your chance!

title: Spot
description: Spot is that dream horse that everyone is looking for. He is solid and seasoned. Spot is the most laid back and easy-going Fjord we have ever owned. He comes to us directly from the gentleman who bred and raised him. He had only had one home until he came to us and Spot was only sold due to the gentleman’s age and health. Spot has had excellent care his whole life. Spot is the horse everyone who comes to our place falls in love with. He loves attention and is so sweet and kind. He will babysit the youngest, is kind and forgiving for the beginner. He comes to you for attention and is easy to catch. He is excellent for bathing and clippers. He stands well for the farrier and vet also. He is happy just to go down the trail, slow and steady. He is that easy going confidence booster that is hard to find. He gets along with all the other horses, rides in a group or out alone without any fuss or hassle. He is also broke to drive so if you don’t want to ride you can hook him and enjoy a nice country stroll. Watch his video as he speaks for himself. No vices or bad habits. He is up to date on worming, vaccinations and farrier. We welcome you to come to the ranch and meet Spot.

title: Star
excerpt: 2016 Quarter Horse Bay Roan Gelding 15 Hands
description: They just don’t come much cooler than this cowboy looking bay roan! Star is just an all around great gelding. You won’t find one more gentle, tolerant, or sweeter. He gets an A+ in all areas. Star is very versatile whether you want to work cows, rope, rein, arena ride, ranch or trail ride. He’s a one stop shop that can do anything you want to horseback. He’s a gentle old soul that is very mature and wise beyond his years. Star has a nice reining foundation with great lead departures, solid spins, a rocking chair lope, and a deep stop. He will change leads, side pass, and has nice gait transitions. Star has worked lots of cattle in the arena and on the ranch. He’s handy for gathering herds in big pastures, sorting in the pens, and will box one in the arena. He has a lot of natural cow sense that is bred into him and training in reined cowhorse. Star has been roped in the pasture and in the arena. He’s pretty solid on the heel side, great in the box and gives you a nice, easy shot. Star’s best characteristic is his demeanor. He’s absolutely the sweetest, loving, and kindest gelding. He wouldn’t hurt a fly and wants to do no wrong. You cannot upset him, startle him, or scare him in anyway. He’s nearly bombproof and carefree. He’s naturally been like this from the beginning. Flying tarps, heavy machinery, gunfire, busy traffic, bicycles, motorcycles, buffalo, pigs, wild dogs, wildlife, etc. do not phase him. Star is ideal to trail ride and pleasure ride. He has great confidence and is very brave. He’s sure footed, will go right where you point him, and walks nicely on a loose rein. Star is 100% gentle and safe for any level of rider, big or small, young or old and he will take care of you. If safety is a priority, he will be the one you can trust. If you can hold his reins you will be able to ride him. Star is such a cool looking horse. Standing 15 hands and built to last a lifetime with balanced conformation and heavy bone. His bay roan color is just a bonus that is sought after in the western world and makes him look the part of a cowboy’s horse, although you definitely don’t have to be a cowboy to ride him. Star is the perfect horse for a first time horse owner that is learning the ropes, yet has the talent, ability, and is so versatile to be a great partner for a veteran horseman that just doesn’t want to deal with any problems.

title: Starlette
excerpt: 2016 Missouri Fox Trotter Bay Tobiano Mare 14.2 Hands
description: Starlette is a 14.2hh, Bay Tobiano mare. She will flatfoot walk on a loose rein or he can move on out easily. Starlette is a SUPER smooth gaited horse, she has a natural runwalking gait where she will shake her head and a nice Racking gait as well! She has been exposed seen everything out on the trails and will cross any obstacle. She is also traffic safe and gets along with my other horses very well.

title: Stars
excerpt: 2017 Quarter Horse Red Dun Gelding 15.2 Hands
description: Stars is a big, kind and handsome guy that just wants to please. He was started in the reining pen and was shown locally in the ranch horse classes including ranch trail, ranch riding, and some boxing by an older lady. Stars has a smooth jog, nice extended trot, and a comfortable lope on a loose rein. He has an easy lead change, good spins, and fluent side passes. He has been over all kinds of trail obstacles including poles, bridges, jumps, dragging logs, and tarps. Stars is a very safe gelding for the entire family. He is always gentle, quiet and easy to handle on his back and on the ground. He has a great neck rein and guides effortlessly. He willingly goes right where you send him without hesitation. He’s accustomed to running rivers, lakes, thick brush, prickly cactus, and mountainous terrain. Stars is a great beginner type horse or would suit someone wanting to build some confidence. He’s got more whoa than go and would just assume go slow, but has plenty of get up and go if asked. He’s great around cattle, dogs, pigs, buffalo and camels. Stars has a sweet and loving disposition. He will meet you at the gate and follow you around eagerly awaiting attention.

title: Stones
description: This little guy is seriously the cutest! Dapples for days stamped on this precious, sweet gelding! Standing 14.1 hands, Stones makes it pretty easy to mount or dismount. He loves all people and wants to please his person. He’s definitely a social butterfly. He will carry and take care of any level of rider. He is very safe and so gentle. Stones has the most comfortable little jog and the smoothest slow lope on a draped rein. He is naturally low headed and has the prettiest way of going around the arena. He’s fun to do the reining maneuvers on with great speed control, pretty spins, automatic lead changes, and a long sliding stop. He’s so easy and simple to ride. Stones is a very fluid and elegant mover and he would excel in the ranch riding and versatility events. Go show him, trail ride or maybe both, he’s an all around great time in any situation. Stones also pulls the cart, wagon, or anything you hook him to. He’s accustomed to a 12 ft wagon going down a busy road or cruising the cart around the desert. You can hook him up alone and he stands quietly and patiently. He is safe, confident, and looks absolutely stellar going down the road hooked up and is definitely a head turner. Stones is a blast to trail ride or leisurely cruise down the road. He’s not spooky and fearless alone. He happily goes right where you point him without hesitation. From day one in our program nothing has phrased him and he easily adapts to everything we throw his direction. Stones is always quiet to handle on the ground and has absolutely no silly business when you ride him. He doesn’t have a mean bone in his body and is a happy, willing, and honest partner. He doesn’t require consistent riding and can easily handle time off. Once a week, once a month, or 6 times a year, he rides the same. Stones is great with other horses and accustomed to crazy dogs, cattle, buffalo, pigs, and wildlife. We have penned roped cattle and he likes that too. He’s handy to use all over our ranch and will ground tie where you drop a rein, side pass to open and close gates, go over bridges, logs and drag anything you dally to the saddle horn. Stones is a total lover boy and enjoys grooming, bathes and and being social. He’s so easy to teach new things and is happy to learn. He never says no and don’t let his size fool you, he can do anything the big boys can. He’s conformationally very balanced and correct. He physically attracts attention to anyone that lays eyes on him and after you get to know him you fall in love. Young, older, or anywhere in between, beginner or advanced, Stones will be a soldier. He will go slow and take care of you, but still has all the talent and athleticism if you ask. So much fun wrapped up into this Fun-Sized package!

title: Storm
description: Storm is a big, kind and handsome guy that just wants to please. He was started in the reining pen and was shown locally in the ranch horse classes including ranch trail, ranch riding, and some boxing by an older lady. Storm has a smooth jog, nice extended trot, and a comfortable lope on a loose rein. He has an easy lead change, good spins, and fluent side passes. He has been over all kinds of trail obstacles including poles, bridges, jumps, dragging logs, and tarps. Storm is a very safe gelding for the entire family. He is always gentle, quiet and easy to handle on his back and on the ground. He has a great neck rein and guides effortlessly. He willingly goes right where you send him without hesitation. He’s accustomed to running rivers, lakes, thick brush, prickly cactus, and mountainous terrain. Storm is a great beginner type horse or would suit someone wanting to build some confidence. He’s got more whoa than go and would just assume go slow, but has plenty of get up and go if asked. He’s great around cattle, dogs, pigs, buffalo and camels. Storm has a sweet and loving disposition. He will meet you at the gate and follow you around eagerly awaiting attention.

title: Stormzy
excerpt: 2016 Paint Horse Black Tobiano Gelding 15 Hands
description:
He is stocky and stands 15 hands. He is as versatile as they come whether you are looking for a competitive show horse, seasoned trail horse, or just a safe horse the whole family can enjoy!
\nWe have been hauling him to numerous shows this summer and Stormzy has been packing both beginner and seasoned riders and excelling in the Hunter and Equitation classes. He loves to jump and is not complicated to ride at all. He also has been shown in the pleasure, horsemanship, halter, showmanship, and trail classes. He has won many high points and all around awards.
\nWhile Stormzy has quite the resume in the show arena, it’s how great he rides outside that makes him truly versatile. He loves trail riding and is very confident to ride out alone. He has spent hundreds of miles on the trails through many different states, stands quietly at the hitching rail while your camping. He rides great through the pastures ( no barn or buddy sour issues) and is traffic safe. He is not a spooky or reactive type horse. Stormzy has zero vices, and doesn’t require any maintenance. He currently has front shoes on but does great barefoot as well. He is a perfect gentleman for the farrier and vet. He loads and unloads easily in various types of trailers. Stormzy is suitable for all ages and levels of riders. He would be a great confidence builder as he is very consistent every time you ride him. The sky is the limit when it comes to all the great things you can do with him: showing, fox hunting, trail riding, lesson horse, or a very nice gelding to take care of your family.

title: Sugar
description: This stunning mare will make you look twice! Sugar is hard to take your eyes off of. Her dappled buckskin color and balanced conformation is complete perfection. Standing 15.1 hands with great structure and impeccable breeding makes her a prime candidate for a future broodmare. This versatile mare has earned points in several disciplines including Ranch Riding and AQHA Ranch Versatility in Conformation, Trail, and Pleasure. Sugar is an elegant mover and has that “classy” style. She performs all the reining maneuvers with ease and has phenomenal gait transitions. Super easy to spin and has the easiest lead change ever. You can run and stop her blindfolded and her speed control is spot on. Sugar is the kindest and most honest mare we have owned and she knows her job and is happy to do it. She is gentle, safe and easy for any level of rider, including children and complete beginners. She is very smooth with a great jog and rocking chair lope on a draped rein. Catch her anywhere, jump on bareback or saddle her up and go! No worries about anything. Sugar is a total trooper out on the trails. She’s confident and steady in all situations. She has been exposed to lots of different terrains and she’s as rock solid as they come. Just point her and she will go through the deep running water, rough and rocky mountains , thick mud and brush, and maneuver around the prickly cactus. Sugar is great with loud gunfire, blowing tarps, crazy dogs, desert wildlife, heavy machinery, and busy traffic. We have ridden Sugar all over our ranch and she is a great partner inside and outside of the arena. She can cover some ground with her extended trot and is fun across big pastures. She ground ties where you drop a rein and will side pass and bend accordingly to open all the tricky gates. Sugar is super sweet and amazing to handle on the ground. She loves attention and makes your job as an owner fun and easy. Her ears are always forward awaiting your arrival and she’s like having an old ranch gelding around the barn. She is good in the pasture with other horses, stands tied quietly and will trailer nicely next to the other horses. Sugar has the black-type pedigree, conformation, performance record and gentle demeanor to satisfy the most discriminating buyer and her color is 100% a bonus! Sugar is the entire package that puts an emphasis on FANCY!

title: Sun
description: Let’s get this party started with Sun! Such an entertaining and fun vibe this gelding brings to the table! Checking all the boxes in every way! Sun is family safe and kiddo friendly! Thoroughly tested, tried, and proven with youth in the saddle in the show ring, down the trails and everywhere in between. A true saint to own, ride and handle all the way around. He will turn heads with his four matching white socks, big blazed face, Snow White mane and tail, and one blue eye which I think is lucky. This fancy boy will ride English, Western, and bareback very calm, cool and collected and will ride just as good with a string around his neck. He is easy, solid, and consistent and would be an excellent partner for another kid, beginner, or amateur to learn on and grow with in the Reining, Ranch Riding, Trail, and Versatility and talented enough that you won’t outgrow him. He has plenty of ability, buttons and tools to take you to whatever level you want, yet very understanding of mistakes and does not ever get upset. He is very tolerant and a great confidence builder. He’s never anxious or worried about anything in or out of the arena. Sun has super flashy way of going around. He is naturally low headed and a really pretty mover. He has smooth, comfortable gaits and spot on transitions. He is capable and has plussed all maneuvers in the show pen with stylish spins, an automatic lead change, beautiful circles, and you can run and stop him blindfolded. He is smooth as glass and will go as slow or fast as you ask. Sun has zero spook and is more inquisitive of things that should scare him. He’s a curious and brave horse and loves to see everything. From day one he has taken all our tactics and training so easy. From the blowing tarps, loud gunfire, crazy dogs, heavy machinery and everything else, he never batted an ear and just liked all the attention. A bombproof trail partner that enjoys cruising down the road, through the trails, or in the mountains. He is super confident alone or enjoys a group and will lead or follow. He doesn’t flinch an ear at heavy traffic, bicycles, or motorcycles. He great in rocky terrain knowing right where his feet are and easily navigates his way through the prickly cactus. He ground ties where you drop a rein and will side pass to any gate. Sun knows lots of fun tricks and is so easy to teach things to. Just pet him once for doing something correct and he’s got it mastered. He’s such a people pleaser and has been so much fun to have around. He’s a barn favorite because of his charming and loving disposition. He wants to be your best buddy and will make you laugh daily with his clown antics, yet always a gentleman and never oversteps his boundaries. He’s one of the happiest horses we have had. His ears are always forward and he will meet you at pasture gate and follow you around like a puppy dog. Standing 14.3 hands with a lot of bone and structure we think he’s the perfect size for any rider.

title: Sunny
description: Sunny is an absolute knockout with his stunning golden color and Snow White mane & tail that goes on forever! He turns heads everywhere you take him. His inquisitive, loving, and sweet personality will seal the deal and his calm and quiet demeanor will make you fall in love over and over. Sunny has been trained in the reining and does all maneuvers easily. He has a comfortable jog and lope on a draped rein and is more of a push-style horse. If you think whoa, Sunny slides to a stop. He has stylish spins and easy lead changes and you can close your eyes in a run down and he stops pretty every time. Sunny has a naturally level headset and is an elegant mover. He has Ranch Riding and Ranch Versatility written all over him. He guides willingly and directly. Sunny has been all over our ranch and would make the fanciest ride for the ranch Foreman. He walks out nicely, easily side passes to the gates, and knows what a day’s work is all about. If you need to go rope a steer in the pasture and doctor one, he will work the rope and do his part. Sunny is always gentle and completely beginner-friendly. He is a super fun horse to have around the barn and always game for whatever the day may bring. Whether his job is babysitting the kiddos packing around your mother-in-law or spending a day in the sorting pens or out on the ranch, Sunny will be your go-to. Nothing bothers this gorgeous gelding. Bring on the rough terrain and mud, blowing tarps, crazy dogs, noisy traffic, loud gunfire, pushy pigs, and even a giant camel. Sunny is a barn favorite. He is the entire package. Black-type pedigree, stunning looks, balanced conformation, puppy-dog disposition, and the talent and willingness to do anything you want on horseback.

title: Tacha
excerpt: 2018 Gypsy Vanner Horse Black Mare 14.1 Hands
description:
Tacha stands 14.1 hands purebred Gypsy Vanner mare that is well broke to ride and has been on lots of trails. Tacha is a seasoned trail horse that is gentle enough for almost anyone to ride. Tacha will ride in the arena or outside and picks up both her leads. She is easy to ride and gets along with other horses. Tacha rides great in a group or goes out alone with no problem. We have taken Tacha up and down the main highway and she does not mind the traffic at all.
\nTacha is not mare-ish at all and is very gentle to be around. We have exposed her to tarps, bouncing balls and all kinds of obstacles and she does mind at all.
\nTacha goes through water and over logs and wherever you point her with no issues. Tacha is quiet enough for my little boy to lead her around the barnyard and brush her legs. Tacha has a smooth walk, trot, and canter, plus she is soft in the face. Tacha will move out on a loose rein and does not get easily excited.
\nTacha would also be a great addition to someone’s breeding program as she is well bred.

title: Teddy
description: Safe, honest, kid tested and approved, and America’s favorite color, dappled BUCKSKIN! Teddy will be your best buddy! This pretty 14.2 hand gelding is as handy as they come. Any job you need to do, he will be your number one partner! Teddy has been shown in the stock horse and Ranch Versatility events by a youth kid. Together they won the year end circuit receiving the trophy saddle. Teddy will work a cow nicely and gives his heart every time. He is fun to use in the sorting pens and out gathering cattle. He’s very quiet in a herd, but gritty and quick footed if need be. Teddy does all the reining maneuvers easily including spins, sliding stops and lead changes. He has nice, smooth gaits and transitions on a draped rein. Teddy is great outside of the arena too! He loves to leisurely stroll down the trails and is confident alone, will lead a group or is happy to trail behind. Nothing bothers this little soldier. He’s great with blowing tarps, loud gunfire, noisy traffic, and heavy machinery. Crazy dogs, wildlife, donkeys, pigs, buffalo, and even camels don’t phase him. Teddy is as honest as a day is long and aims to be a pleaser. He’s a super fun boy to have around the barn and easy to own. Catch him anywhere, jump on bareback and go enjoy anything you want to do horseback. Teddy would make a great kids horse, first horse or anyone that needs a confidence builder. He’s consistent and gentle every ride even with time off.

title: Tequila
excerpt: 2016 Quarter Horse Red Dun Gelding 15 Hands
description: This is one cool gelding. We affectionately call him Tequila. Conformationally very correct and balanced with that attractive red dun color, dorsal stripe and tiger striped legs. He can do all the maneuvers easily and correct. Pretty spins, smooth stops, easy lead change, and lopes on a draped rein. Tequila has very comfortable gaits and transitions with a nice slow jog and good extended trot. He neck reins nicely and guides easily. Tequila is very smart and learns new things eagerly and easily. He’s very adaptive and quiet minded in new surroundings. He’s gentle and easy going. Tequila enjoys a relaxing trail ride and is excellent in all types of terrain. He’s confident to ride alone, but good in a group as well. He’s not in a rush to do anything as he would just assume go slow, but has plenty of go if needed. He’s not spooky and good with wildlife, dogs, cattle, loud gunfire, busy traffic, blowing tarps, and heavy machinery. Tequila is very fond of any attention you give him and is a very loving soul. He has a lot of personality and is entertaining around the barn. He will run to the gate when he sees you and follow you around like a puppy dog. Tequila is a big boned gelding with great structure. He’s built to last a life time. He’s very versatile and a willing partner that can go any direction. This classy gelding is always gentle and aims to please.

title: Tessy
description: Tessy is a stocky built 1450lb mare standing around 16hh with some very nice markings. We bought Tessy from an Amish kid in Michigan who trained her with natural horsemanship methods. She is trained to lay down for mounting from the ground or she will lay down for you to dismount from the saddle, which is a great tool to have for anyone who has knee or hip issues or if you are handicapped. In addition to laying down she will bow and set like a dog and play kick the can. She has been taught all about leg pressure and will ride without a bridle. She will ride with a rein around her neck or just totally by using your feet. She will back, spin, turn, sidepass both ways, lope and slide stop all by using leg cues. She has been camping, we have used her around cows, trail ridden her hundreds of miles and hooked her up and drove her under a harness. We have ponied other horses off of her and used her to break colts to lead. She has been ridden around farm equipment, ATV’s, over large noisy tarps and has also had guns shot off of his back. No matter where she goes or what she does, Tessy is not spooky acting. She has been exposed to all kinds of wildlife such as deer or turkey or other animals like cows or dogs and will go anywhere that she is asked too. She has been rode many miles in the mountains of California and encountered every obstacle possible on the trail. She will go up or down even the steepest slopes, across deep creeks, over downed trees, and over all types of rough terrain while still being sure footed. She has been rode in traffic, and is very traffic safe around cars, semi, log, and dump trucks. She is one of the friendliest horses that you will find, in fact she will follow you around and even go for a job with you. She has a great attitude about whatever she is asked to do. One lucky person is about to get the love of their life with this gal!!!

title: Tex
description: You have to come meet my boy, Tex! I absolutely love this gelding! You will immediately be taken with his big, soft, kind eye and stunning buttermilk buckskin coat with his long flowing mane and tail! Standing 15.2 hands this is one handsome guy that moves so graceful. It’s hard to find a horse with this size and bone structure with a modern day, top performance, black-type pedigree. Tex is so low key, receptive, and easy going towards anything you through his way. He is one of the most gentle, kind and trustworthy horses we have had the opportunity to have in our program. Tex physically isn’t a superstar athlete like Micheal Jordan and he can’t run like Secretariat, but if you want a horse that you can throw any member of the family on or the CEO of your company and have an amazing insurance policy, he is your guy. Tex does all the fun stuff too. He has pretty spins, automatic lead changes and a nice sliding stop. He is naturally cowy and strong enough to hold anything you are cowboy enough to rope. He definitely has more whoa than go, but is very trained and easily takes his correct leads with just a smooch and the minute you say “whoa” he stands like a wooden Indian. Tex easily guides and has a lot of direction one handed. He would make a fun horse to go show in the ranch riding or ranch trail events. His demanding presence will definitely get you noticed in the show pen. He is a superstar over all the trail obstacles, drags, bridges, and willingly side passes to open the gates and over the logs. Tex is soft in his face and good in his rib cage. I do believe he would also be amazing in western dressage. He loves long relaxing trail rides and is bombproof outside. Nothing phrases him. He’s a great confidence builder that is safe for any level of rider. He’s fun out on the ranch and handy enough to do a days work. He enjoys riding out in the big pastures to check fence and cattle. Tex lays down on command with trust and confidence around blowing tarps, crazy dogs and loud gunfire. He will boldly cruise down busy highways with traffic and bicycles. He is good around heavy machinery, pigs, buffalo and even a camel. Tex has a fabulous disposition and is always a gentleman around the barn and on his back. He will meet you in the pasture and truly enjoys any attention. We are proud to offer this very sweet, honest and handsome gelding.

title: Thunder
description: Oh la la check out our handsome guy, Thunder. He is all that and then some! He is the type of horse that will make you fall in love over and over each time you are in his presence. Exceptionally special in so many ways, Thunder is the total package! Above all, his attitude and demeanor he is a+ across the board. If a push-style trail and ranch-loving horse is your perfect partner, look no further! ! His beautiful 24k dappled coat, long snow-white mane, and tail are just a bonus! Thunder rides the very best and is safe and gentle in every way. If you can hold his reins, you can ride him. He’s always dependable even with time off. Everyday he is the same sweet, honest and lovable gelding you have always dreamed of owning. Thunder has is super fun and easy to ride and his ground manners are pristine. More of a push-style ride he doesnt ever anticipate your next move. He waits for you to ask him and he happily performs. Thunder has pretty spins, super easy lead changes, beautiful circles on a draped rein, and smooth sliding stops. He would be a phenomenal ranch rider or versatility contender. He is an outstanding mover, and his transitions are Thunder. He looks the part and demands attention when he presents himself! He has a super comfy jog and a nice slow lope. He has a good extended trot, and his speed control is spot on. He is very pretty under an english saddle as well. Thunder enjoys cruising through the trails or riding the ranch the most. He would be a great family horse and will give beginner or nervous riders confidence. He is patient and tolerant of mistakes; nothing bothers this sweetheart gelding. He is calm, steady, and quiet. Thunder is a steady eddy out on the trails and is perfect alone or will follow or lead a group. He enjoys a nice leisure ride and will be the best company you can ask for. He will brighten your day and make you look forward to going to the barn. He’s a fun and easy horse to own. We have ridden Thunder all over our ranch and used him to gather and sort cattle and he’s been roped on a little too. Nothing spooks him and he aims to please. He is sure footed and will go right where you point him through the water, mud, rocks, brush, etc. He has never worried about loud gunfire, crazy dogs, wildlife, busy traffic, bicycles, blowing tarps, or any other distractions from day one. He just wants to get along and be good. Thunder has great conformation and is built to last. Standing 15 hands and has a lot of structure and is very balanced. Thunder has the pedigree, looks, ability, and disposition of a superstar! We are proud to offer this exceptional gelding! He is worth his weight in gold!

title: Torch
description: Handsome, charming, and 100% gentleman in every way! You will fall head over heels in love with our sweet boy, Torch! He’s a people pleaser for sure! You ask, he will do it! This gelding is so sincere and kind. He will follow you around like a big puppy dog around the barn and run to the pasture gate when he sees his person. Torch is trained in the reining and performs all the maneuvers easily and consistently. He is a very elegant mover with the smoothest, most comfortable gaits and transitions. The torch has a huge stop, a lot of turn around, automatic lead change, and great speed control. He has a great direction with a solid neck rein. Just point and he will go right where you send him. Torch loves trail riding and being outside. He is very sure-footed and handles himself well on rocky and rough terrain and willingly goes through running water, deep mud, thick brush, and heavily wooded areas. He’s confident alone, but good with a group of horses out on the trails. He will ground tie where you drop a rein and will side pass to open all the gates. Torch can go long periods without any riding and he stays gentle. He’s always honest to saddle up and go. He stays trained and knows his job. He is safe and sane for any level of rider. We have steer stopped out of the head box and roped the sled on Torch. He tracks right in behind a steer and rates one great. We have used him to sort and doctor cow/calf pairs and used him out in big country to catch wild cows. He’s happy to do any job you though as him with his ears forward and a great attitude. He will go all day long and has no quit in him. Torch deserves the best home. His willingness to ride for anyone that climbs on his back and his big personality unquestionably makes him a barn favorite.

title: Trooper
description: Cuteness overload! This chromed out, blonde haired, blue eyed little charmer is marvelous! Trooper’s inquisitive personality and loving disposition will make you laugh and fall in love over and over. He likes to please his people and doesn’t want to be wrong. Trooper has been trained in the reining and can perform all the maneuvers very stylish! He cruises around naturally low headed and has the most amazingly smooth gaits. He’s easy and comfortable to sit. He has a rocking chair lope on a loose rein and guides easily. He has fancy spins, easy lead changes, a deep sliding stop and is a gorgeous mover. He loves to rope the lead steer around the arena and has a lot of natural cow. Trooper is good in the sorting pens and fun to gather and work cattle on. He has a responsive one handed neck rein, but will ride bridle-less just as well. Trooper stays very gentle and trained even with substantial time off without being ridden. We have grabbed him out of the pasture after months and it’s as if he never had a day off. Over the years we have let friends, family and business associates ride him around our ranch and on the trails. Trooper is always the same and trustworthy to take care of everyone. He lays down on command with trust and confidence around blowing tarps, crazy dogs and loud gunfire. He will boldly cruise down busy highways with traffic and bicycles and is good around heavy machinery, pigs, buffalo and even a camel. Whether you want to trail ride, horse show, ride down the parade or just to the mailbox this fancy boy will be reliable, consistent and turn everyone’s head to that crosses his path.

title: Tucker
excerpt: 2016 Tennessee Walker Blue Roan Gelding 16 Hands
description: This is Tucker. He is a 16-h beautiful blue roan Tennessee Walking Horse. We have gone many miles together and I can say without a doubt that this guy is a true FINISHED TRAIL HORSE. He is very careful with his feet, taking care of himself and his rider at all times. I have had kids, adults, beginners, everyone on him. He never takes advantage of a rider’s inexperience like many horses do.

title: Turner
description: Hard to find one with this much shape, pedigree and ride that is dappled Turnergray! This guy is easy on the eyes! Turner as we affectionately call him is very versatile and always a pleasure to ride. He knows the reining maneuvers with pretty spins, lead changes, and a nice sliding stop. He is a pretty mover with a comfortable jog and smooth slow lope on a draped rein. Turner has been successfully shown locally by a youth in the Ranch Versatility classes, taken to playdays , and 4-H events. Turner is happy and willing to do whatever you throw his way. He has absolutely no silly business about him and is simply a fun horse to own. He has gathered huge sections that are mountainous, rocky and full of cactus. He has been used in the branding pens and sorted numerous pairs of cattle. He is no stranger to wet saddle pads and a long day of work. He’s a great partner to have all over the ranch. Turner is amazing out on the trails and loves to leisurely cruise wherever his rider wants to go. He’s confident alone and good with a group. Nothing bothers or spooks him on the trails and he’s happy to go through running rivers, deep mud, navigate around prickly cactus, and is very sure footed in mountainous terrain. He’s accustomed to wildlife, crazy dogs, blowing tarps, heavy machinery and loud gunfire. Turner lays down with a touch of the finger and you can climb on him bridle-less and bareback and go whenever your heart desires. He’s a sweet, affectionate, and very kind gelding. Super easy to catch and just an all around good boy. Always gentle, quiet and sane and doesn’t have to be ridden consistently.

title: Vandam
excerpt: 2016 Paint Horse Black Tobiano Gelding 14.2 Hands
description: Vandam is a SUPER stocky built gelding standing 14.2hh and is a beautiful Black/White Paint. He is registered APHA and his pedigree has some of the best you will find!!!! He is bred to do anything that involves a cow! Vandam has a lot of experience and has been ridden lots of miles. He has been owned and ridden by a good friend of ours who is a natural horsemanship trainer. Vandam will lay down and set on his rump. He also rides bridleless, you MUST SEE his video!!! He is a super sweet horse and loves attention! He is a horse that the whole family can ride and love regardless of what age they are! He is stout enough to carry a big ol daddy yet gentle enough to his carry baby girl! I have hauled him to team sorting events and won money on him, he has been started on both ends of the roping dummy and has huge potential! He has been trail ridden in several states. He will cross creeks, ditches, logs and navigate rough rocky areas. He is safe riding in traffic. He has a smooth jog, a nice lope, will slide stop, turns a circle both ways, sidepasses and backs with ease! He a confident horse on the trails and will lead the crew, head out alone or follow behind with no issues! He has been exposed to all kinds of wildlife such as deer or turkey or other animals like cows or dogs and will go anywhere that he is asked too. He has been rode many miles in the mountains and encountered every obstacle possible on the trail. He will go up or down even the steepest slopes, across deep creeks, over downed trees, and over all types of rough terrain while still being sure footed. Vandam is not cinchy, cold backed, does not crib or weave. If you’re looking for a family horse, ranch horse, rope horse, team sorter… Vandam is one horse that can do all those jobs!

title: Victoria
excerpt: 2016 Paint Horse Palomino Tobiano Gelding 15 Hands
description: Have you got a husband or wife that likes to play cowboy but isn’t really a hand…??? Well let me tell ya Victoria here will make them look like they know what they are doing! Victoria is a super stocky 15hh QH gelding. … He has pasture roped calves, penned cows at the stock yards, been a boys girls 4H horse and a fantastic trail mount. Victoria has that in your pocket personality he will follow you around like a lost puppy. Very easy to handle. He has had natural horsemanship training and is very soft and supple on the ground as well as on his back. Victoria gives off pressure very well he will flex both directions and at the poll. Will give to pressure off his fore quarters and hind quarters. Victoria stands very quietly to be tied both in the cross ties and tied out. He is very easy to saddle and bridle. Stands perfect to mount and always rides off slow and easy. Victoria has a lot of handle under saddle. He neck reins, rides off leg pressure and has a good back. He will one step lope out of a walk or can jog as slow as you want to go. He is very laid back and never gets worked up. He is perfectly content with dog walking all day. Victoria is a great trail horse like I mentioned earlier. He will go up, down or through anything. He is very confident and knows his job. If you are looking for a horse that can make you look like a professional but that’s also very easy to ride Victoria is your man!!!

title: Victory
excerpt: 2017 Gypsy Vanner Horse Dapple Grey Gelding 14.1 Hands
description: Victory is a very fancy SILVER DAPPLE GYPSY SPORT HORSE. This gelding is strikingly handsome, very well broke, seasoned on the trails, and broke to drive. He has been driven on the main roads and is traffic safe. He stands 14.1 hands. He has a flashy white strip in his face and two hind socks with lots of big gorgeous silver dapples. He has a very pretty mane and a Snow White tail. He is a dreamy horse to ride or drive with lots of style and action. He lopes nice circles, catches his leads, and has a nice lead departure. He will cross water and all trail obstacles quietly and is not spooky of wildlife. He is sure footed, takes his time down steep embankments, and he genuinely enjoys going out into the woods. He is a really cool horse for anyone to enjoy riding or driving. He has been to the hitch classes and he stands to harness, hitch, tack, mount, and groom. He loads, bathes, hauls, and stands tied for any length of time. He has been ridden under English and Western tack. He has a nice extended trot when asked for it and a slower jog that is easy to sit. His lope is comfy and collected. This is a hard to find horse with the color, size, ride, and personality that everyone is seeking. Don’t miss out on a unique colored GYPSY SPORT HORSE with all of the eye appeal, ride, drive, sense, and ability that you could want. He’s fancy enough to show and durable enough for ranch work.

title: Whiskey
excerpt: 2016 Quarter Horse Blue Roan Gelding 16.2 Hands
description: Whiskey sticks at 16.2 hands, weighing in at 1,450lbs, and a TRUE Blue Roan. It’s rare to find a horse with his modern day black type pedigree with his bone structure. He has a very well rounded background with a lot of experience in and out of the arena. Whiskey has nice lead departures and has a very smooth and comfortable lope on a loose rein. He collects nicely and is soft in his face and ribcage. He has a great one handed neck rein with good direction. He side passes, goes over all the trail obstacles, and handles everything thrown his way rock solid. He has a big long trot across large pastures and can cover some ground. He’s gathered thousands of cattle, caught some wild ones in the brush, and has been used for sorting, doctoring, branding, and loading. Whiskey has been roped on a lot in the pasture and some in the arena. He could pull a semi truck if you dallied it onto your saddle horn. He’s super quiet and easy to track cattle on. He ground ties where you drop a rein, stands quiet for the mounting block and will let you climb on him fence side. Whiskey is cool as a cucumber out on the trails and enjoys to leisurely cruise down the road. Nothing spooks this bold, brave guy and he’s safe for any level of rider. Always gentle and safe even with substantial time off. Saddle up and go, no worries! Whiskey is built to last a lifetime and will be your best partner on the trails or on the ranch. He’s docile and kind on the ground and on his back. He’s easy to own and wants to be solid citizen in all aspects of owning a horse. He will lay down on command and you can ride anywhere you want bareback. He is trustworthy around loud gunfire, crazy dogs, blowing tarps, heavy machinery, and wildlife. I bet you can’t show me one like him, he’s the kind!

title: Whisper
description: Check out this handsome blonde gentleman! Whisper is 15 hands, sweet as pie and as honest as the day is long. The entire family will enjoy this gentle gelding. He will be safe and fun for the kiddos and would be a great confidence builder for a beginner or timid rider. Whisper would be fun to go show in the reining, ranch riding and ranch versatility events. He’s very smooth and easy to sit. He has a nice slow jog and a big extended trot. He lopes on a draped rein and has more whoa than go. Whisper has easy lead changes, pretty spins, and a long sliding stop. His transitions are fluent and he has great direction. He easily guides with a neck rein or will ride just as good with no bridle and a string around his neck. Whisper always stays trained and gentle even with time off. You won’t ever have to worry about anything with this sweet gelding, just saddle up, climb on, and go! Whisper has been exposed to lots of different types of terrain and landscape.

title: Willy
description:
Willy is 100% gentle, sane and absolutely kid friendly!
\nThis is definitely one of my best ponies being offered to the public to date!
\nWilly is perfectly marked and full of chrome. He is a great size and made right! Willy is one hand broke, moves off leg pressure and is very light in the mouth. Willy can give an English lesson and have another kid hop on and gather cattle on him in the next! If you can sit in the saddle, you can ride him! Willy has a very nice lope with easy smooth transitions. His pleasing and kind attitude makes him the first choice for every kid! Children, teens and small adults have been on top of Willy. He lives up to his name, taking care of every one of his passengers. He rides safely through busy towns and excels inside and outside of the arena. He does not spook at new objects, has been hauled to paydays and little shows all over. He stays levelheaded and has no fear around dogs, ropes, goats, roping sleds, vehicles, pigs and more! Willy truly has been used in all aspects of western and English riding. The kids absolutely adore being around this saint of a pony. They can easily catch him in any size pen, throw a halter on, swing up and ride him bareback! He stands quiet and still for brushing, baths and clipping. He is a gentleman to load, tie and haul. Willy is not spooky nor does he have any bad habits. He walks, trots and lopes on a loose rein and will NOT take advantage of the tiny learning kids. He picks up both leads and backs up with ease! SOUND and clean, with no visible bumps or blemishes. Willy sells with a current negative Coggins test, and heath certificate. Pre purchase exams are available at buyer’s expense!

title: Winnie
excerpt: 2017 Rocky Mountain Horse Chocolate Mare 15.1 Hands
description: Winnie is a super stout built, Rocky Mountain Mare, standing 15.1hh, is that classic dark chocolate color with a platinum blonde mane and tail! She is built like a tank, built to carry a heavy load but gentle enough to carry the precious cargo! She has miles and miles of experience! Winnie has been camping and trail ridden at large campgrounds and has been on week long camping trips. She is easy for me to catch, clip, bath, tack-up, load, and handle. She has a natural smooth 4-beat gait that covers the ground with ease. No matter where she goes or what she does, Winnie is not spooky acting and on the trails she is always great! She will ride anywhere that she is asked whether that be in the front or back of the group. She is confident and leave the barn or other horses with no issues. She has been exposed to all kinds of wildlife such as deer or turkey or other animals like cows or dogs and will go anywhere that she is asked too. She has been rode many miles in the mountains and encountered every obstacle possible on the trail. She will go up or down even the steepest slopes, across deep creeks, over downed trees, and over all types of rough terrain while still being sure footed. She has been rode in traffic, and is very traffic safe around cars, semi, log, and dump trucks. She has a great personality and a great attitude about whatever she is asked to do.

title: Wrangler
excerpt: 2015 Quarter Horse Red Roan Gelding 15.1 Hands
description: This guy has it all! The breeding, talent, disposition, size, and color! Wrangler has some substance to him and stands 15.1 hands. He’s a one stop shop for a working cowboy, yet a perfect family horse. He is fancy enough for the ranch foreman, but gentle and safe for the little buckaroos! He was ridden for years on a ranch by a man in his late 70’s and took care of him every step of the way. Wrangler cuts a cow and is super fun to use in the sorting pens and gathering cattle. We have roped on him out of the box and in the arena. He reads cattle great with great timing and rate. Wrangler is well trained in the arena with good turnarounds, pretty slow lope, deep stop and has a solid one handed neck rein. He is great outside in big pastures with a ground covering trot and is very sure footed. He will willingly side pass to open any gate and ground ties where you drop a rein. Wrangler is always gentle and has zero silly businesses to him. He’s a sweet, kind, and easy horse to own. He’s good with other horses and easy to catch in a pasture. He has lots of fun buttons and like most Metallic Cats, he has been a pleasure to ride and train. Go ranch, rope, cut, or have a superstar trail horse, Wrangler is very trustworthy and will be your go-to partner.

title: Xavier
description: Xavier is the perfect Child/Adult Hunter/Equitation for any level rider and would happily go in the Jumper ring. He is always willing to please and has great manners in the barn. Great movement and a 10 jump. For more info please do not hesitate to contact us.

title: Yankee
description: Yankee is not only tall, dark, and handsome, but has impeccable manners and the sweetest personality. He’s the kind that everyone wants to take home and call theirs.
