Standing 15.3 hands, gorgeous blood bay with a super long mane and tail, this gelding will get attention every step he takes. Yankee is quite versatile with a pretty big resume.He has quite the accomplishments, buckles and ribbons! Yankee has a very elegant and classy style and I believe he would excel in western dressage. He also looks unbelievable in an English saddle. He is an excellent mover with a magnificent long trot, slow and smooth jog, and a rocking chair lope that you could ride all day. In or out of the arena, this guy handles the trail course flawlessly. Yankee is crosses logs, bridges, and jumps. He willingly side passes to to the gates and ground ties where you drop a rein. We have roped cattle on him and used him all over our ranch. He’s a kind soul that wants to be your best partner. Yankee is 100% gentle, tolerant, and kind for a beginner, kid, or great grandma. He’s a great confidence builder that knows the ropes. He stays gentle with time off and is the same sweet and honest boy every time you saddle him. Absolutely no silly business. Yankee trail rides like a dream and is confident alone or good in group. He’s a happy camper in all situations. He will cross running water, deep mud, thick brush, navigate through prickly cactus, and has seen lots of different terrain. Yankee loves attention and is easy peasy to catch in the pasture. He will walk right up to you and follow you around. He’s great with other horses in the pasture and side by side in a stock trailer. He will stand tied patiently for hours and is always respective of people and all animals. Yankee knows some fun tricks and will lay down with a touch of the finger and pick up your rope or hat from the ground. He’s accustomed to crazy dogs, heavy traffic, loud gunfire, large machinery and blowing tarps. Yankee is going to make someone amazing and we are proud to offer this phenomenal gelding. He ticks all those boxes with his stellar looks, a gentle demeanor, blacktype pedigree and a huge performance record! Just like Yankee, we absolutely adored him. Good bloodlines produce solid minded, trainable, and good horses!

title: Zidane
description:
Let us introduce you to Zidane. Being arguably one of the best geldings we have offered to the public, this gorgeous guy is a true heart horse. ‘Zidane’ as we call him has a personality the size of a planet and the biggest heart to match. His flashy looks are just a bonus!
\nIt’s hard not to fall in love with this big-hearted, flashy gelding. Right away, Zidane’s huge dog-like personality won us over. He truly loves everyone… and I mean everyone. It doesn’t matter what time of day, or if he’s in a dead sleep, once he hears you coming he lets out a big nicker to greet you. It didn’t take long for him to show us his ‘silly’ side and he has been making us laugh ever since. He sticks his tongue out on command when you push on his nose! This sweet guy can convince just about anyone to stop and pet him. He actually knows his name and will respond to you! If he doesn’t flag you down with his nickers, his looks sure will. Zidane is a Palomino on his papers, but as he has gotten older he darkened into a gorgeous Dunalino. He has a dark dorsal stripe, tiger stripes on his legs and withers, and a bright mane and tail to top it off!
\nTrained to go at whatever pace you would like, he can step it up or cruise around nice and slow. Zidane is a push-style horse, but not dull, and is very responsive to every cue. He has super smooth gaits that are easy to sit and enjoy. His transitions are simple and his turnarounds can be slowed down or sped up, as shown in his sale video. He will cross water, step over a tarp, drag whatever you would like, carry a flag, step over logs, and the list goes on. Zidane is as good-minded as they get! He has the mind to make an excellent kid’s horse, but the ability to step up and show at whatever level you would like. His pretty extended trot would make him a great ranch rider as well. This guy can take you right to the winner’s circle, or down the trail – wherever you point him, he’s happy to go! He is a confident, calm gelding and is happy to go trail riding alone or with other horses. Zidane will also pick you up off the mounting block as shown in his video.
\nHe has absolutely no vices, bad habits, or tricks to mention! No need for front shoes, Zidane is barefoot in the front and has sliders on his back feet. As you can see, he is a shapey guy. He is a very easy keeper and has no special requirements for feed. Zidane is easy to catch and if he sees you coming, will beat you to the gate and greet you with a nicker. He is extremely respectful on the ground and stands still for the farrier and to be saddled. He will stand to be bathed, clipped, loads like a dream, and is willing to be a participant in whatever activity you like!
\nHe is a once-in-a-lifetime type of gelding and we have never met another like him! Zidane knows how to be loved and how to love you back.

title: 1 – White Rock Ranch Cutter
description: This White Rock Cutting Saddle is built on a Hadlock Brand, Buster Welch Tree, that carries a 5-year tree warranty, with Herman Oak leather, it comes standard with rawhide wrapped stirrups (pictured with Nettles stirrups $125 up-charge). It has a 9-inch front swell height, 13-inch width, 3-inch cantel, and is a full quarter horse bar width. This saddle features a Basketweave/Floral combo tooling with roughout jockey and fenders. These saddles known as “ranch cutters” are some of the most versatile in the industry and are used for Trails, Ranch, Team Sorting, Cutting, and other disciplines as well. These trees fit a wide variety of horses from Quarter Horses to Draftcrosses to Gaited Horses. We have 15.5″ and 16.5″ in stock and ready to ship!
